title: ABM Operations Manager, AI & Automation
descriptionHtml:
About the role 

Our ABM team runs highly targeted programs for the accounts that matter most to RELEX. We want those programs to be even more personalized, more interactive, and faster to launch across channels, without adding manual effort for every new account. 

That's where you come in. You'll advise how the ABM team runs and develops five operational areas: paid media, landing page creation, content personalization, targeted direct mail, and analytics. You'll review how each area works today, then design and build the AI-based workflows, templates, and quality guardrails that let the team focus on account strategy, creativity and stakeholder alignment over manual work. 

What you'll do 

Across all five operational areas 

  • Map how each area works today, find where time and quality can be improved, and agree a prioritized automation roadmap with the Head of ABM
  • Build and maintain the AI workflows the ABM team uses day to day, with tools such as Claude, n8n, Folloze and HubSpot
  • Partner with Marketing Operations, who own our martech platforms, data, and integrations: build ABM workflows on top of the shared stack, follow its standards, and hand over anything that should become a cross-team capability
  • Agree brand and quality guardrails with Brand & Creative so AI-produced assets can go live with light review
  • Document every workflow and train the team so it runs without you 

Ad operations (LinkedIn, Influ2) 

  • Own the setup and execution model for ABM account and contact level campaigns
  • Build workflows and guardrails that cut the time spent on campaign setup
  • Build workflows that generate on-brand ad variants by account, segment, and buying group role
  • Run channel and tactic experiments to find the right mix of reach, engagement, and conversion activity
  • Close the data feedback loop, so account and contact level engagement flows back to the account team and into ABM planning automatically 

Landing page operations 

  • Build a template and component library the team can use to generate account and segment pages with AI
  • Set standards for personalization depth, and work with ABM designers on a tailored look and feel per account
  • Find opportunities to build deeper, more interactive experiences for prospects 

Content build operations 

  • Build and fine-tune workflows that turn existing RELEX content (research, customer stories, point of view pieces) into account-tailored assets such as one-pagers, guides, and sales follow-up material 

Direct mail operations 

  • Design a direct mail program framework that delivers personalized mailers at scale
  • Own the operating model behind them: vendor setup, address data quality, GDPR compliance, budget, and cost per account
  • Connect every send to a defined sales follow-up, and measure what it contributes 

Analytics and reporting 

  • Define how ABM programs are measured, together with the Head of ABM and Marketing Operations: account reach, engagement, buying group coverage, and pipeline contribution
  • Build and maintain reporting that shows what's working by account, channel, and tactic, so channel and budget decisions rest on evidence rather than assumption
  • Keep campaign data clean and comparable across platforms, including naming conventions, UTM standards, and campaign taxonomy
  • Measure the impact of the AI workflows themselves: time saved, cost per asset, and speed from brief to launch 

What we're looking for 

  • 4+ years in B2B ABM, demand generation, growth marketing, GTM engineering, or marketing operations
  • A working understanding of how B2B paid media runs, ideally on LinkedIn: campaign structure, account and contact list targeting, bidding and budget pacing, and which platform metrics you can and can’t trust
  • A proven track record of designing and shipping AI and automation workflows that other people use, with examples you can walk us through
  • Practical experience working with LLMs: prompt design, structured outputs, connecting models to business data and tools, and evaluating output quality
  • Hands-on experience building automations in n8n, Make, Zapier, Workato, or similar, including APIs, webhooks, JSON, and error handling
  • A process mindset: you can map a workflow, see where it breaks, and design a repeatable replacement
  • Good judgment on quality: you know when AI output is ready to be rolled out and when it isn't 

Nice to have 

  • Enough Python or JavaScript to write, read, and debug automation scripts and API calls
  • Experience with intent and engagement platforms such as 6sense, or contact-level advertising such as Influ2
  • Experience running direct mail or gifting programs in B2B
  • Working knowledge of SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (for example Power BI, Looker, or Tableau)
  • Background in global enterprise B2B software with long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles 

About RELEX 

RELEX Solutions creates cutting-edge supply chain and retail planning software. Within our platforms, we have the power and potential to increase adaptability, efficiency, and sustainability in the consumer goods and retail value chain. Our impact is tangible; from sustainability and eliminating waste to delighting customers and delivering great tailored tech solutions, we’re curious and passionate challenge-seekers creating the future of retail today.

We’re currently a global team of 2000+ employees working from offices in the US (Atlanta), UK, Germany, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Singapore, Australia, and our headquarters in Helsinki, Finland. We work in small teams where everyone’s input is valued. We’re passionate about what we do, we like putting our skills to the test, and we make sure we have fun during the process — because life is supposed to be fun.

RELEX Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Academy Team Lead (9 Month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy is a key contributor to driving the self-sufficiency and enablement of Quantexa's customers and partners. We achieve this through online learning, instructor-led training and practical technical programmes that help Quantexa users configure, use and implement our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform. We are looking for someone to join our Academy Team Lead team on a nine-month maternity cover, delivering high-quality technical learning experiences for our colleagues, customers and partners.

In this fixed-term maternity cover role, you will deliver engaging face-to-face and online training, support learners with technical and learning queries, assess learner work and contribute to the continued development of the Academy's technical curriculum. You will act as a key interface between the Academy, learners, clients and partners, working closely with colleagues across Education Services, Cloud, Delivery, Solution Engineering, Technology Account Partners and Alliances.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Provide timely learner support through online sessions and digital channels, including troubleshooting technical issues and delivering live code demonstrations.

  • Evaluate learner projects and assessments, applying fair and consistent marking criteria and providing timely, constructive feedback.

  • Plan and conduct viva assessments for assigned learners, including where further validation of learner understanding is required.

  • Detect and address plagiarism and inappropriate use of AI in learner submissions in line with Academy processes.

  • Deliver engaging face-to-face and online technical training sessions, ensuring high levels of learner participation and satisfaction.

  • Support the maintenance and improvement of training code, technical environments and program setup, resolving general bugs and issues.

  • Collect and act on learner feedback to support the continuous improvement of Academy programs and learning experiences.

  • Collaborate with the Training and LMS Administrator to support the smooth delivery and administration of training programs.

  • Contribute to the creation and ongoing development of technical education programs, curriculum content and communications for Quantexans, customers and partners.

  • Work with Cloud and Delivery teams on VDI setup, issue resolution, data engineer enablement and alignment of assessment criteria with delivery requirements.

  • Act as a subject matter expert for the Design and Publish Pillar and contribute to projects and initiatives across Education Services.

What you’ll bring

Essential

  • Strong knowledge of data processing pipelines and big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop and Elasticsearch, alongside proficiency in Scala, Java, Python or other object-oriented languages.

  • Experience delivering engaging technical training and live coding in both face-to-face and online environments, with the ability to explain complex concepts to learners of varying experience levels.

  • Experience assessing technical projects and conducting viva assessments, providing constructive feedback and identifying plagiarism or inappropriate use of AI.

  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to resolve learner, code, platform and training-environment issues.

  • Excellent communication, relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to motivate learners and work effectively with clients, partners, colleagues and stakeholders.

  • Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to balance training, assessment and learner support while adapting to changing programme needs.

  • A proactive, positive and solution-focused approach, contributing to an inclusive and supportive learning environment.

Desirable

  • Experience with front-end development technologies, including HTML, Angular and CSS

  • Experience of maintaining or contributing to technical curricula, training code or learning programs

  • Experience working with cloud-based virtual training environments or VDI setup and issue resolution

  • Knowledge of learning technologies, assessment platforms or Learning Management Systems

  • Quantexa Data Engineer Academy certified

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our French EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalised outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Account Director SEO - F/H - CDI
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Description

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

A propos de WPP Media:

WPP is the creative transformation company. Nous utilisons le pouvoir de la créativité pour construire un avenir meilleur pour nos collaborateurs, notre planète, nos clients et nos communautés. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wpp.com. WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com.

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.

Contexte Le pôle SEO de WPP Media accélère sa transformation technique et produit. Nous cherchons un Consultant SEO Technique Senior capable de prendre la main sur nos comptes les plus complexes tout en structurant nos assets internes

Missions

Pilotage de comptes SEO complexes

  • Prendre la responsabilité stratégique et opérationnelle sur des comptes clés (e-commerce, international, multi-marché).
  • Structurer et piloter les feuilles de route SEO avec une vision long terme, en cohérence avec les objectifs business clients.
  • Être l'interlocuteur de référence côté agence : assurer la qualité des livrables, la tenue des engagements, et la progression mesurable des performances.

Conseil stratégique et relation client

  • Animer les comités stratégiques avec les clients, en posture de conseil senior, pas d'exécution.
  • Identifier les opportunités de croissance (upsell, nouveaux sujets SEO/GEO, synergies Search).
  • Vulgariser les recommandations techniques pour des interlocuteurs non-experts (directions marketing, e-commerce, digital).

Encadrement et structuration

  • Encadrer et faire monter en compétence les consultants SEO sur les comptes dont il/elle a la charge.
  • Contribuer à la formalisation des méthodologies et des best practices du pôle.
  • Participer aux sujets d'innovation (GEO/LLM, IA appliquée au SEO) sans en être le seul référent technique.

Développement et transversalité

  • Travailler en coordination avec les équipes SEA, Data et Analytics pour des stratégies Search intégrées.
  • Contribuer aux pitchs et réponses à appels d'offres sur les comptes stratégiques.
Profil recherché

Expérience et compétences

  • 6 à 10 ans d'expérience en SEO, dont une part significative en agence sur des comptes de taille entreprise.
  • Maîtrise solide des fondamentaux SEO : technique (crawl, indexation, Core Web Vitals), sémantique, et performance.
  • À l'aise avec les outils de référence (Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, GSC, GA4) sans nécessairement maîtriser le développement.
  • Une première exposition aux sujets GEO/LLM et à l'évolution des SERP (AI Overviews, Search Generative Experience) est un atout réel.

Posture et savoir-être

  • Sens client affirmé : capacité à gérer des interlocuteurs seniors côté annonceur, avec aisance et conviction.
  • Leadership naturel sur ses comptes, sans attendre une validation à chaque étape.
  • Pédagogie : sait rendre lisible une recommandation complexe pour un public non-technique.
  • Esprit de collaboration avec les équipes internes (SEA, data, produit).
  • Anglais professionnel courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

Ce qui fera la différence

  • Une expérience sur des environnements multi-marchés ou multi-marques.
  • Une capacité à porter des sujets en avant-vente et à contribuer à des pitchs.
  • Un intérêt sincère pour les transformations du Search (IA, LLM, Search intégré).

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité. Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.

Nos avantages comprennent:

  • Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année
  • Deux jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte
  • Jours de congé additionnels par pallier de 5 ans d’ancienneté
  • 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaborateurs souffrant d’endométriose
  • Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH
  • Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act

Process de recrutement

Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise. 🥈Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste. 🥉Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée. Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle. Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.

title: Account Executive – Accountant Channel
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as an Account Executive – Accountant Channel to turn France’s accounting firms into one of Qonto’s strongest growth channels. You’ll build your own pipeline of firms and close them end to end, under the guidance of Adrien Cannet, our Lead Accountant Channel.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Build your own pipeline: You’ll source and prospect accounting firms across France, with no inbound to lean on.

  • Own the whole sales process end to end: qualify, understand how each firm works and where its pain sits and close the deal.

  • Turn firms into referral partners: You’ll get accountants recommending Qonto to their own client base.

  • Use AI to work smarter: You’ll lean on AI tools to prep calls, personalise outreach and speed up qualification.

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge

There are thousands of businesses globally growing fast and hitting the same wall - they need capital, and traditional lenders are too slow, too rigid, or simply not interested. We've already deployed over $6bn to growing businesses like these. The opportunity in front of us is significant, and we need people who can capitalise on it.

 

What you'll actually do

You'll own the full sales cycle from sourcing your own leads to closing deals with some of the most exciting consumer brands on the market. You'll run in-depth discovery calls using MEDDPICC, work closely with our underwriting team to move fast without cutting corners, and negotiate deals that genuinely work for both sides. You'll have a dedicated BDR alongside you, but you won't wait around for a full pipeline to land in your lap. The best AEs here source relentlessly, close confidently, and treat their customers like business partners, not transactions. Top performers are hitting ~200% of target. That's not a boast. It's a signal of what’s possible.

 

What this role could turn into

Account Executives at Wayflyer tend to grow in one of two directions - first on the ground in one of our emerging verticals, or into team leadership as we scale. We're continuing to launch new products and verticals, which means the people who perform here will have real options. We'd rather promote from within than hire from outside, and our track record reflects that.

 

Who thrives here
You've worked a full sales cycle before, and you didn't just hit your number; you understood exactly why you hit it and what to do differently when you didn't. You source your own pipeline without being asked, and you don't wait for perfect conditions to start. You're energised by ambiguity, not paralysed by it. You push deals forward when others would wait for a signal. When a sceptical founder pushes back, you lean in. You've been told "no" and come back with a better question. You care about eCommerce and small business growth, not as a line on a cover letter, but as a genuine reason you want this job.

We hire for range
Full sales cycle experience across a range of deal values (think: $10K to 100K) in SaaS or FinTech, ideally with time spent as an outbound BDR/SDR. You know what it takes to build a pipeline from scratch, not just work it. A consistent track record of exceeding targets matters more than tenure. Resilience shows up in your history: you've had a bad quarter, figured out why, and bounced back stronger. MEDDPICC familiarity is required. Startup or scale-up experience helps; the pace here is real, the playbook is still being written, and we need people who see that as an opportunity, not a risk.

 

Location and working policy

📍Dublin or London, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)

 

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.

title: Account Executive, native Mandarin speaker
descriptionHtml:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

 

About the role

As an Account Executive at Scarlet you will own deals from discovery to close by building relationships with regulatory and operations leaders. You will become a regulatory expert capable of meeting the complex needs of our customers. Your work will help ambitious medical technology companies bring safe products to patients sooner and drive Scarlet’s growth.

This is a London-based role with a global reach requiring native-level Mandarin and excellent English. You will initially sell to English-speaking customers, including customers outside China, while helping us prepare for future demand from Chinese-speaking customers. As that demand grows, your focus may increasingly include Chinese-speaking accounts. You will remain based in London, including if China-related work becomes your full-time focus.

 

What you'll be working on

The companies you'll be selling to are doing some of the most interesting work in healthcare right now. A few of the customers you'll be pointing prospects towards:

  • Floy certified three AI radiology devices under EU MDR, completed an ISO transfer and a scope extension, all in 16 weeks

  • Skin Analytics brought a Class III AI dermatology device to the European market

  • Augmedit certified multiple augmented reality neurosurgery devices

  • Flok Health went from submission to EU MDR certification of an AI physiotherapy device in 14 weeks

  • Lucida Medical transferred an AI radiology device to Scarlet in seven weeks and started shipping model updates immediately

  • Feebris got an AI photoplethysmography device certified in time to support critical NHS priorities

You can read all of these at scarlet.cc/customer-stories. Your job is to find the next Floy or Skin Analytics and show them there's a faster way.

 

Responsibilities

  • Build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers at cutting-edge technology companies across the healthcare industry, in person wherever possible, including at major industry conferences (e.g. MEDICA in Düsseldorf, RSNA in Chicago) and customer sites globally

  • Sell to English-speaking customers and, as demand develops, Mandarin-speaking customers

  • Source, own, and win deals from discovery to closed won with the right customers

  • Collaborate closely with teammates to bring the relevant expertise to different parts of the sales motion and communicate Scarlet’s value proposition

  • Work with the rest of the Sales function to continuously improve our processes

  • Drive continuous iteration by sharing insights from customer interactions to help shape our go-to-market strategy and product offering

 

Required qualifications

  • You have 2-3 years of B2B closing experience

  • You’re insatiably curious about the world and what makes people tick

  • You have native-level spoken and written Mandarin, alongside excellent spoken and written English, and can confidently sell to customers in both languages

  • You are able to work in a London-based role and are comfortable initially selling to English-speaking customers outside China, with your portfolio evolving as customer demand grows.

  • You have a high EQ, which alongside your curiosity enables you to navigate complex human relationships, understand people’s drivers, communicate creatively, and close complex deals

  • You have exceptional written & verbal communication skills

  • You are a self-starter, high-agency, and take ownership of your own success

 

Preferred qualifications

  • You have experience working in healthcare and/or a regulated industry

 

Interview process

Note: we typically collapse interviews 4-7 into one in-person session at our London HQ.

  1. Intro call with Karan - 15 mins

  2. An advanced Mandarin language test (20 mins)

  3. Interview with Val or Anna - 30 mins

  4. Live case with Dan - 45 mins

  5. Interview with James A - 30 mins

  6. Culture Q&A with Yun in Mandarin (10 mins)

  7. Founder interviews: James and Jamie (2x20 mins)

  8. Offer & references

Compensation: £150K – £190K • Offers Equity

title: Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Über Cosuno

Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Volumen, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du ownst jeden Kunden nach erfolgreichem Onboarding Abschluss: Performance Tracking, Erstkontakt nach Kündigungseingang innerhalb von fünf Werktagen, Pain-Analyse, Angebot, Abschluss oder sauberer Abschied. Du verhandelst Paketwechsel, Laufzeiten und Incentives selbstständig innerhalb des Playbooks und hältst den Preis, wo er zu halten ist.

Dein Erfolg bemisst sich am Wert deines Kundenpools: Winbacks, Downgrades, Upsells – was am Ende an ARR bleibt. Dafür forecastest du deine Cases wöchentlich mit Commit und Best Case und hältst Salesforce so sauber, dass dein Forecast ohne Nachfrage lesbar ist.

Rund 30 % deiner Zeit onboardest du Neukunden, die ohne Hilfe nicht in die Nutzung kommen: Onboarding-Call, Profil, erste Angebote.

Du berichtest an den Head of Customer Success.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Mindestens 50 % der Kündigungen, die du bearbeitest, hast du (zu einem Upsell) gedreht.

  • Du bearbeitest alle Winback Cases im Monat, jeder Kunde hat innerhalb von fünf Werktagen von dir gehört und ein konkretes Angebot bekommen.

  • Dein Forecast steht jede Woche, Commit und Best Case, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Salesforce ist bei dir vollständig: Status, Kündigungsgrund, Angebot, Ergebnis – bei jedem Case.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, telefonierst du mehr, nicht weniger.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du 30 Kundengespräche die Woche normal findest und nach dem dritten Nichterreichen zum vierten Mal anrufst – unsere Kunden stehen auf der Baustelle.

  • du ein Nein aushältst und lieber das Angebot umbaust, als den Preis zu senken.

  • du schon einmal den echten Kündigungsgrund hinter dem genannten gefunden hast.

  • du Handwerksbetriebe magst und ihre Sprache sprichst.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen vermeidest.

  • du aus Support oder Service kommst und noch nie eine eigene Zielzahl hattest.

  • du zehn Enterprise-Accounts gewohnt bist und wöchentliche Cases als Fließband empfindest.

  • dich eine Zahl über deinem Schreibtisch stresst statt motiviert.

Harte Anforderungen

  • 2–4 Jahre in einer quotentragenden Rolle: Inside Sales, SDR/BDR mit Closing-Anteil, Renewals, Retention oder Account Management im SMB-Geschäft.

  • Belegbare Zielerreichung in den letzten Perioden.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2), Englisch gut.

  • Berlin oder Bereitschaft zu Bürotagen.

Vergütung

80.000 € OTE pro Jahr (Zielgehalt bei 100 % Zielerreichung), bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt und einer variablen Komponente, die sich nach deiner Zielerreichung richtet.

Was wir bieten

  • Klarheit: Eine Zahl, ein Playbook, direkter Einfluss auf dein Ergebnis.

  • Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung.

  • Arbeitsort: Berlin-Kreuzberg oder hybrid, du wählst.

  • Entwicklung: Regelmäßige 1:1s, Entwicklungsgespräche, offene Feedbackkultur.

  • Team: Firmen- und Teamevents, online und offline.

Compensation: €70K – €80K • 80.000 € OTE pro Jahr (Zielgehalt bei 100 % Zielerreichung), bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt und einer variablen Komponente, die sich nach deiner Zielerreichung richtet.

title: Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.
Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.
Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.
How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.
About the Role: As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall. By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time. This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations. Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey. This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
  • Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.
    • Why Join our Account Management Team: At Aircall, you’ll join a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team that thrives at the intersection of success and growth. You’ll have the autonomy to build your book of business, the support of dedicated technical partners, and the opportunity to help customers unlock the full potential of Aircall’s communications and AI solutions. This is an exceptional opportunity for stellar sellers who want to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive measurable business impact — helping them realize the value of Aircall through trust, expertise, and long-term partnership.

We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.

title: Account Manager, SME & Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the role

As an Airwallex Account Manager, you will build relationships with our existing customers to ensure they are receiving the tools and support needed to achieve their goals. You will be the bridge between the customer and the Airwallex team and will have an in-depth understanding of the customer’s needs and goals and how Airwallex can support them. You will be working in an incredibly fast paced, scaling environment and providing resources across the EMEA business at a senior level, evaluating and scaling Account Management strategy and working closely with Sales, Marketing and Operations Leadership.

Our UK team is growing, we are currently 110+ employees, working in a hybrid work environment with 3 days per week required in our London Office @wells&more - GPE, Fitzrovia.

What you'll do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic accounts, developing account plans, increasing product adoption, deepening relationships, and driving expansion through regular strategic customer engagements.

  • Identify, develop, and close upsell and expansion opportunities, proactively managing opportunities through the sales cycle from identification to close and revenue realisation.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, understanding their business, industry, and goals to help them maximise the value of Airwallex and identify opportunities to support their growth.

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, including bespoke commercial agreements, multi product solutions, and high-value expansion opportunities.

  • Translate customer needs into solutions, with the ability to understand technical requirements and work across multiple products to develop compelling, commercially viable solutions.

  • Operate with ownership and agility, demonstrating the ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.

  • Demonstrate a strong track record of performance and a passion for technology, consistently achieving or exceeding KPIs and revenue targets while maintaining the curiosity to understand and articulate the value of an evolving technology landscape.

What you bring

  • 2+ years of experience in account management or sales, ideally selling a technical product, with a proven track record of top performance.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to manage complex sales cycles, understand customer strategies and pain points, and articulate compelling value propositions. Experience with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC is preferred.

  • Proven track record of exceeding targets, with demonstrated success in high target, high pace environments and consistently delivering against commercial KPIs and revenue goals.

  • Strong analytical and strategic skills, with the ability to use data to develop account strategies, identify opportunities, and build effective QBRs and account plans.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-product accounts, including developing and executing strategic account plans to drive retention, adoption, and expansion.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with strong verbal and written English and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders.

  • Strong problem-solving, networking, and relationship-building skills, combined with resilience, a positive attitude, and a strong bias towards action when navigating blockers.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand complex technical problems and requirements. Solid understanding of APIs is preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

  • Startup and/or fintech experience preferred.

  • Experience with Salesforce highly regarded.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Accounts Payable & Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
Als Accounts Payable & Financial Controller ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële administratie — een van de belangrijkste pijlers voor het nemen van beslissingen binnen Crisp. Je combineert de dagelijkse sturing op de crediteurenadministratie met uitdagende controlewerkzaamheden, data-analyses en het automatiseren van onze processen met behulp van moderne tools en AI.

Wat je gaat doen

Je werkt elke dag met een gezellig team vol gedreven mensen. We hebben ervaring in business control, accounting, corporate finance, data analytics, fiscaal recht en auditing. Crisp groeit snel, en de verantwoordelijkheden van ons team dus ook. Zo is geen dag hetzelfde en blijven we onszelf continu ontwikkelen. We sparren veel en staan open voor elkaars mening.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verwerken en controleren van inkomende facturen en declaraties. Je staat leveranciers te woord, beheert de mailstroom en zet betalingen klaar.

  • Je stuurt een team van werkstudenten en stagiaires aan en zorgt er samen met hen voor dat alle facturen tijdig en correct worden verwerkt.

  • Je ondersteunt bij de maandafsluiting, controleert grootboekrekeningen en helpt mee met ad-hoc analyses en periodieke rapportages.

  • Je denkt actief mee over het slim inrichten van financiële workflows. Je verkent en implementeert mogelijkheden voor procesautomatisering, slimme datakoppelingen en AI-oplossingen (zoals OCR-herkenning en geautomatiseerde factuurverwerking).

  • Je rapporteert aan de Lead Financial Controller, die je ondersteunt in je dagelijkse werkzaamheden en je helpt om door te groeien in je rol.

Dit ben jij

Als ideale kandidaat heb je al een basis aan kennis en ervaring en wil je blijven leren in een vakgebied dat continu verandert en digitaliseert. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo- of universitaire opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Finance, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy).

  • Je hebt 0-3 jaar relevante werkervaring in een financiële of control-functie.

  • Je hebt ervaring met de crediteurenadministratie en het verwerken en controleren van facturen.

  • Kennis van accountingsoftware (zoals Exact) is een pré.

  • Je bent handig met data en hebt een sterke affiniteit met automatisering en nieuwe technologieën (zoals AI-tools, data-integraties en procesoptimalisatie).

  • Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

  • Je bent integer, nauwkeurig en risicobewust. Je begrijpt dat een strakke administratie de basis vormt voor goede besluitvorming.

  • Je denkt in kansen en mogelijkheden: je ziet direct waar processen sneller, slimmer of foutlozer kunnen en schroomt niet om dit op te pakken.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !
Tes futures missions : L’IA générative bouleverse les méthodes de développement logiciel et d’architecture. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un·e AI Architect, capable de concevoir une architecture cible et une trajectoire de modernisation IA-powered, en particulier pour des systèmes legacy complexes. En tant qu’AI Architect chez Theodo, ta mission sera de : - Cartographier les dépendances des systèmes legacy - Concevoir une architecture moderne (modulaire, scalable) adaptée à l’IA - Définir un plan de migration progressif et soutenable - Apporter ton expertise dans l’usage des LLM et de la génération de code IA dans les projets client - Tu travailleras avec des équipes produit et tech de 4 à 6 personnes, composées de Software Engineers, Tech Leads et Product Owners, sur des problématiques complexes à fort impact. Exemples de projets IA : - Définition d’une nouvelle architecture logicielle pour un grand acteur public, avec intégration d’un moteur IA pour générer automatiquement des composants front - Migration vers une architecture modulaire d’un backend monolithique dans le retail, en exploitant la génération de code pour accélérer les refontes - Mise en place d’un socle technique pour créer des agents IA internes, interopérables avec des APIs métiers Profil recherché : Nous recherchons un profil senior, passionné par l’architecture logicielle et l’IA générative. Tu as une forte capacité à prendre de la hauteur, modéliser des solutions complexes, et collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires. Tes compétences clés : - Solide compréhension de la théorie du code et des patterns d’architecture - Expérience en prompt engineering (meta-prompts, chain-of-thought, few-shot learning…) - Excellentes capacités d’abstraction et de modélisation Ton background : - Tu es architecte logiciel expérimenté·e - Tu as déjà une immersion d’au moins 6 mois dans l’univers de la génération de code assistée par IA (LLMs, copilots, tooling…)Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Pour participer à la redéfinition de ce que c'est que travailler avec l'IA

  • 5 ans d'avance sur le sujet : Theodo investit massivement sur l'IA appliquée au développement logiciel depuis 2020. Nous ne suivons pas la vague, nous la construisons.
  • Partenariats stratégiques avec Anthropic et Google : un accès direct aux dernières avancées des modèles, aux équipes produits, et aux best practices de l'écosystème.
  • Un positionnement hybride entre conseil et opérations : tu ne fais pas que des slides, tu ne fais pas que du code. Tu construis la stratégie ET tu la mets en œuvre, sur le terrain, avec les équipes du client.
  • Un terrain d'expérimentation unique : nos clients (grands groupes du CAC 40, scale-ups, secteurs régulés) font face à des défis concrets de transformation. Tu seras au cœur de la définition des nouveaux standards du métier.

Ta mission : reconstruire le SDLC avec des agents IA

En tant que Consultant SDLC & IA Agentique, tu interviens chez des clients (scale-ups, grands groupes) pour les aider à intégrer des agents IA dans leur cycle de développement logiciel — de la spec au déploiement.

Tu travailles en binôme avec les équipes engineering du client. Tu n'es pas là pour faire un audit et partir : tu déploies, tu formes, tu mesures.

Ce que tu feras au quotidien

Explorer et comprendre le SDLC client

  • Analyser comment l'équipe travaille : comment les stories arrivent, comment le code est écrit, reviewé, testé, déployé
  • Identifier les étapes où les agents IA peuvent avoir le plus d'impact en termes de productivité ou de qualité
  • Documenter et partager des insights actionnables avec le client

Déployer des agents IA dans le pipeline de delivery

  • Configurer des agents de génération de code contextualisés au codebase client
  • Mettre en place des reviewers automatiques dans les PR workflows (GitHub, GitLab...)
  • Intégrer des agents dans les étapes de test, de documentation, ou de migration
  • Brancher tout ça dans les outils existants : CI/CD, IDE, ticketing

Former les équipes à travailler avec les agents

  • Animer des ateliers pratiques pour les devs : "comment travailler avec un copilote IA ?"
  • Créer les guides d'adoption adaptés aux différents niveaux (junior dev → tech lead)
  • Être le point de contact de confiance pendant la phase de transition

Mesurer l'impact avec de vrais chiffres

  • Définir les métriques qui comptent (temps de cycle, taux d'adoption, qualité du code généré)
  • Mettre en place la télémétrie IDE et les dashboards de productivité
  • Transformer ces données en recommandations concrètes pour la suite

Profil recherché

  • 5 ans minimum d'expérience en développement de logiciel
  • Diplôme d'ingénieur (ou équivalent grande école / Master en informatique)
  • Double expertise tech et consulting : tu sais coder, architecturer ET tu sais embarquer un COMEX, structurer une recommandation, conduire un atelier, naviguer dans les organisations complexes et porter des démarches de change management
  • Passion pour l'IA : tu testes les modèles, tu lis les papers, tu as déjà construit des choses avec Claude / Cursor / Claude Code, tu suis l'écosystème (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Mistral)

title: AI Engineer (LLM) - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to dexter health!!

At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients.

We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production

  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value

  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior

  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems

  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider

  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control

  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows

  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow

  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language

  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows

  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly

  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs

  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems

  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior

  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow

  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment

  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development

  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems

  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows

  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems

  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments

  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation

  • German language skills

  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role

  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills

  • You need detailed specifications before making progress

  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments

  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building

  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow

  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work

  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location

  • Ownership of important backend systems

title: AI Native Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.
As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.
Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.
We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!
The role:

Join us as a Product Engineer to build a new product within Brevo called Brevo OS.

Brevo OS is a startup inside Brevo: a team of six, a product we started from an empty repository earlier this year, and the feel of a small company within the big one. The product works, the first customer deployments are beginning, and a great deal is still undecided — so the people who join us now will shape what it becomes.
It's an AI-native operating system for small businesses: a system of agents that helps a solopreneur, a hair salon or a building contractor run their whole business — clients, contracts and signature, invoicing, their website, their inbox. Modules get added the way an ERP grows, except the whole thing is built around agents from the ground up.


Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Turn a very high level business need into something real : understand the function, define the users, the smallest useful version, the entities and their lifecycles, the permissions and constraints that matter, and what to build versus integrate
  • Decide which of our platform primitives to extend rather than reinvent, then build it, ship it, watch it in production, and improve it
  • Work across product management, frontend, backend, data modelling, infrastructure, and AI. Everyone arrived with a specialism and nobody is confined to theirs; product thinking and business analysis is part of everyone’s job
  • Build almost entirely through coding agents: Claude Code is the workflow, not a pilot running alongside it, for implementation, codebase exploration, documentation, debugging, and operations
  • Decompose problems into work an agent can actually execute, give it context without over-constraining it, and tell the difference between correct and merely plausible
  • Verify with tests and instrumentation, not vibes, and keep a large generated codebase coherent
  • Work day to day in TypeScript, Kubernetes, and agentic frameworks

    • Who you are:
  • Around 2-5 years of professional engineering experience. We care more about your slope than your years.
  • Real depth in something, and no attachment to staying there. Bring what you're genuinely strong at — the team compounds those — and expect to spend a good part of your time well outside it.
  • Coding agents already central to how you work. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, something equivalent. Not "I've generated the Unit Tests" — real delegation of substantial work, and real review of what comes back. Scepticism about generated output is a feature of this job, not a problem.
  • Evidence you've owned a problem, not just implemented a ticket — something you helped define, drove, shipped and then lived with in production. Product questions are your questions too.
  • At your best when the brief is one sentence and the plan is still moving. We're learning what this product is, so priorities change often. The mission doesn't.
  • English. We're an international team working across France and India, and English is our working language. French is not required.

  • A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighbourhood.
