L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

La practice AI Modernisation est l’offre prioritaire du Groupe et porte la vision de Theodo de devenir le leader européen de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel. Notre métier, c’est la migration accélérée par IA de vieux systèmes de legacy vers des langages et framework plus modernes pour réduire les risques business, cybersécurité, de compliance que ces systèmes peuvent présenter. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.

Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit.

Tes futures missions : En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs. Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement. Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :
  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in post-training methodologies, with a special focus on agentic behaviors and tool use. We expect you to have deep expertise in large language model architectures and substantial experience in post-training for agentic workflows, including tool use fine tuning, function calling, and reinforcement learning from feedback on multi turn interactions. You will adopt a hands-on, research driven approach to developing, testing, and implementing new post-training algorithms that unlock goal directed behavior, self correction, and reliable tool invocation.

Your responsibilities include curating agentic training data (e.g., trajectories of tool use, reasoning chains, environment interactions), strengthening baseline performance, and identifying as well as resolving bottlenecks in post-training for tool augmented agents to achieve SOTA model quality. The goal is to build models that do not just know but also act, use tools, and adapt, pushing the limits of what agentic AI can achieve.

  • Collaborate with tooling, product, and training teams to improve the usefulness, reliability, and agentic capabilities of frontier models.

  • Closely liaise with research, engineering and cross-functional teams to determine which integrations are production-ready for inclusion in major model releases.

title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
descriptionHtml:
Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.

Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex, real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? 

The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.

At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket.
We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

From learning to leading

Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.

You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.

As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.

Where you’ll make an impact

From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:

  • Consumer - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic. 
  • Logistics - Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more

Your superpowers

You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.

More specifically, you:

  • Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a quantitative field: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar
  • Have experience in high-performance environments: consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar
  • Show an entrepreneurial mindset: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked
  • Think like a builder: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions
  • You have already gained basic knowledge in PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel or alternative coding languages 
  • EU citizenship or valid EU working permit required.

Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.

Why Picnic?

  • Grow as we grow. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours
  • Work with other innovators. Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)
  • Kickstart your career. Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic

Picnic Perks 

🏆 Rewarding Impact from Day One

You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

🍎Learning & development 

Our Future Leaders Graduate Program - Business Analytics is designed to offer you a steep learning curve by taking business ownership and end-to-end responsibility early on. You’ll get to learn by doing, while mentored by our Picnic leaders that had a similar journey like you. Next to that, you’ll benefit from other opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already do in this program. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. 

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. 

 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. We subsidise your Deutschlandticket and with the Lease-a-Bike you can get to work sustainably and healthily. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ

Do I need a quantitative background? It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.

Does the program include rotations? No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.

In what language should I apply? English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)

What are the long-term opportunities after the program? This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. 

Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.

title: API Consultant (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:

title: Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an Applied AI Engineer in Berlin, you’ll build the production AI systems behind Resonance’s client engagements across DACH, driving a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier alongside Senior AI Engineers, owning features, integrations and evals end to end. You’ll build and ship agentic systems, from agents and MCP servers into client systems to retrieval and the product around them, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems and the interfaces people use. You’ll build evals and observability from day one, take features from first prototype to production, and deploy and extend what we build inside client environments, shipping at pace with the latest AI coding tools. You’ll grow with the firm by contributing to Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning what you learn on each build into reusable components, and taking on more ownership as you grow.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency and a bias for action, thrive on ambiguity, and are AI-obsessed, getting hands-on with new models and tools the day they hit the market. You typically have up to four years building software at a startup, a scale-up, a fast-moving product team or your own company. You write production Python or TypeScript, have shipped software with an LLM at its core, at work or on your own projects, and have iterated on prompts, agent loops and evals. You’re at home with messy real-world data, APIs and SQL, you ship fast without cutting corners, and you enjoy solving problems with technical and non-technical people. You have consistently been among the top performers in high-performing environments, at university or at work. Forward deployed experience, AI side projects or a company you founded are a plus, and so is German for client work in DACH.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Most engineers get one shot at a startup. Here you build many products, not one: our own AI products and platform, and several production AI systems a year across industries. You’ll learn fast alongside people who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, with scope that grows as fast as your impact. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm. As one of our first engineers in Berlin, you’ll shape how we build, operate and grow.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV, your GitHub profile and a short note on the AI system you're proudest of shipping and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Audit Methodology Lead
descriptionHtml:
We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What you'll own

  • Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform

  • Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against

  • Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one

  • Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review

  • Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix

  • Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements

  • Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes

  • Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product

  • Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ

  • Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it

What you'll bring

  • A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent

  • Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions

  • Recent experience across several clients and industries

  • Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work

  • Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail

  • Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write

  • Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion

Nice to have:

  • You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review

  • You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today

  • You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process

  • You stay with open-ended problems until the answer holds up

What this role is not

  • Not product management. You shape what ships, but you don't own the roadmap

  • Not implementation or customer success

  • Not volume work. AI produces the volume; you decide what's right

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Interview with an Audit Expert

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

title: Avionics Electronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

 

Role & Mission

Avionics Architecture & Hardware Design

  • Design, develop, and integrate avionics and electronic subsystems for high-performance unmanned aerial systems

  • Own schematic capture, PCB layout reviews, and component selection for flight-critical electronics, with a strong focus on size, weight, power, and cost

  • Define the electrical architecture, power distribution, and harnessing for compact, high-dynamic airframes

  • Select and integrate flight controllers, navigation sensors (IMU, GNSS, magnetometer, air data), data links, and onboard compute

  • Design for manufacturability and reliability, from early prototypes through to series production

Integration, Test & Validation

  • Lead bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and environmental testing of avionics subsystems

  • Integrate electronics into the airframe and support full system integration with the software and guidance teams

  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, power, signal integrity, and EMI/EMC issues

  • Support ground and flight test campaigns, analyse test data, and feed results back into rapid design iterations

Suppliers & Industrialisation

  • Work with component suppliers to secure quality, cost, and lead times

  • Manage component obsolescence, second-sourcing, and supply chain resilience for critical parts

  • Produce and maintain design documentation, BOMs, interface control documents, and test procedures

  • Support qualification activities against relevant aerospace and military standards

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Software, Guidance & Navigation, Mechanical, Product and Flight Test teams in short iteration loops

  • Contribute to design reviews, trade studies, and product roadmap decisions

  • Support field deployments and live demonstrations with customers when required

 

Requirements

Candidate profile

  • MSc or equivalent in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field

  • 3-8 years of experience in avionics, embedded hardware, or electronics design, ideally on UAS, aircraft, missiles, or other airborne systems

  • Hands-on experience taking boards from schematic to tested flight hardware

  • Solid understanding of power electronics, motor control, RF and data links, and sensor interfaces

  • Familiarity with autopilot ecosystems (PX4, ArduPilot, or proprietary) is a strong plus

Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on, lab-oriented mindset: at ease with an oscilloscope, a soldering iron, and a test bench

  • Rigorous, structured problem solver able to deliver under tight timelines

  • Able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, cost, and schedule

  • Clear technical communicator in documentation and design reviews

  • High integrity, discretion, and understanding of security culture

  • Fluent English; French is a plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a defense startup, neoprime, or fast-moving hardware environment

  • Knowledge of MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, DO-160, or equivalent standards

  • Embedded firmware experience (C/C++) on STM32 or similar microcontrollers

  • Experience integrating edge compute modules (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson) and high-bandwidth data links

  • Exposure to counter-UAS or air defense systems

  • Willingness to travel to test ranges and field sites

title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
descriptionHtml:
About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

  • Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

  • Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

  • Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

  • Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

  • Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

  • Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have:

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

  • Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

  • A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

  • Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

  • Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

  • Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

Bonus points:

  • Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack

  • Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud

  • Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

  • CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale

  • Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products

  • Python or Rust alongside Go

  • Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media

What makes this role exciting

  • Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

  • Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

  • Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

  • Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream?

We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

What we offer

  • Company equity

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

  • Pension plan with a company contribution

  • NS Business Card or a company bike, covered

  • Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year

  • Catered lunches in the office

  • MacBook Pro

  • Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice

  • Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam

This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Our culture

Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now.

We hire on skills and experience, and we don't discriminate based on age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, political opinion, disability or chronic illness, marital status, working hours, type of contract, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an adjustment at any point in our hiring process, let us know.

Our first airborne battery pack technology partnership, a first commercial collaboration for defence applications, is an important step we have already accomplished.

As Business Development Manager - Dual Use (all genders), you will drive both areas. You will lead Microliner aircraft sales with passenger and cargo operators, lessors and airlines. You will also build our dual-use battery business by winning technology partnerships with aerospace and defence manufacturers and shaping the commercial models behind them. You will work closely with the Chief Business Officer, the Commercial and Marketing Team and our engineers.

title: Business Intelligence Data Architect
descriptionHtml:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Data Architect to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack.

In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making.

If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing:

  • Lead analytical architecture and governance: Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews.
  • Build governed data models and semantic layers: Design and implement reusable business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics that support consistent reporting, self-service analytics, applications, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Establish analytics engineering best practices: Set standards for dbt development, testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, deployment reliability, model performance, and observability to improve scalability and maintainability.
  • Enable secure, reliable data access: Design governed access patterns for applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data, including role-based access control (RBAC), APIs, service layers, and query optimization.
  • Partner across the business: Work closely with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions.
  • Mentor and enable the team: Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices.
  • Drive platform evolution: Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You

  • 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including at least 3 years in an architect capacity with direct ownership of an analytical platform.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization.
  • Expert-level experience with dbt, including staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental models, testing, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, with the ability to select and justify approaches based on business and analytical needs.
  • Proven experience designing and deploying production semantic layers and governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based integrations.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python, along with familiarity with dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Git, CI/CD, and cloud-native analytics environments.
  • Experience designing secure data access patterns for applications consuming Snowflake data, including APIs, service layers, RBAC, query performance, and governed semantic access.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions to technical teams, executive leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and India.
  • Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certification; dbt Certified Data Architect or Analytics Engineer certification.
  • Experience with Snowflake Cortex and Snowpark ML for in-warehouse AI/ML workloads.
  • Experience working with Salesforce as a source system, including dimensional modeling for go-to-market (GTM) data.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures that connect large language models to governed analytical data.
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
  • Experience implementing data governance frameworks, including data catalogs, column-level lineage, and row-level security.
  • You value a fun, collaborative, and innovative culture!

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. 

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

title: Business Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Engineer C2

Team: Product & Tech Business Operations

Salary: £45,600 - £57,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Business Operations

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work inthe UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

You'll own and evolve the technical systems that power P&T Business Operations — Jira architectures, data pipelines, dashboards, and integrations with enterprise platforms. You identify where operational capability could be stronger, scope those opportunities, and design and build solutions in collaboration with the Business Operations Manager. You approach problems with an AI-first mindset and make technical decisions with clarity about trade-offs.

  • Own and evolve the standardisation of Jira and other Kaluza data systems. Configure, extend, and redesign them to support increasingly complex business operations.

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and dashboards that turn raw operations data into clear signals for decision-making. Explore where AI agents and autonomous systems can streamline operations.

  • Identify opportunities for new capabilities (better delivery planning data & tooling capabilities, improved management insights solutions, plugging into adjacent Kaluza products) and design and build solutions, aligned with the direction from the business operations manager who will lead the product & delivery enablement side of things

  • Connect and integrate internal products and platforms — Workday integrations, locally-built internal tools, and other solutions. Make recommendations on what to build, integrate, or take over — clearly articulating trade-offs, impact, and delivery path.

  • Anticipate security, compliance, and regulatory constraints upfront. Navigate Kaluza's systems to unblock delivery quickly.

  • Spot when something's off — in the data, in a process, or in a tool — and fix it before it becomes someone else's problem.

  • Iterate on our operational tooling continuously, testing new approaches early and sharing what you learn openly with the team.


What you'll bring

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • 3–5 years building and maintaining operational tooling — not just writing code, but owning what you ship.

  • Strong Jira expertise (including JQL) and Confluence; comfortable configuring them for complex portfolio structures.

  • Experience with APIs/integrations and data exchange, SQL + basic scripting, BI tools, AI tools and automation.

  • Experience building data pipelines or automated workflows with practical understanding of keeping them reliable at scale.

  • Confident in identifying improvements and implementing them independently. You break down ambiguous problems, scope solutions, and drive delivery without constant prompting. You don't wait to be told what's next.

  • Comfortable with data analysis, ambiguity, and working in scaling organisations where processes and systems need to grow as fast as the people using them.

  • You navigate Kaluza's systems to move fast. You share progress openly and communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.

What will set you apart:

  • You're the kind of person who spots a constraint, maps it back to its root cause, and builds a fix (or identifies where a temporary workaround is needed, whilst you work on a fix). You set a high bar for your own work and raise it over time, and you're not satisfied leaving a system in a worse state than you found it.

  • You work openly by default: you share progress, flag blockers early, and communicate what's working and what isn't without waiting to be asked. People across the organisation find it easy to understand what you're doing and why.

  • You're genuinely curious about new tools and approaches — especially AI — and you actively bring others along by sharing what you've tried, what landed, and what didn't. Learning in the open comes naturally to you.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Category Management Werkstudent (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Als Online-Supermarkt ist das Herzstück unseres Businesses natürlich die Picnic App. Das Category Management Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere digitalen Regale perfekt mit den besten lokalen und internationalen Produkten ausgestattet sind – und das immer frisch und zu den besten Preisen.

Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Category Managern sowie cross-funktionalen Teams (wie Supply Chain und Marketing) zusammen, pflegst wichtige Stammdaten und hilfst dabei, dass unsere App für die KundInnen immer perfekt gepflegt ist. Das erwartet dich

  • App & Content Pflege: Du bist mitverantwortlich für den In-App Content deiner Produktkategorien. Du sorgst dafür, dass Artikelbeschreibungen, Bilder und Promotions immer up-to-date sind und unseren KundInnen ein Lächeln ins Gesicht zaubern.
  • Daten & Analysen: Du wertest Verkaufszahlen, Kundenfeedback und Markttrends aus, erkennst Muster und hilfst dem Team dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zur Sortimentsoptimierung zu treffen.
  • Lieferanten- & Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Du unterstützt bei der Vor- und Nachbereitung von Lieferantengesprächen und arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit Teams wie Supply Chain und Customer Success zusammen.

Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.

title: Cdi - Responsable Chef De Produit Chaine Et Trame Femme (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. department: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
descriptionHtml:
Présentation département

L’Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon (INL) a pour vocation de développer des recherches technologiques multidisciplinaires dans le domaine des micro et nanotechnologies et de leurs applications. Les recherches menées s’étendent des matériaux aux systèmes. Le laboratoire s’appuie sur la plate-forme technologique lyonnaise Nanolyon.

Les domaines d’application couvrent de grands secteurs économiques : l’industrie des semiconducteurs, les technologies de l’information, les technologies du vivant et de la santé, l’énergie et l’environnement.

Le laboratoire est multi sites avec des localisations sur les campus d’Ecully et de Lyon-Tech La Doua. Il regroupe environ 240 personnes dont 120 personnels permanents. L’INL est un acteur majeur du Pôle de Recherche et d’Enseignement.

Ce poste se situe dans un environnement innovant, à la pointe des technologies du futur, dans des secteurs stratégiques applicatifs.

Le poste se situe dans un secteur relevant de la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique (PPST), et nécessite donc, conformément à la réglementation, que votre arrivée soit autorisée par l'autorité compétente du MESR

Présentation de la ou les thématiques :

Le programme PHOENIX est un projet national d’envergure (17 M€, 5 ans) financé par France 2030 et visant à structurer un hub français pour la conception de circuits intégrés, incluant les chiplets et les méthodes d’EDA enrichies par l’IA. Il implique plusieurs laboratoires du CNRS (INL, TIMA, IRISA, IETR, LIP6, LIRMM, LAMIH, IMS, Lab Hubert Curien, Lab-STICC…), le CEA-LIST, ainsi que de nombreux partenaires académiques et industriels.

Dans ce cadre, nous recrutons un(e) ingénieur(e) informatique / EDA chargé(e) de la qualification des outils, modèles et blocs IP utilisés et développés au sein de PHOENIX, en interaction étroite avec les équipes de recherche, les doctorants et les partenaires industriels.

Description de la ou les missions / les activités

- Mettre en place, maintenir et faire évoluer l’environnement logiciel de conception (flow EDA) pour les partenaires du consortium PHOENIX (CAO, simulation, caractérisation, PDK, IP).
- Qualifier les outils EDA (commercials et open source), modèles de dispositifs et blocs IP : définition de bancs de tests, métriques de performance, protocoles d’évaluation et rapports de validation.
- Participer à l’intégration et à l’évaluation de méthodes d’EDA augmentées par l’IA (optimisation de flows, génération de modèles, analyse automatique de résultats, etc.).
- Assurer le support technique auprès des équipes (installation, configuration, troubleshooting, interface avec les fournisseurs d’outils et les équipes IT locales).
- Contribuer à la rédaction de livrables techniques du projet : documents de spécification, rapports de qualification, guides d’utilisation des outils et IP.

title: Clinical AI Research Lead
descriptionHtml:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi is building AI that works at the frontier of clinical practice. As we pursue medical device registration and expand our clinical trial portfolio and product portfolio, we need someone who can hold the full arc from regulatory strategy to research protocol to working prototypes and translate across all of them.

This role is designed for a rare profile: clinically trained, technically capable, and research-rigorous. You will own the innovation pipeline from problem identification through validated prototype, coordinate the company's clinical research programme, and serve as the internal bridge between product, regulation, and evidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with a small specialist team and broad cross-functional mandate.

 

What you’ll do

Research & Evidence Programme

  • Lead and support clinical trials and pilots adjacent to product development and regulation from protocol through analysis and dissemination

  • Design evaluations with research/publication-grade rigour: statistical power, confounder control, reproducible methodology

  • Provide analytical support company-wide - elevating ad hoc analysis to defensible evidence

Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence

  • Translate evolving UK and international medical device regulation into actionable product and development constraints

  • Generate and maintain technical documentation, clinical evaluation reports, and post-market surveillance artefacts - directly analytically supporting the regulatory team.

  • Partner with compliance to ensure regulatory soundness is built in, not bolted on, a strategic moat, not a checklist

  • Serve as the accessible regulatory resource for product, engineering, models and commercial teams: making regulation legible, usable and deeply embedded into all engineering practices.

  • This role is strategic support, and ownership of all product and regulatory adjacent research activities with a strong supporting team to drive progress and delivery.

Cross-functional AI & Research Support

  • Act as a senior research partner to product squads, commercial teams, and leadership, providing evidence, framing decisions, and raising analytical standards

  • Supporting commercial requests with tender applications etc…

 

What you'll need

Clinical

  • Qualified clinician with active understanding of clinical workflow, risk, and patient safety

  • Experience in medical device or clinical AI evaluation, including familiarity with MHRA, UKCA, and/or EU MDR frameworks

Research

  • Postgraduate research training in a relevant field (clinical informatics, AI/ML, health data science, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ability to design, execute, and disseminate clinical or applied research independently

  • Fluency in quantitative methods: statistical modelling, NLP evaluation, speech analytics, and performance benchmarking

  • Skills in implementation science and translational projects involving new technologies

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong written communication, capable of producing high-quality documentation for clinical, regulatory, and commercial audiences

  • Collaborative operator in a fast-moving environment; able to work across seniority levels and functions

  • Experience managing small teams or contractors; structured, outcome-oriented

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

title: Cloud Engineer (All genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our cloud engineering team builds and maintains the foundational infrastructure supporting next-generation defence technology. We collaborate closely with software, autonomy, and security engineers to deliver high-availability systems across air, land, and sea domains. We foster an agile, fast-paced environment where IaC, automation, and operational excellence drive our core engineering practices.

YOUR MISSION

As a Cloud Engineer (All genders), you will focus on transforming service requests into production-ready, scalable environments. By utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), you ensure every deployment is executed with precision, security, and thorough documentation. Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of our embedded autonomy infrastructure deployed across air, land, and sea systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Act as the primary contact for infrastructure service requests.
  • Build and maintain Terraform modules to ensure consistent state management and streamlined deployments.

  • Monitor cloud provider activities to ensure cost-efficiency and compliance with security standards.
  • Produce detailed "How-to" guides for new services to enable developer self-service.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 2 to 4 years of professional Cloud Engineering experience.
  • Strong practical knowledge of GCP is preferred; AWS or Azure experts willing to transition are welcome.
  • Advanced proficiency in Terraform.

title: Commercial Account Executive, Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product,  the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.  

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. 

About the role

We are hiring for our second Commercial Account Executive to help grow the Commercial business across the Netherlands.

You will help grow the Commercial business in your market by building strong relationships, creating new logo momentum, and working closely with partners and the wider team to expand Horizon3’s reach.

We are looking for experienced sellers who enjoy building. They should be proactive, thoughtful, and comfortable helping markets develop. They should carry the story well, build trust with customers and partners, and help turn ambition into market presence, new logo growth, and long-term opportunity.

How we work

Our Commercial team comes together in the Amsterdam hub to collaborate, learn from each other, and build community around the Commercial business.

At the same time, we work for and in our local markets. That means staying close to customers, partners, and market activity. Travel in-region is part of the role.

In each market, the Commercial seller, Enterprise seller, Partner Manager, Sales Engineer, and Commercial leader may report into different leaders, but they share collective responsibility for helping the market work well and for making Horizon3 successful in the region.

What you will do

  • Grow the Commercial business in your assigned markets through strong customer engagement, partner collaboration, and good market execution

  • Create new logo momentum and build pipeline in a way that fits the local market

  • Build and manage opportunities with good judgement, clear ownership, and strong follow-through

  • Work closely with partners, distributors, MSSPs, Enterprise sellers, Partner Managers, and Sales Engineers to help the market work well

  • Contribute to partner and territory plans and help turn those plans into action

  • Work across Marketing, Channel, Sales Engineering, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, and leadership to move business forward

  • Bring useful market feedback back into the business

  • Represent Horizon3 well with customers and partners

  • Keep building your capability, product knowledge, and commercial effectiveness over time

What success looks like

Success in this role is about helping the market grow and contributing to a strong Commercial motion in-region.

You will be successful if you:

  • Create new logo momentum and help grow the Commercial segment in your markets

  • Build strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal teams

  • Manage opportunities well and help move business forward with consistency and ownership

  • Become productive quickly and continue to grow in impact over time

  • Bring useful market insight back into the business

What we are looking for

We are looking for experienced Commercial sellers who are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and helping build markets.

Strong candidates will bring:

  • More than 4 years of closing experience in IT or cybersecurity sales

  • Experience in Commercial or mid-market sales, ideally in more than one market or in a regionally complex environment

  • Confidence working with partners, distributors, MSSPs, and cross-functional teams

  • Good commercial judgement and the ability to navigate opportunities with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders

  • Strong ownership, follow-through, and comfort with visibility and accountability

  • Curiosity, coachability, and a desire to keep learning and improving

  • Comfort working in a scaling business where structure is still being built

  • Fluency in Dutch, plus strong English

  • A proactive, builder mindset: someone with a point of view who stays close to the market, works well with customers, partners, and the wider team, and looks for better ways to increase reach, efficiency, and impact

Why this role matters

This is a chance to help shape how Commercial grows across EMEA.

If you want a role where you can help build markets, work closely with partners and customers, and play a meaningful part in how a new category develops in-region, this is that role.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid Work: We a hybrid work model in Amsterdam and require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
descriptionHtml:
Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant

Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite.

Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission.

  • Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance.

  • Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée.

  • Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses.

  • Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation.

  • Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être.

Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience :

  • Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes.

  • Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission.

Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons

Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté.

Ce que nous cherchons

  • Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes.

  • Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas.

  • La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise.

  • De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole.

  • Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients.

  • Maîtrise parfaite du français ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier.

Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps

  • Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris.

  • Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe.

  • Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client.

Ce que vous trouverez chez nous

  • Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME.

  • Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année.

  • Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet.

  • Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux.

Comment nous recrutons

Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape.

  • 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions.

  • 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter.

  • 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés.

Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape.


Candidature

Envoyez votre CV et, à la place de la lettre de motivation, une note d'une page qui répond à cette question : que devient le métier de consultant quand le client a accès à la même IA que nous ? Dites-nous sur quoi vous êtes d'accord avec notre approche, sur quoi vous ne l'êtes pas, et ce que vous apporteriez au cabinet. Appuyez-vous sur au moins une situation que vous avez vécue. Avec ou sans IA, peu importe : ce qui compte, c'est votre avis.

Wir definieren, entwickeln, betreiben und erweitern sie, alles im Haus und alles in der Schweiz, mit rund 50 Leuten in Zürich und Bern. novu gehört zur Union Group AG, einer Gruppe von Schweizer Agenturen für digitale Kommunikation.

Damit Software zum Geschäft unserer Kunden passt, muss jemand ihre Ziele verstehen, die richtigen Fragen stellen und Entscheidungen voranbringen. Das ist deine Rolle:
Als Consultant berätst du Entscheidungsträgerinnen und Entscheidungsträger, von Marketingverantwortlichen bis zur Geschäftsleitung. Du verbindest Geschäftsverständnis mit technischem Know-how und führst anspruchsvolle Software- und Digitalprojekte zum Ziel. Dabei bist du die verlässliche Ansprechperson deiner Kunden, vom ersten Gespräch bis in den Betrieb. Arbeiten kannst du wahlweise von Zürich oder Bern aus.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du berätst Marketingverantwortliche, Fachverantwortliche und Geschäftsleitungen zu ihren digitalen Vorhaben. Du machst technische Möglichkeiten verständlich, zeigst Handlungsoptionen auf und schaffst fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen.

  • Du leitest mehrere Software- und Digitalprojekte parallel, von der Offerte bis zum Go-live. Dabei verantwortest du Umfang, Termine, Budget und Qualität und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden, Entwicklung, Design und Operations.
