  • Du prüfst gemeinsam mit Kunden und Team, wo AI und Automatisierung einen konkreten Mehrwert schaffen. Ideen machst du bei Bedarf mit einfachen Prototypen greifbar.

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als IT-Projektleiterin oder IT-Projektleiter in anspruchsvollen Software- oder Digitalprojekten, idealerweise im Agentur- oder Dienstleistungsumfeld. Du hast Projekte mit technischer Komplexität und anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern erfolgreich geführt.

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Entscheidungsträgerinnen und Entscheidungsträgern. Du kannst geschäftliche Anforderungen einordnen, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln und Empfehlungen überzeugend vertreten.

  • Ein professionelles, verbindliches Auftreten und Freude am persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, bereitest Gespräche sorgfältig vor und hältst Zusagen ein. So baust du Vertrauen und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.

title: Consulting Manager (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Who/What is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Consulting Manager (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will act as a trusted sparring partner to executives, steer complex transformation programs across functions, and drive organizational change at scale.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead AI Transformation Programs: Steer end-to-end execution of enterprise-level AI transformations. Identify internal champions, navigate corporate politics, manage structural blockers, and drive measurable user adoption and organizational change. 
  • Strategy & AI Use Case Scoping: Work closely with C-level stakeholders to answer high-stakes questions: How can AI reshape their business models? How should they govern data? You don't just advise; you help evaluate model choices, discuss data privacy trade-offs, and conceptualize technical feasibility.
  • Drive Business Growth: Actively drive the growth of our German practice. Take ownership in lead generation and pipeline conversion by engaging prospective clients, shaping proposals, and leading pre-sales and key-account expansion initiatives.
  • Thought Leadership & Advocacy: Represent Artefact's AI Transformation perspective externally. Advance our voice in enterprise AI through expert discussions, content creation (e.g. LinkedIn, whitepapers), and opinionated, hands-on perspectives on applied AI trends and real-world adoption pathways.
  • Advance the Practice: Evolve our methodologies, tools, and frameworks to keep our offering state-of-the-art. Develop reusable transformation playbooks and bring your strategic consulting or technology expertise into the team.
  • Team Leadership & Mentoring: Act as a senior advisor and role model - leading, coaching, and mentoring agile, hybrid project teams (consultants, data scientists, and engineers), fostering a fast-paced, “can-do” culture.

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. You are a true team player, eager to support others while scaling both the company and your own career.

  • Work Experience: You have approximately 5–8 years of full-time working experience in top-tier management consulting, technology consulting, or strategic corporate in-house roles. A proven track record of successfully leading and delivering data, analytics, or AI-driven transformation projects is essential.
  • Transformation & Change Management: Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs, with the ability to manage executive stakeholders, navigate corporate politics, and embed AI capabilities within client organizations.
  • AI Fluency & "Builder Mindset": Strong fluency in modern and applied AI (e.g., GenAI, LLMs, agentic systems, automated workflows). While you don't need to be a full-time programmer, you have a hands-on understanding and can credibly demo working AI concepts and discuss data privacy and technical constraints.
  • Analytical & Technical Acumen: Knowledge about common machine learning techniques, cloud architectures, and data management principles. Excellent quantitative skills to draw strategic insights from complex data sets.
  • Communication & Presence: Outstanding communication, presentation, and moderation skills. You have a strong presence and can translate complex technical topics into compelling arguments for non-technical senior executives, as well as bridge the gap to technical execution teams.
  • Education: Excellent academic track record with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.
  • Languages: Business-fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory to successfully advise our German clients and lead workshops. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

Why Join Us?

  • Strategy with a Data Edge: Artefact sits uniquely at the crossroads of top-tier business strategy and deep tech. You will build boardroom-level strategy expertise while staying at the absolute forefront of AI, data management, and digital value creation.
  • Impact & Entrepreneurial Freedom: As part of a fast-growing team in Germany, you will have high visibility from day one. You will directly help shape Artefact's footprint in the region, bringing in your own ideas and driving business growth.
  • Continuous Learning: Constant exposure to new AI solutions at the intersection of technology and business. Access to regular training in both strategy consulting methodologies and the latest AI/data capabilities through our global network.
  • Culture of Doers: We combine a high degree of self-assurance with a supportive, collaborative environment. We are entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and committed to delivering real impact - while strongly supporting each other's personal growth.

This position is based in Berlin or Munich.

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!

title: Content Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Remote-first · Teilzeit (30 Std./Woche) oder Vollzeit

Über snipKI

Unsere Mission: Wir befähigen Unternehmen, KI strategisch richtig anzugehen, Teams mit den nötigen Skills und dem richtigen Mindset auszustatten und Projekte erfolgreich in die Praxis umzusetzen.

snipKI sorgt dafür, dass KI bei den Menschen ankommt – dass sie positiv angenommen und produktiv und sicher in den Arbeitsalltag integriert wird. Dafür setzen wir auf KI-Enablement und befähigen Mitarbeitende in Mittelstand und Enterprise, KI wirklich zu nutzen. Was uns unterscheidet: Unsere Formate sind brandaktuell und maßgeschneidert – nicht nur auf Unternehmens-, sondern auf Personenebene.

Unser Ziel: Wir wollen DIE KI-Marke im DACH-Raum werden – wenn Menschen an KI denken, sollen sie an snipKI denken. Das braucht Vertrauen und starken Content. Genau deshalb wollen wir zu einer echten Content- und Medienmarke im KI-Bereich werden. Wir wachsen schnell und arbeiten remote-first.

Wie wir arbeiten

KI ist bei uns kein Werkzeug, das wir für einzelne Aufgaben aufrufen, sondern die Ebene, auf der wir arbeiten. Postfach, Kalender, Ablage und unsere Projekt- und Wissenssysteme hängen über Konnektoren an unseren KI-Systemen, Wiederkehrendes läuft als Automation, und jede:r im Team baut sich die eigenen Skills und Agenten dafür selbst.

Dazu kommt das Tempo unseres Themas. Was in der KI-Welt heute passiert, ist in zwei Wochen kalt. Unser Content entsteht in Tagen, nicht in Quartalsplänen.

Deine Mission

Als Content Lead verantwortest du unseren gesamten Content, strategisch und vor allem hands-on. Strategisch heißt: Du entscheidest, welche Kanäle wir aufbauen und welche nicht, und baust sie dann auch. Hands-on heißt: Du produzierst selbst.

Das ist bewusst keine Rolle mit einem Menschen-Team unter dir: Du führst ein Team aus Agenten und Automationen, das du selbst aufbaust. Die Ideen kommen aus dem ganzen Team, du entscheidest, welcher Inhalt auf welchen Kanal gehört, produzierst ihn und sorgst dafür, dass alles aus einem Guss ist. Du hast den vollen Überblick über unseren Content und machst snipKI als Marke sichtbar.

Aufgaben

Diese Kanäle baust du aus, und die nächsten baust du auf

  • Newsletter

  • Die LinkedIn-Profile unserer Gründer und unseres Teams

  • Den LinkedIn-Unternehmensaccount

  • Unseren neuen Podcast (im Aufbau)

  • Unseren YouTube-Kanal

  • Unsere Website (Testimonials, Case Studies) und weitere Social-Kanäle

  • Und weitere Experimente mit neuen Kanälen

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entscheidest, auf welchen Kanälen wir wachsen: Du übersetzt Themen in einen kanalübergreifenden Plan, gibst jedem Kanal eine eigene Rolle statt überall dasselbe zu posten, und du sagst uns auch, welchen Kanal wir sein lassen sollten.

  • Du produzierst hands-on: Du schreibst stark, erstellst Bilder und schneidest Videos. Den Großteil davon erstellst du KI-gestützt, aber du bist immer der human-in-the-loop und prüfst alles selbst.

  • Du veröffentlichst und steuerst den Redaktionsplan: was wann wo erscheint.

  • Du baust dir die Produktionsstrecke selbst: Agenten, Skills und Automationen, die Recherche, Rohentwürfe, Varianten pro Kanal und Wiederverwertung übernehmen.

  • Du baust unseren LinkedIn-Unternehmensaccount aus und entwickelst die persönlichen Profile von Gründern und Team weiter – und dein eigenes natürlich.

  • Du sorgst für Markenkonsistenz und Premium-Qualität über alle Kanäle hinweg.

  • Du recycelst Inhalte und spinnst sie weiter (z. B. einzelne Content-Pieces aus unseren Studien-Daten) und holst Kunden-Testimonials & Case Studies ein – für Website und Social.

  • Du baust unsere neuen Formate mit auf: Podcast, YouTube & Co.

  • Du hältst unseren Content-Stack auf Stand: Du probierst neue Modelle und Systeme aus, wirfst raus, was nicht mehr das Beste ist, und gibst dein Wissen ins Team zurück.

Qualifikation

So arbeitest du mit KI

  • KI ist dein Haupt-Arbeitsmodus, nicht dein Hilfsmittel: Du arbeitest den Großteil deines Tages in KI-Systemen, nicht daneben.

  • Du hast deine Arbeitsumgebung selbst angebunden: Mail, Kalender, Ablage, Projekt- oder Wissenstool hängen über Konnektoren an deinem KI-System.

  • Du baust dir eigene Bausteine statt jedes Mal neu zu prompten: Projekte und Skills. Und du automatisierst Wiederkehrendes.

  • Du hast schon mal etwas gebaut, das du eigentlich nicht bauen kannst: ein kleines Tool, eine Seite, per Vibe Coding zusammengesetzt.

Kein Muss sind n8n, Make oder Programmieren. Wenn du das mitbringst, umso besser. Wenn nicht, reicht die Bereitschaft, dir Automationen selbst zusammenzubauen.

So machst du Content

  • Du hast mindestens einen Kanal selbst von null aufgebaut, ein LinkedIn-Profil, einen Newsletter, einen Podcast oder einen YouTube-Kanal, und kannst sagen, was der Hebel war.

  • Du denkst in Kanal-Logiken statt in Content-Stücken: Dasselbe Thema braucht auf LinkedIn, im Podcast und auf YouTube eine andere Form.

  • Du wählst Themen nach Relevanz und Positionierung, nicht nach Suchvolumen. Vieles, was wir spielen, ist so neu, dass noch niemand danach sucht.

  • Du arbeitest im Takt des Themas: Ein KI-Thema ist nach zwei Wochen kalt.

Und das bringst du außerdem mit

  • Du hast ein hervorragendes Gespür für Sprache und Kommunikation und schreibst exzellent auf Deutsch.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, greifst Ideen auf und spinnst sie eigenständig weiter.

  • Du bist schnell, pragmatisch und lieferst – auch ohne dass alles bis ins Detail vorgegeben ist.

Nice to have

  • Automatisierung mit n8n, Make oder Zapier, oder eigene kleine Tools.

  • Visuelles und redaktionelles Storytelling, Fotografie, Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Ein Gründer- bzw. Macher-Mindset.

Was dich erwartet

  • Volle Ownership: Du entscheidest über Kanäle, Themen und Produktion, nicht über eine Freigabekette hinweg.

  • Die Chance, snipKI von Grund auf als Content- und Medienmarke mitaufzubauen.

  • Arbeiten an der vordersten Front der KI: Budget für die Systeme, die du brauchst, und keine Freigabeschleife, um ein neues Modell auszuprobieren.

  • Ein ambitioniertes, nahbares Team, das genauso arbeitet wie du, und kurze Wege.

  • Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten; Teilzeit (20–30 Std.) oder Vollzeit möglich.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – zeig uns am besten direkt ein paar Beispiele deiner Arbeit (Content, Profile, Videos, Bilder).

Und beschreib uns deinen KI-Setup. Ein paar Sätze, ein Screenshot oder ein kurzes Video reichen: Mit welchen KI-Systemen arbeitest du, was hast du angebunden, welche eigenen Skills, Projekte oder Automationen hast du gebaut, und was davon hat dir letzte Woche konkret Arbeit abgenommen.

title: Content Strategist
descriptionHtml:
About Payrails


Payrails is a global payment software company helping leading enterprises to take control of their payment operations and maximize performance. With deep experience in the payments space and firsthand knowledge of merchants' challenges, we’ve seen how fragmented, complex, and inefficient these systems can become. Now, we are setting a new industry standard for how enterprises around the world manage and optimize payments, with more control, visibility and flexibility than ever before.

Our vision is to reimagine payments from the ground up. We are building a deeply integrated meta layer that spans the entire payment lifecycle with a modular architecture. This helps us give leading brands building blocks to craft solutions to most complex operational challenges, tailor seamless customer experiences and grow their business.

We are backed by some of the world’s top investors including Andreessen Horowitz, HV Capital, EQT Ventures and General Catalyst, who share our mission to simplify payment complexity globally.

At Payrails, we’re committed to building a team of exceptional people - not just talented, but driven to build, solve, and deliver at the highest level. Excellence isn’t just a value here; it’s a way of working. We believe that great people thrive in environments where there’s trust, clarity, and shared purpose. We work openly and collaboratively, with deep respect for each other’s craft. Everyone is encouraged to understand the bigger picture - what we’re building, why it matters, and what stands in the way. When people have that context, they move faster, take ownership, and make better decisions. We care about creating a culture where people feel inspired to do their best work and a deep sense of responsibility to help us bring our vision to life. Success at Payrails means staying focused on the problems that matter most, and executing with purpose.

Your team


At Payrails, Marketing is a creative and strategic engine that shapes how the world experiences our product. Sitting at the intersection of storytelling, product, and go-to-market, our mission is to make Payrails instinctively understood, relevant, and trusted by modern enterprises around the globe.

 

We focus on three core pillars:

  • Deeply understanding our customers and their evolving challenges - by continuously listening, researching, and engaging across markets and segments

  • Crafting sharp, differentiated narratives - built on clarity, insight, and a strong editorial and visual voice

  • Driving scalable growth through rapid experimentation - testing and iterating across content, channels, and experiences to unlock what moves the needle

Marketing at Payrails operates with a fast pace and precision. We move quickly, value thoughtful execution, and aim for lasting impact over short-term noise. We’re ambitious about quality - from the way we tell our story, to how we measure results, to the brand experience we deliver at every touchpoint.

 

You’ll be joining a team of hands-on builders who blend creativity with analytical rigor, and who take full ownership of their craft. If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape how an emerging category is defined and want to experiment, learn, and scale what works, you will thrive here.

 

How you will make an impact


  • Shape the strategy behind what we publish, why it matters, and how it aligns with our voice, product, and customers

  • Raise the bar for quality ensuring every piece we ship reflects our standards for clarity, precision, and usefulness

  • Work across teams (Product, Marketing, Sales) to plan content that supports launches, explains our value, and builds trust

  • Build and maintain content guidelines and systems that help us scale without losing consistency or craft

  • Help define how Payrails shows up in the market - not just through what we say, but how well we say it

 

What we are looking for


  • You bring 5+ years of experience planning and creating content in fast-growing tech or SaaS companies - with a strong track record of shaping narratives, developing brand voice, and building high-quality editorial systems that drive meaningful business results

  • You’re an excellent writer and editor, not just fluent in language, but obsessed with clarity, tone, and structure

  • You approach content like a strategist always asking what purpose it serves, who it’s for, and how it connects to business goals

  • You’re fluent with AI tools such as LLMs and AI writing and research assistants, and you use them every day to research faster, explore angles and scale production. You use AI to speed up the work, but you still apply your own judgment, fact-check, and edit so that everything we publish meets our standards for accuracy, voice and quality

  • You take pride in the craft. Whether it’s a landing page, case study, or blog post, you aim to make it the best version of what it could be

  • You’re comfortable collaborating across functions and gathering input without losing focus or momentum

What we offer

descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking an enterprising, dynamic and highly self-sufficient Counsel, International to join our fast-paced International Legal team.

In this role, you will be a key player supporting our European footprint with a primary focus on Germany, while also driving expansion into new European markets through our international launch function. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce, you will tackle novel legal questions, bring clarity to complex regulatory frameworks, and partner closely with business leaders to build compliant, high-growth healthcare experiences across Europe.

You will be a central operational driver for our German and pan-European commercial, telehealth, and pharmacy strategy.

You Will:

  • Support German Operations: Serve as a key legal advisor on day-to-day matters across Germany advising on healthcare and pharmacy regulations, e-commerce compliance, digital health, and marketing.

  • First-Principles Problem Solving: Untangle complex, novel, or undefined regulatory challenges where traditional precedents don't exist. You will help build legal frameworks using first principles rather than off-the-shelf templates.

  • Deliver Actionable, Concise Advice: Cut through ambiguity and synthesise complex legal risks into clear, commercially pragmatic guidance. Your advice will be direct, risk-calibrated, and focused on business value.

  • Navigate Pharmacy & Healthcare Regs: Advise cross-functional teams on German, Dutch, and cross-European pharmacy regulations, telemedicine rules, prescribing workflows, healthcare compliance and privacy. Particular focus on Germany’s AMG and HWG.

  • Commercial Risk & Disputes: Mitigate commercial risk, negotiate key partner/vendor agreements, and assist with advertising and competition matters (including Germany’s unfair competition / UWG litigation environment).

title: Creative Strategist (Freelance)
descriptionHtml:
Ce qu'on fait chez Ops Clean 🧪

Ici, on est en guerre contre une industrie opaque qui balance des produits toxiques dans les foyers depuis des décennies. Notre mission : rendre l'entretien de la maison sain, transparent et désirable. Et ça marche — on est passés de 0 à une marque DTC qui cartonne en passant de 0€ à 1M€ de CA en 2 ans.

Mais on ne veut pas juste vendre des sachets de lessive. On veut dominer la conversation sur la santé domestique. Et pour ça, on a besoin d'un cerveau créatif qui pense performance autant qu'organique.

On ne cherche pas quelqu'un qui exécute. On cherche un partenaire créatif qui comprend que chaque scroll est une bataille, que chaque hook a 3 secondes pour gagner, et que chaque euro dépensé en ads doit revenir multiplié.

Vos missions

Ce qu'on attend de toi 🫵

En tant que Creative Strategist, tu seras le lien entre notre expertise produit (santé, éco, transparence) et l'attention de millions de personnes sur TikTok, Reels et Meta Ads.

Stratégie créative organique : Concevoir des formats récurrents à haut potentiel viral — séries "debunk" de produits toxiques, vulgarisation clivante, tests en situation réelle. Tu penses en séries, pas en posts isolés.

Stratégie créative ads : Scruter nos comptes Meta/TikTok Ads, analyser ce qui performe, et proposer des recommandations créatives structurées et actionnables. Identifier les pépites organiques et les transformer en ads. Créer des itérations (variantes de hooks, CTA, angles) pour scaler nos campagnes.

Scripting & copywriting : Rédiger des scripts et briefs calibrés pour la performance — hooks puissants, structure narrative fluide, chaque mot compte. Tu briefes nos créateurs de contenu et nos monteurs jusqu'à la moindre virgule.

Supervision de production : Tu ne montes pas toi-même, mais tu diriges. Tu supervises les créateurs UGC et les monteurs pour garantir que le rendu final respecte ta vision stratégique et les codes natifs des plateformes.

Analyse & itération : L'idée de passer des heures dans les Business Managers Meta/TikTok pour comprendre comment créer LA prochaine créa banger doit te faire kiffer. Tu suis les métriques (Watch time, Hook Rate, ROAS, CPA) et tu pivotes en continu.

Vos compétences

  • Expérience solide en stratégie créative ads, avec une compréhension approfondie des régies publicitaires Meta et/ou TikTok.

  • Tu sais ce qui rend une vidéo virale — tu connais les algos, les formats, les tendances.

  • Capacité à transformer des insights data en idées créatives percutantes.

  • Plume affûtée : tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques (santé, ingrédients, écologie) en messages simples, accrocheurs, parfois provoc'.

  • Esprit analytique combiné à une forte créativité — tu es aussi à l'aise devant un dashboard que devant un script.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication — tu sais briefer un créateur, challenger un angle, défendre une idée.

Avantages

  • Impact réel : Tu bosses pour une cause qui a du sens — santé publique, transparence, écologie. Pas du bullshit marketing.

  • Autonomie totale : Pas de flicage. On juge sur les résultats, pas sur les heures.

  • Flexibilité : On est basés à Lyon, mais 100% remote c'est cool aussi.

  • Opportunité de partenariat : Si tous les feux sont au vert, on est ouverts à discuter equity/vesting pour que tu sois vraiment dans la team Ops Clean.

  • Accès direct au fondateur : Pas 12 couches de validation. Tu proposes, on teste, on itère.

⚠️ OBLIGATOIRE pour postuler

Pas de lettre de motiv' classique. Envoie-nous :

  1. Une vidéo d'1 min max pour nous expliquer en quoi tu es la personne la mieux placée pour ce poste. Utilise http://loom.com/ pour enregistrer et transmets le lien.

  2. 2-3 réalisations (organiques ou ads) dont tu es vraiment fier·e.

  3. Une petite critique de notre contenu actuel : quel angle "clivant" devrions-nous explorer demain ?

title: Customer Onboarding Manager I (Dutch Speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Step into the world of Customer Onboarding, a place where seamless onboarding experiences are crafted to bring delight to customers and businesses alike. As a Pleo Customer Onboarding Manager, you hold the key to unlocking the full potential of our cutting-edge solutions for businesses across Europe & the UK. Your mission is to oversee and execute the onboarding process with precision and finesse, collaborating seamlessly with both customers and internal teams to ensure a smooth and memorable journey from start to finish.


Picture yourself as the bridge between technology and human connection, understanding each customer's unique requirements, and configuring Pleo to match their needs perfectly. You'll be the go-to expert for technical queries, providing consultation, sharing best practices, and conducting training to drive user adoption that allows our customers to take their business to new levels. Your role goes beyond just technical prowess – it's about building strong relationships and ensuring customer success becomes a powerful reference point for the world to see. Your genuine curiosity and exceptional problem-solving skills will shine through as you navigate multiple onboarding projects with ease, all while staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends.


Some of the fun you will have
Facing the customer externally:

  • In short, after our customers have signed up to Pleo, you'll be in charge of their Onboarding

  • Work with these customers to identify objectives, priorities, policies, systems, and effective rollout plans

And internally facing:

  • You'll enjoy sharing knowledge with the team, collaborating on training and enablement

  • The opportunity to work and add your voice to our continuous process improvement projects

  • Accurately track efforts for revenue recognition and resource allocation

  • Provide feedback and insights to product, development, and marketing teams

  • Collaborate with stakeholders, share updates, address risks

  • Ensure onboarding timeline and customer satisfaction

  • Share success stories, encourage testimonials, showcase experiences

 

You will thrive in this role if you have

  • Successful customer facing experience (at least 2-3 years), ideally in Customer Onboarding, or in Customer Success.

  • Some knowledge of accounting principles and financial workflows is desirable.

  • Genuine curiosity for understanding and fulfilment of customer needs.

  • Strong and proven commitment to customer satisfaction and building relationships.

  • Excellent planning, prioritisation, and risk management abilities for simultaneous onboarding projects.

  • Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive success. Can you really break down a customer problem and explain it to a data analyst, designer, or engineer?

  • Willingness to adapt to changing requirements and stay updated with industry trends.

  • Energy that is palpable. Are you someone who can lift others up? Can you be a rock for your teammates? Can you be vulnerable when times call for it? And, can you bring a fierceness that propels our business forward? If yes then you are the one for this team.

  • Complete business fluency in Dutch and English (Essential)

title: Customer Success Internship (German speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You’ll Do

Dive in as the strategic force behind our post-sales customer journey, transforming satisfaction into a powerful engine for growth. As a key player in a nimble, high-impact team, you'll own the customer experience for the DACH market, shaping processes and driving initiatives that directly enhance customer lifetime value and accelerate our market expansion.

title: Customer Success Manager Grands Comptes - Cabinets comptables H/F
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

  

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

  

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote.

You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. Some of the accounts you'll inherit are in difficult places, so you'll be rebuilding trust, holding rooms independently and driving outcomes in ambiguity.

We're a high-performance team. Everyone holds an important seat and is expected to perform at an elite level. We have each other's backs, we assume good intent, and we have zero space for internal politics. If that's your default, you'll thrive here.

This is an on-site role. Four days a week you'll be in our London office or out with customers, with one day working from home. Regular travel to customers across the UK is part of the job.

Responsibilities

  • Own senior customer relationships at Director level and above (Operations, Finance, HR), in person as well as over video, and act as the escalation point for your accounts

  • Run the QBR cadence and own renewals end to end, so the value case is made long before the renewal conversation

  • Drive proactive value work: account audits, surfacing unused functionality, and translating product usage into business outcomes

  • Progress seat upsells as customers grow, and flag wider expansion opportunities to AEs

  • Hold difficult conversations with diplomacy, including product feedback that isn't on the roadmap

  • Manage customer-side projects such as integrations and configuration changes, keeping status visible so customers always know where they stand

  • Help shape how Customer Success works at Sona, from health scoring to escalation

Requirements

  • You've owned a book of enterprise SaaS accounts, whether as a CSM, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales, Implementation Consultant or PM

  • You've held Director-level customer relationships independently and been accountable for the customer health that drives renewal

  • You're commercially fluent around NRR and value realisation, and treat accounts as long-term assets

  • You're confident in complex SaaS products: you can demo, discuss configuration trade-offs and translate capability into business value

  • You've worked in a scaleup where process was still being built

  • You use AI tools daily in your CS work and can point to specific workflows

  • You can disagree with a senior customer and keep the relationship intact

It’d be a bonus if you could bring

  • Hands-on experience with Planhat, Salesforce, or similar CS platforms

  • Track record of identifying and converting commercial expansion opportunities (seat upsells, module flags)

Benefits

  • Salary: £55,000 - £75,000

  • On-site working: 4 days a week in the London office or with customers, 1 day from home

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Annual team off-sites and quarterly socials

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

  • Professional development budget

  • Unlimited free books

Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

title: Data Engineer, Finance
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

About the Role 

As a Data Engineer within Engelhart's Finance department, you will build and operate reliable data pipelines connecting the data warehouse and CTRM platform with brokers and Futures Commission Merchants (FCMs), margin and collateral processes, and the wider Finance technology stack. You will help automate manual Finance workflows into tested, monitored jobs, with robust reconciliations and controls that give stakeholders confidence in the completeness and accuracy of financial data. 

This will be a full-time role based in our London office and owning the following responsibilities: 

  • Build, operate and maintain data pipelines between the data warehouse, CTRM platform, brokers and FCMs, margin and collateral processes, and Finance systems. 
  • Integrate data from the Finance stack, including P&L and F+, SAP General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, and bank statements. 
  • Automate manual Finance processes by developing reliable, tested and monitored jobs that can be operated and supported effectively. 
  • Implement reconciliations and data controls to identify missing or incomplete records, duplicates and breaks, and produce clear exception and break reporting. 
  • Ingest and process external files and feeds, including data received over SFTP and in formats such as CSV and XML. 
  • Investigate data and reconciliation issues, trace discrepancies through source systems and pipelines, and explain P&L or cash breaks to relevant Finance stakeholders. 
  • Develop and maintain serverless ETL solutions on AWS, using infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices to support consistent, controlled releases. 
  • Apply strong SQL and Python-based data processing to transform, validate and reconcile data accurately and efficiently. 
  • Work with Finance and technology stakeholders to understand requirements, improve existing workflows and deliver maintainable solutions with appropriate controls. 
  • Contribute to improving the reliability, observability and quality of Finance data flows as the business and its systems evolve. 

About You 

You will be a practical, analytical data engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with an understanding of Finance processes and controls. You can work with varied data sources, investigate discrepancies and explain the cause of a P&L or cash break clearly. You take ownership of the reliability of the jobs you build and look for opportunities to simplify and automate manual processes. 

As a result, we believe the following experiences and skills are essential for application: 

  • Strong Python development skills, including experience with Pandas and/or Polars, NumPy, and automated testing with pytest. 
  • Hands-on experience building AWS serverless ETL pipelines, using services such as Lambda, EventBridge, ECS/Fargate, DynamoDB, CloudWatch and S3. 
  • Experience with AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Experience building APIs using Python frameworks, preferably FastAPI. 
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to query, transform, validate and reconcile data. 
  • Experience ingesting external files and data feeds, including SFTP transfers and formats such as CSV and XML. 
  • Good understanding of Finance processes and data, with the analytical skills to investigate and clearly explain a P&L or cash break. 
  • A disciplined approach to testing, monitoring, reconciliation and control design, including checks for completeness, duplicates and exceptions. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to trace issues across systems and data pipelines. 
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Finance and technical stakeholders. 

The following experience is not required, but highly desirable for this role: 

  • Experience using Kafka from Python. 
  • Experience integrating with SAP or treasury systems. 
  • Exposure to trading data, including positions and P&L. 
  • Familiarity with dbt and/or Airflow. 

What we offer 

  • Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.  
  • 25 days of annual holiday entitlement, excluding UK public holidays. 
  • Robust benefits package such as medical, dental, life insurance, generous pension contribution, and supplemental benefits partially subsidised by the Company.   
  • Eligibility to receive external and internal training in accordance with our Training & Development Policy. 

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

title: Data Platform Engineer

We’ve built the early foundations but there’s still plenty to build - you’ll shape the architecture to serve hundreds of enterprise customers.

title: Data Steward - People Platforms
descriptionHtml:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.

You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.

This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.

You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.

What you'll be doing:

Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance

  • Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.
  • Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.
  • Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Director - Data with supporting analysis.
  • Process new entity creation requests, validating source data against matching rules before golden record creation.

Source system mapping and onboarding support

  • Manage and maintain mappings between source system entities and golden master records, ensuring traceability and accuracy.
  • Support the onboarding of new agencies and source systems by executing mapping activities and validating initial data loads against MDM standards.
  • Maintain reference data configurations, ensuring code sets and lookup values remain aligned across source systems.

Data governance and classification

  • Apply data classification standards to master data entities as defined by the governance framework, covering sensitivity, confidentiality, and regulatory categorisation.
  • Review and correct AI-generated data classifications, providing feedback to improve automated tagging accuracy over time.
  • Follow and enforce stewardship workflows including exception handling, approval processes, and escalation procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of entity mappings, transformation rules, hierarchy structures, and stewardship decisions.

AI-assisted stewardship operations

  • Act as the human-in-the-loop for AI-assisted matching and entity resolution, reviewing model-suggested matches, adjudicating low-confidence merge candidates, and approving or rejecting proposed golden record updates.
  • Review and validate AI-generated mapping recommendations during source system onboarding, ensuring accuracy before mappings are committed.
  • Provide feedback on AI model outputs to support continuous improvement of match accuracy, classification quality, and enrichment relevance.
  • Work with AI-driven anomaly detection alerts, investigating flagged records and determining appropriate stewardship actions.

Data quality monitoring and remediation

  • Monitor data quality dashboards and alerts, investigating exceptions and applying remediation actions in a timely manner.
  • Execute data quality checks across master data entities, documenting findings and tracking resolution through to completion.
  • Maintain and update data quality rules as business requirements and source systems evolve, under the direction of the Data Manager.

Operational reporting and team support

  • Provide first-line support for master data issues raised by downstream consumers and business users.
  • Contribute to operational reporting on stewardship volumes, exception trends, match rates, and resolution times.

Support data migration and reconciliation activities during source system onboarding and platform changes.

What you'll need:

  • Experience in a data stewardship, data administration, or master data management role.
  • Practical understanding of MDM concepts including golden records, matching, survivorship, and entity resolution.
  • Familiarity with enterprise master data management and data governance solutions (e.g. Informatica MDM, Informatica Data Governance) or equivalent platforms is desirable.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data investigation, validation, and reporting.
  • Understanding of data governance principles including data classification, ownership, and stewardship workflows.
  • Willingness to work with AI and machine learning tools as part of day-to-day stewardship operations, including reviewing AI-suggested matches, classifications, and enrichments.
  • Experience working with ERP or HCM data (Workday, SAP, Dynamics, or similar) is an advantage.
  • Attention to detail with the ability to identify and resolve data discrepancies methodically.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent stewardship tasks and priorities.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to document and explain findings clearly to both technical and business audiences.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving data problems.
  • Enthusiasm for developing expertise in master data management, data governance, and AI-assisted data operations.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. title: Database Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Database Engineering Intern to work on the data layer of our production software. You will work alongside the developer who owns our data layer on data modelling, query optimisation and documentation.

title: Deputy Superintendent Pharmacist
descriptionHtml:
As our pharmacy continues to grow, this is an exciting opportunity to bring your clinical expertise, regulatory knowledge and leadership experience to an ambitious and evolving business. Working closely with our Superintendent Pharmacist, you will help shape the future of our pharmacy, strengthen professional standards and support the delivery of safe, effective patient care at scale.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their clinical and regulatory knowledge, understands the importance of patient safety and is ready to take on a position with significant accountability, influence and leadership.

What is the Job?

At Montu, every prescription represents a patient waiting for treatment that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

Our pharmacy processes over 50,000 prescriptions each month, with continued month-on-month growth of approximately 10%. As our operation continues to scale, the Deputy Superintendent Pharmacist will work in close partnership with the Superintendent Pharmacist across all areas of clinical and regulatory governance.

You will take a leading role in the day-to-day clinical operation of the pharmacy, providing specialist regulatory expertise in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs, supporting professional standards and ensuring patient safety remains central to everything we do.

You will provide clear clinical and regulatory guidance, identify and manage risks, support inspections and audits, and contribute to the ongoing development of our pharmacy systems, processes and governance frameworks.

You will also deputise for the Superintendent Pharmacist when required, helping to balance the demands of a high-volume pharmacy operation with the professional, legal and regulatory standards expected of us.

What Will You Be Doing?

Clinical Governance and Regulatory Compliance

  • Work alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist to maintain clinical governance and professional standards across Montu Pharmacy.

  • Support compliance with GPhC standards, MHRA regulations and all relevant statutory and professional requirements.

  • Lead the day-to-day clinical operation, providing clear guidance and direction to clinical and operational teams.

  • Take an active role in regulatory inspections, audits and compliance reviews, ensuring the pharmacy remains inspection-ready.

  • Identify, assess and manage regulatory risks, implementing appropriate corrective and preventative actions.

  • Review and maintain pharmacy policies, procedures and governance frameworks.

  • Maintain oversight of professional accountability, patient safety and regulatory reporting requirements.

Controlled Drugs Governance (Schedule 2)

  • Act as a specialist in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs regulation, working alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist to ensure compliance with relevant legislation.

  • Oversee appropriate systems and controls for the safe storage, handling, dispensing, recording and management of Controlled Drugs.

  • Ensure accurate, auditable records are maintained, with effective monitoring and reconciliation processes.

  • Identify and address potential compliance risks, incidents and discrepancies.

  • Support the development of Controlled Drugs governance processes that remain effective as prescription volumes increase.

Professional Leadership and Team Development

  • Provide clinical leadership alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist to a pharmacy workforce of over 100 colleagues.

  • Support the maintenance of professional standards and competencies across the pharmacy.

  • Oversee competency frameworks, training requirements and ongoing professional development.

  • Work with pharmacy leaders to promote accountability, patient safety and continuous improvement.

  • Provide guidance on complex clinical, professional and regulatory matters.

  • Collaborate with operational leadership to maintain accuracy, efficiency and patient-centred care.

Pharmacy Operations, Systems and SOPs

  • Maintain oversight of pharmacy systems, processes and Standard Operating Procedures.

  • Ensure operational practices remain compliant, efficient and appropriate for the scale of the business.

  • Identify opportunities to improve patient safety, dispensing accuracy and operational efficiency.

  • Support the implementation of pharmacy technology, automation and system improvements.

  • Ensure appropriate governance is maintained when introducing new processes, technologies and services.

  • Work closely with operational teams to balance prescription volumes, service delivery and regulatory requirements.

Strategy and Business Growth

  • Work alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist, General Manager of Pharmacy, Medical Director and senior leadership team to support the clinical and regulatory strategy.

  • Provide regulatory expertise when evaluating new services, products and business opportunities.

  • Support regulatory readiness for pharmacy expansion and operational growth.

  • Help develop scalable governance frameworks that support increasing prescription volumes.

  • Contribute to decisions relating to pharmacy systems, technology and automation.

  • Ensure regulatory considerations remain central to business planning and operational decision-making.

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced pharmacist with the expertise, confidence and ambition to make a meaningful contribution to the leadership of our pharmacy.

You will have strong clinical judgement, excellent regulatory knowledge and a thorough understanding of the professional standards required within a complex, high-volume pharmacy environment.

You will be particularly confident in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs legislation and compliance, with the ability to provide clear, practical guidance to both clinical and non-clinical colleagues.

This role requires someone who can see the bigger picture. You will understand the importance of operational performance, commercial awareness and business growth, while ensuring patient safety and regulatory compliance are never compromised.

You will be comfortable joining a growing business, building relationships across teams and bringing fresh perspectives to the way we work. Above all, we are looking for someone who leads by example, communicates effectively, remains calm under pressure and has the confidence to challenge, influence and make informed decisions.

What Experience Will You Need?

Essential

  • Current registration with the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC).

  • Extensive knowledge of GPhC Standards for Pharmacy Professionals and relevant pharmacy legislation.

  • Demonstrable knowledge of Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs regulation and compliance in practice.

  • Experience leading clinical pharmacy operations within a high-volume or complex environment.

  • Strong understanding of MHRA regulations, including relevant requirements relating to importing, wholesaling and medicines storage.

  • Strong knowledge of pharmacy governance, risk management and Standard Operating Procedures.

  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections, audits and compliance frameworks.

  • Ability to provide clear clinical and regulatory guidance and influence decisions across clinical and operational teams.

  • Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of operational performance, KPIs and business growth.

Desirable

  • Previous experience in, or deputising for, a senior pharmacy leadership position.

  • Experience supporting pharmacy technology, automation or systems implementation.

What Does Success Look Like?

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Strengthened Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs governance, ensuring processes remain compliant, auditable and scalable.

  • Supported the development and maintenance of robust pharmacy governance frameworks.

  • Helped establish clear professional competency, training and development standards.

  • Played an active role in preparing for and supporting regulatory inspections and audits.

  • Identified and supported meaningful improvements to pharmacy systems, technology and automation.

  • Contributed to shaping the clinical and regulatory strategy of Montu Pharmacy

What we offer

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

title: Developer Experience / DevEx
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Software organisation at Fractile

Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.

About the team and role

The Developer Experience team at Fractile helps shape how our customers interact with the Fractile inference accelerator. We work across the company to identify, create, and present information on how the system is being used, as well as providing the tooling to help optimise our customers' usage of the system, while keeping a shallow learning curve.

As a member of the Developer Experience team you will need to understand the current state of development for inference hardware. You will need to be able to identify what will work well for engineers wanting to identify potential opportunities for performance improvements, while knowing what tooling will fit into an existing LLM engineer's workflow with the minimal amount of disruption and effort.

About you

We're looking for someone who is self-driven and capable of identifying tooling opportunities, designing those tools, and delivering them in a way which will fit in with an LLM engineer's existing toolset. You will have worked in this area before, possibly as an FDE or at a company that provides inference services using their own models, and have the ability to develop new tools that are designed to be functional and easy to learn and use.

Key Requirements

  • Experience with inference frameworks such as JAX and/or PyTorch

  • Experience of software development in Python, Rust, C/C++, or a similar language

  • Experience monitoring and optimising code written in CUDA, ROCm, OpenCL, or similar

  • Experience monitoring and optimising LLM deployments with 50+ billion parameters

  • Experience working with stakeholders across multiple teams

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

descriptionHtml:
Localisation

Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique !

En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets, vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants.


Vos missions

· Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire.

· Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires.

· Identifier de nouveaux sites à potentiel grâce à votre réseau, aux outils cartographiques et à vos actions de terrain.

· Réaliser l’analyse technico-économique des sites, en intégrant contraintes et risques.

· Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions.

· Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets.

· Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux.

· Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement.

· Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial.

Votre profil

· Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural.

· Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial).

· Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation.

· Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux.

· Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets.

· Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation.

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours.
🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance.
🌴 Une prime vacances.
🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50%
🚗 Une voiture de fonction.
🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous.
📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS).
🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse.

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation.

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

title: DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Was wir suchen

Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen wir die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) für unser IT Team, zu 100 % aus dem Home-Office (Deutschland) oder bei uns im Bremer Office!

Das sind deine Aufgaben

  • Du überwachst und betreust unsere Server
  • Du kümmerst dich um das interne Monitoring
  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Weiterentwicklung und Wartung der IT-Infrastruktur
  • Du verwaltest unsere Infrastruktur als Code (z. B. mit Terraform, Ansible)
  • Du integrierst Security-Checks direkt in unsere CI/CD-Pipelines (Shift-Left-Ansatz) und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du führst regelmäßige Schwachstellen-Scans und Penetrationstests durch
  • Du kümmerst dich um das Secrets-Management und die sichere Verwaltung von Zugangsdaten
  • Du sorgst für die Einhaltung von Sicherheitsstandards und Compliance-Vorgaben (z. B. ISO 27001, DSGVO)
  • Du betreibst Threat Modeling und bewertest Sicherheitsrisiken frühzeitig
  • Du dokumentierst Prozesse und Infrastruktur
  • Du beobachtest aktuelle Trends und bringst neue Tools und Best Practices ein
  • Du berätst Kolleg:innen bei sicherheitsrelevanten Fragestellungen

Dank deiner Expertise erreichst du folgende Meilensteine bei uns

  • 0-3 Monate:
    • Du hast unser Team, unsere Prozesse und unsere IT-Infrastruktur kennengelernt
    • Du hast dich in unsere bestehende Server-, Monitoring- und CI/CD-Landschaft eingearbeitet
    • Du hast einen Überblick über unsere aktuellen Sicherheitsmaßnahmen und erste Optimierungspotenziale identifiziert
    • Du übernimmst eigenständig erste Aufgaben im Tagesbetrieb und Monitoring
  • 4-6 Monate:
    • Du hast erste Security-Checks in unsere CI/CD-Pipelines integriert (Shift-Left)
    • Du hast Verbesserungen im Monitoring und Alerting umgesetzt
    • Du hast bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Infrastruktur aktiv mitgewirkt
    • Du hast erste Schwachstellen-Scans durchgeführt und Maßnahmen abgeleitet
  • 7-12 Monate:
    • Du verantwortest eigenständig zentrale Teile unserer IT-Infrastruktur
    • Du hast Sicherheitsstandards und Best Practices im Team etabliert
    • Du treibst die Automatisierung von Prozessen eigenverantwortlich voran
    • Du bist zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für sicherheitsrelevante Fragestellungen
    • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer DevSecOps-Kultur aktiv mit

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im IT-Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik) – oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in der Administration von Linux-Servern
  • Du bist vertraut mit Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und deren sicherem Betrieb
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code-Tools (z. B. Terraform, Ansible)
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Du hast Kenntnisse in Monitoring- und Logging-Tools (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK-Stack)
  • Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Netzwerke, Firewalls und gängige Sicherheitskonzepte mit

Das bieten wir dir

  • Diese Stelle kann zu 100% im Home Office (aus Deutschland) erledigt werden.

Das sind unsere Werte

  • Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.
