title: Freelance E-Mail Marketing / CRM Manager | 100 % Remote (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du kennst dich mit Klaviyo aus, hast bereits E-Commerce-Marken betreut und möchtest weitere eigene Kunden und ein Team verantworten? Dann könnte das hier gut passen.

Wir sind eine Agentur für E-Mail- und SMS-Marketing. Wir unterstützen DTC-Marken mit sieben- und achtstelligen Umsätzen dabei, mehr aus ihrem E-Mail-Marketing herauszuholen und langfristig zu wachsen.

Bei uns übernimmst du die Betreuung mehrerer Kunden. Du entwickelst die Strategie, planst Kampagnen und koordinierst die Umsetzung mit deinem Team aus Copywriter, Designer und Klaviyo-Technician. Dabei behältst du die Ergebnisse im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden jederzeit wissen, woran wir arbeiten.

Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, klar kommuniziert und seine Aufgaben selbstständig voranbringt.

WICHTIG: Erfahrung bei einer Agentur oder Brand ist Pflicht. Bitte bewerbe dich ansonsten nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kunden betreuen: Du bist der erste Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden, hältst sie auf dem Laufenden und kümmerst dich um Feedback und Freigaben.

  • Strategien entwickeln: Du planst Kampagnen, Flows und Pop-ups, die zur jeweiligen Marke und ihren Zielen passen.

  • Kampagnen planen: Du erstellst die monatlichen Kampagnenkalender und bringst eigene Ideen für Themen, Angebote und Tests ein.

  • Dein Team koordinieren: Du briefst Copywriter, Designer und Klaviyo-Techniker und sorgst dafür, dass jeder weiß, was zu tun ist.

  • Qualität prüfen: Du kontrollierst Texte, Designs und die technische Umsetzung. Du achtest darauf, dass jede E-Mail zur Marke passt und vor dem Versand sorgfältig geprüft wird.

  • Deadlines einhalten: Du behältst den Überblick über laufende Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass alles pünktlich fertig wird. Korrekturen werden normalerweise innerhalb von 24 Stunden umgesetzt.

  • Ergebnisse auswerten: Du analysierst die Performance, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und besprichst die Ergebnisse und nächsten Schritte mit deinen Kunden im monatlichen Reporting.

  • Ordnung halten: Du sorgst für eine übersichtliche Struktur in Figma und Klaviyo, damit dein Team gut zusammenarbeiten kann.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre im E-Mail-Marketing für E-Commerce- oder DTC-Marken gearbeitet, entweder direkt bei einer Marke oder in einer Agentur.

  • Klaviyo-Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest sicher mit Klaviyo und kennst dich mit Flows, Kampagnen und Segmentierung aus. Auch im SMS-Marketing bringst du fundierte Kenntnisse mit.

  • Ein gutes Auge: Du erkennst, ob eine E-Mail übersichtlich aufgebaut ist, zur Marke passt und zum Kauf anregt.

  • Klare Kommunikation: Du kannst Kunden beraten, verständliche Briefings schreiben und deinem Team hilfreiches Feedback geben. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschst du fließend in Wort und Schrift.

  • Selbstständigkeit: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden nächsten Schritt vorgibt. Du denkst mit, gehst Aufgaben selbst an und meldest dich frühzeitig, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Organisation: Du kannst mehrere Kunden gleichzeitig betreuen und behältst Aufgaben, Prioritäten und Deadlines im Blick.

  • Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest zügig, ohne wichtige Details zu übersehen.

  • Erreichbarkeit: Du kannst von 9:00 bis 17:00 Uhr MEZ weitgehend ungestört arbeiten und antwortest während dieser Zeit in der Regel innerhalb von 60 Minuten auf Slack.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Freelance: Du kannst von dort arbeiten, wo du dich wohlfühlst und gut konzentrieren kannst. Außerdem kannst du nebenbei noch andere Kunden betreuen.

  • Verantwortung und Freiraum: Du betreust deine eigenen Kunden, bringst Ideen ein und gestaltest ihre E-Mail-Marketing-Strategie mit.

  • Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung: Du arbeitest mit einem Team aus Copywriter, Designer und Klaviyo-Technician zusammen.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Kunden: Du lernst unterschiedliche Marken, Produkte und Zielgruppen kennen.

  • Messbare Ergebnisse: Du siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt und welche Ideen bei den Kunden ankommen.

  • Gute Zusammenarbeit: Wir legen Wert auf klare Absprachen, ehrliches Feedback und darauf, dass wir uns aufeinander verlassen können.

Klingt interessant?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Erzähl uns kurz von deiner bisherigen Erfahrung, den Marken, die du betreut hast, und den Ergebnissen, die du mit deiner Arbeit erzielen konntest.

This approach enables business people, analysts, web developers, software engineers, and even CEOs to participate significantly, thereby creating better applications faster.

The Mendix Platform uses visual modeling to abstract long-form coding out of application development. Our customers use Mendix to create and deploy better software for the enterprise, faster. title: 📱 Fullstack Developer (Paris or remote)
descriptionHtml:
🍿 About Staycation

For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

But we see something different.

Behind their doors, hotels hide some of the most extraordinary spaces cities have to offer: breathtaking rooftops with skyline views, world-class spas and pools, bars and restaurants led by visionary chefs, interiors that spark the imagination, and beds so perfect you never want to leave them.

Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away.

Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment.

Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment.

Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home.

Today, Staycation means:

  • 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland

  • 🏨 4,000 partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces

  • ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.

✨ The role

We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team.

You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers.

Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability.

We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack.

You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin, our CTO & Head of Product.

📍 Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification.

  • Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change.

  • Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement.

  • Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt.

  • Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time.

  • Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop.

🧰 Our tech environment

Four products running on a shared stack:

  • The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel.

  • The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes.

  • The hotel extranet, where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots.

  • The internal admin platform, the tool our teams use to run the marketplace.

On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform.

📌 Key results

In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows.

  • Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production.

  • Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production.

  • Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement.

  • Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design.

In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad.

  • Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business.

  • Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility.

  • Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team.

  • At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others.

🌍 Location

This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:

  • If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.

  • If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).

🚀 Why join us?

  • Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience.

  • Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey.

  • Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design.

  • Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma.

  • Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working.

  • Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris.

🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you:

Must-haves

  • Have at least 5 years of professional software development experience, with a track record of shipping and owning meaningful product features.

  • Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger.

  • Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.

  • Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way.

  • Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact.

  • Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design.

  • Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with React Native.

  • Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey.

  • Previous experience working remotely.

  • Comfortable working in English in a professional environment.

⚙️ Hiring process

  • Recruiter interview with Mathieu, our Talent Acquisition Manager (30–45 min)

  • Manager interview with Robin, our CTO & Head of Product, and Charlie, one of our Lead Developers (60 min)

  • Technical interview with Corentin and Joachim, our Tech Leads (60 min)

  • Final meetings with members of our Leadership team (60 min) and your potential future teammates (30 min)

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern, eingebettet in deren Teams. Du übernimmst eigene Features von der Schnittstelle bis zur Oberfläche, erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind ansprechbar.

Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Entwickler, gezählt nach Ausbildung oder Studium.

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du auf beiden Seiten sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Unsere Kunden erwarten das, und wir arbeiten auch so. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

title: Functional Safety Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release

• Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals

• Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls

• Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams

• Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD)

• Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification

• Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics

• Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices

 

Skills and Experience Required:

• BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory

• Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems

• Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061)

• Hands-on experience with HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA and safety requirements engineering

• Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures

• Familiarity with hydrogen, high-voltage or pressure system safety is a strong plus

• Team player able to work autonomously with internal and external experts

• Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory; French/German is a plus

• Functional safety certification (e.g. TÜV FSEng) is a plus

 

Start date: Immediately

descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du definierst übergeordnete Systemanforderungen und leitest daraus klare und umsetzbare Teilanforderungen ab
  • Du führst Gefährdungs- und Risikoanalysen durch und definierst die relevanten Systemgrenzen
  • Du entwickelst und bewertest Systemarchitekturen mit einem besonderen Fokus auf Functional Safety
  • Du arbeitest im Rahmen unseres Robotics Safety Chapters eng mit Stakeholdern innerhalb und außerhalb des Entwicklungsteams zusammen
  • Du koordinierst Produktzertifizierungen in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Zertifizierungsstellen
  • Du pflegst und implementierst sicherheitsrelevante Entwicklungsprozesse und stellst deren konsequente Anwendung über den gesamten Entwicklungszyklus hinweg sicher
  • Du berechnest und bewertest die Sicherheitsperformance unserer Systeme
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung der Benutzerdokumentation mit besonderem Fokus auf sicherheitsrelevante Inhalte

Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über ein tiefgehendes Verständnis der funktionalen Sicherheit von Maschinen oder Fahrzeugen, idealerweise im Bereich der mobilen Robotik
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit Hardware- und Softwarearchitekturen mit
  • Du hast ein Masterstudium in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Naturwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich abgeschlossen und bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Functional Safety (FuSa) mit
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikobeurteilungen nach ISO 12100 sowie in Functional-Safety-Analysen wie FMEDA und FTA mit
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse der relevanten Normen und Vorschriften im Bereich der mobilen Robotik, darunter: EN ISO 12100 / EN ISO 13849 / EN 61508 / EN ISO 3691-4 / EN 1175 / EN 60204-1 / Maschinenverordnung (EU) 2023/1230
  • Du arbeitest gerne hands-on mit mobilen Robotern und fühlst dich in industriellen Umgebungen wohl
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, ergreifst Initiative und treibst deine Themen mit hoher Eigenmotivation voran
  • Du kommunizierst sicher und fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch

Was wir bieten

  • Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte!
  • Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Menschen arbeiten.
  • Kultur: Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativenund vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig.
  • Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee!
  • Flexibilität: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei.
  • Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, Wellpass‑, Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahre hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Benefits.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 %? Kein Problem. Wir wissen, dass die besten Talente nicht immer jeden Punkt einer Stellenanzeige mitbringen. Wenn Du Dich für Robotik begeisterst und die Zukunft der Automatisierung mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht ist genau diese Position der richtige nächste Schritt für Dich oder eine andere spannende Gelegenheit bei Jungheinrich Robotics.

Für uns bei Jungheinrich Robotics ist die Förderung der Inklusion sehr wichtig. Wir sind daher bestrebt, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Kandidaten zu schaffen und bieten allen qualifizierten Bewerbern unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Kultur oder Bildung gleiche Chancen. Wenn Du gewisse Anpassungen benötigst, um den Rekruitingprozess für Dich zugänglich zu machen, werden wir unser Bestes tun, um Dir entgegenzukommen. Sprich uns gerne darauf an!

title: Gestionnaire Pole Quittancement F/H
descriptionHtml:
Rejoignez COOP Ivry Habitat, une société coopérative d'intérêt collectif HLM, riche de plus de 90 ans d'histoire et de savoir-faire dans le secteur de l'immobilier social. Située à Ivry-sur-Seine, à la limite sud de Paris, notre organisation gère un patrimoine architectural diversifié de 6 400 logements. En tant que membre fondateur de CAP Habitat, nous sommes engagés dans la défense des valeurs du logement social et le développement de synergies communes avec plus de 50 000 logements en Ile-de-France. Nous recherchons un(e) Gestionnaire Pôle Quitancement F/H. Ce poste clé vous permettra de participer activement à nos opérations de renouvellement urbain et à notre mission de fournir des solutions de logement durables et accessibles. Venez rejoindre notre équipe dynamique et contribuez à façonner l'avenir de l'habitat social en Ile-de-France.

Vos missions

Au sein de la direction relation locataires, vous assurez la gestion du quittancement mensuel, des encaissements de loyer.

QUITTANCEMENTS MENSUELS :

Gérer la facturation des consommations d’eau et de chauffage consécutives à la transmission des index relevés par nos prestataires ;

  • Traiter les APL, AL et RLS après réception du fichier transmis par la Caisse d’allocations familiales du Val de Marne, y compris remboursements des rappels dus aux locataires ainsi que des indus à reverser à la CAF ;
  • Calculer et vérifier le quittancement, transmettre les fichiers à notre prestataire pour édition et envoi des avis d’échéance aux locataires ;
  • Déverser le quittancement en comptabilité, vérifier les comptes budgétaires.

TRAITEMENT DES MODIFICATIONS DE QUITTANCEMENT:

  • Gérer la facturation du quittancement pour les locataires entrés après la date de validation ;
  • Saisir en modification de quittancement les soldes de tous compte des locataires ayant donné congés de leur logement ;
  • Déverser en comptabilité, vérifier les comptes budgétaires.

ENCAISSEMENTS DES LOYERS, IMPUTATIONS SUR LES COMPTES LOCATIFS :

  • Prendre en charge la gestion des chèques déposés à l’accueil, envoyés à notre prestataire, des cartes bancaires effectuées à l’accueil et effectuées sur notre site Internet ;
  • Gérer les prélèvements automatiques, ainsi que les règlements effectués par virement sur notre compte bancaire ;
  • Déverser en comptabilité, vérifier les comptes budgétaires.

ACCUEIL DES LOCATAIRES :

  • Assurer les permanences du service les matins.

REPONSES AUX DEMANDES INTER-SERVICES :

  • Traiter les admissions en non-valeur, FSH, imputer les aides départementales ;
  • Gérer les indemnités d’occupation ;
  • Traiter de OD (opérations diverses) au niveau du quittancement ;
  • Rechercher, en fonction des demandes, l’historique du quittancement.

MISSIONS SPECIFIQUES :

  • Prendre en charge la révision annuelle de la tarification des loyers et des charges locatives ;
  • Suivre la pose des compteurs d’eau et de chauffage pour les nouvelles construction et réhabilitations.

title: Global Account Executive at Private Equity Insights
descriptionHtml:
Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility?

Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people?

The role

You’ll be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of sponsors across our international conferences, building long-term relationships with senior decision-makers and driving sponsorship revenue.

This is a high-performance B2B sales role with a strong focus on sponsor retention, renewals and account growth, alongside identifying and closing new sponsorship opportunities.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a commercially driven salesperson who enjoys building strong client relationships, growing accounts and consistently delivering against revenue targets.

You should have:

  • At least 2 years of B2B sales experience.

  • A proven track record of achieving or exceeding individual revenue targets.

  • Experience managing client relationships, retaining customers and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.

  • Confidence engaging, pitching and negotiating with senior decision-makers.

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to identify new revenue opportunities.

  • Ambition, resilience and ownership – you take responsibility for your portfolio, performance and results.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

This role might not be the right fit if...

  • You prefer a role focused purely on relationship management, without responsibility for sales and revenue.

  • You don't enjoy negotiating, closing deals and working towards commercial targets.

  • You're not comfortable taking ownership of client relationships and proactively identifying opportunities to grow accounts.

  • You're looking for a hybrid or remote position – our London team works together from the office five days a week.

What you’ll do

  • Manage and retain sponsors: Build strong, long-term relationships with an existing portfolio of sponsors, driving renewals and repeat business.

  • Grow existing accounts: Identify opportunities to upsell, cross-sell and increase sponsorship revenue within your portfolio.

  • Drive new business: Identify, pitch and close new sponsorship opportunities to expand our client base.

  • Own your revenue targets: Take responsibility for achieving ambitious individual sales and retention targets.

  • Deliver exceptional partnerships: Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure sponsors receive a high-quality experience and see value in their partnerships.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and market-leading OTE.

  • Significant ownership and responsibility from day one.

  • The opportunity to work closely with our senior leadership team.

  • International travel to our conferences.

  • Training, coaching and ongoing development.

  • Strong opportunities for internal progression as we continue to grow.

About us

Private Equity Insights is a global community connecting private equity professionals, investors and industry leaders through conferences, networking and industry insights. Our events bring together key decision-makers from across the private equity ecosystem to exchange ideas, build relationships and discover new opportunities.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media, a global B2B media and conferences group.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Monday–Friday, we work from our WeWork office in Victoria, London. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

You must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Global Senior Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs within the semiconductor industry? As Senior Program Manager, you drive multidisciplinary global projects from concept to delivery, working closely with leading customers, engineering teams and operations.

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes.

Your main responsibilities are:

  • Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery.

  • Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites.

  • Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle.

  • Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables.

  • Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact.

  • Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth.

Why do you want this position?

Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology.

What do we offer?

At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. We are an organization where you are given freedom, where entrepreneurship is rewarded, and where you have the opportunity to turn your ideas into reality. We offer a dynamic environment with plenty of room to grow, take ownership, and advance your career. You will be part of a global company while still enjoying the down-to-earth culture that Twente is known for.

At Benchmark, you will find challenging work, a high level of trust, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work alongside pragmatic colleagues in an informal culture, supported by attractive employment conditions that enable long-term success.

In addition, we offer:

  • A competitive salary of up to €9,000 gross per month, based on full-time employment, depending on your experience, expertise, and background.

  • revenue-based quarterly bonus scheme with a maximum payout of 5% of your quarterly salary.

  • Enjoy 40 days of paid leave per year (27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days).

  • Personal growth and development, with a tailored development path that aligns with your ambitions and the needs of the business.

  • Flexibility in how you organize your workweek, enabling you to balance work and personal life in a way that works for you.

  • A strong engineering-driven knowledge culture, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation are central. Through initiatives such as Lunch & Learn Sessions and Pitch Discovery Sessions, you will have ample opportunities to learn, inspire others, and develop new ideas.

Who are you?

Whether you're already leading large-scale engineering programs or ready to take on a broader strategic role, you thrive in complex, technology-driven environments. You know how to align stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and guide multidisciplinary teams towards a common goal. With your leadership skills, business acumen and ability to bring structure to complexity, you successfully translate ambitious plans into tangible results.

Furthermore, we are looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in a high-tech semiconductor environment, preferably within system development and with a background in mechatronics or mechanical engineering.

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary teams around common goals and priorities.

  • Proven track record in delivering complex systems and development programs, from concept and design through industrialization and customer delivery.

  • Strong technical affinity, capable of translating engineering challenges into clear plans, decisions and results.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, combined with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced international environment and willingness to travel.

If you're excited by the challenge of leading global semiconductor programs at the forefront of technology, we cannot wait to get in touch!

Serious Tech
At Benchmark, you work on products that make a real impact through innovation, whether by improving safety, enhancing healthcare, or making everyday life easier. From product design and engineering to volume production and, in some cases, direct delivery to end users, the entire process takes place at our Almelo facility, where you will work alongside approximately 650 colleagues.

We develop and manufacture innovative solutions for industries including semiconductor, healthcare, aerospace, and industrial markets. From concept to production, the complete product lifecycle comes together under one roof. While the technical challenges are significant, our culture remains down-to-earth and approachable. You will work with people who take ownership, support one another, and continuously strive for improvement.

Seriously you?

We are looking for people who are energized by complex technology and are motivated by challenging work. People who take initiative, share ideas, and enjoy working together to make things better every day. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Go-To-Market Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

Are you excited about solving real, hard problems? Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. You will learn to write copy that makes elite investors act, map the entire market of investors, decide who to target, and deploy AI to outperform a teams of 20+ people.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career, apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way
  • Unlimited growth potential. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our conferences

Your Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value to the client.

What we expect from you

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Role is full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week.

Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year.

The start date is flexible.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Go-to-Market Manager:in – Commercial Energy Solutions (w/m/d) bei der Enpal Business Solutions GmbH treibst du die Energiewende aktiv voran und verantwortest komplexe Vertriebsprojekte im Bereich Commercial Energy Solutions. Du begleitest Industrie- und Gewerbekunden von der ersten Opportunity bis zum Vertragsabschluss und leistest einen direkten Beitrag zum Ausbau von Großbatteriespeicher-, PV- und weiteren Energielösungen.

  • Identifiziere und entwickle neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Bereich Commercial Energy Solutions

  • Verantworte komplexe Sales-Prozesse mit Industrie- und Gewerbekunden eigenständig von der Qualifizierung bis zum Vertragsabschluss

  • Entwickle überzeugende Lösungskonzepte gemeinsam mit internen Fachbereichen

  • Führe kommerzielle Verhandlungen auf verschiedenen Entscheidungsebenen bis hin zur Geschäftsführung

  • Steuere mehrere Stakeholder gleichzeitig und behalte auch bei längeren Verkaufszyklen den Überblick

  • Bringe deine Erfahrung ein, um Vertriebsprozesse und Go-to-Market-Strukturen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

  • Trage aktiv dazu bei, den Ausbau von Batteriespeichern und weiteren Energielösungen im Markt zu beschleunigen

     

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung in Business Development, Sales, Commercial Management oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer B2B-Verkaufsprozesse mit mehreren Stakeholdern

  • Starkes Interesse an Energielösungen und der Energiewende

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

 

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit -Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost -29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

  • Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf.

  • Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause.

 

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: Hardware Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

Role Overview

As a Hardware Test Engineer at Optics11, you play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our fiber-optic sensing systems. You develop and execute hardware tests at board and sub-system level, identifying potential issues early and helping our engineers deliver robust, production-ready solutions.

Combining hands-on hardware engineering with test automation, you build test setups, analyze results, support prototype development, and help transfer testing processes from R&D to production.

You will be part of our Sensing Platform Team, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, production, and external partners.

What You'll Do

Hardware Testing & Automation

  • Develop and execute test plans and procedures for electronic boards, assemblies, and sub-systems.

  • Design and maintain test setups, fixtures, and jigs for functional, electrical, and optical testing.

  • Perform environmental, stability, and robustness testing, including thermal cycling, vibration, and EMC/ESD pre-compliance.

  • Develop Python-based test automation for instrument control, data logging, and analysis.

  • Document test procedures, results, and findings, ensuring clear traceability and reproducibility.

Prototyping & Production Support

  • Support prototype assembly, soldering, rework, cable assembly, and fiber handling and splicing.

  • Develop and improve production and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) setups, procedures, and test jigs.

  • Support troubleshooting, repairs, and root-cause investigations during development and production.

  • Maintain an organized, safe, and well-equipped R&D laboratory, including equipment calibration and materials management.

Technical Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze test results to evaluate hardware performance, identify risks, and support engineering decisions.

  • Investigate hardware failures and collaborate with design engineers on corrective actions.

  • Contribute to design-for-test and design-for-manufacturing improvements.

  • Identify opportunities to improve test methods, automation, and product reliability.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with Electronics, Photonics, Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, IVVQ, and production teams.

  • Support the handover of tested hardware and documentation to integration, validation, and production teams.

  • Independently plan and execute assigned activities, communicating progress, risks, and dependencies.

  • Share technical knowledge, contribute to design reviews, and support continuous improvement across the team.

What we offer

  • Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.

  • A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package.

  • 30 days of holiday per year.

  • Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.


Qualifications

  • BSc (HBO) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in hardware testing, test engineering, prototyping, or lab work on electronic or electro-optical products.

  • Hands-on experience with laboratory instruments such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, and data loggers; experience with optical power meters is an advantage.

  • Experience executing test plans and procedures, logging and analyzing measurement data, and documenting results in clear test reports.

  • Good soldering and rework skills for through-hole and SMD components, including building custom cables and harnesses, and the ability to read schematics, PCB layouts, wiring diagrams, and assembly drawings.

  • Experience with or good understanding of environmental testing (e.g. temperature, thermal cycling, vibration) and of EMC/ESD principles.

  • Python skills for test automation, instrument control, and data analysis; experience with LabVIEW, embedded Linux or similar tools is advantageous.

  • Awareness of ESD-safe working practices and lab safety, including laser safety, or willingness to be trained.

  • A structured, practical, and hands-on working style, and real enjoyment of testing, finding problems, and getting hardware to work.

  • Good communication skills in English and a collaborative working style.

  • Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance.

Preferred

  • Experience with fiber handling, connector cleaning and inspection, and fusion splicing.

  • Experience with EMC pre-compliance measurements (e.g. EN 55032/CISPR 32 emissions, IEC 61000-4-x immunity) or environmental test standards (e.g. IEC 60068, MIL-STD-810).

  • IPC certification (e.g. IPC-A-610 or IPC J-STD-001) or experience with ESD control programs (IEC 61340-5-1).

  • Experience developing production test setups, test jigs, or programming fixtures, or supporting NPI and production transfer with electronics manufacturing partners.

  • Experience in multidisciplinary high-tech product development (e.g. sensing, photonics, instrumentation, defence, or subsea).

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal



This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead



Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority.

We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:

"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer."

If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.

Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.

And be prepared to change your own mind too.

The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.

Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.

You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.

But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded.

The Technical Challenge



Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.

At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.

Our backend estate includes:


  • .NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.
  • TypeScript services.

  • Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Cloudflare platform services.
  • API-first architecture.
  • Git-based development workflows.


We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.

We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.

We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.

What You'll Do



You'll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to:


  • Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.
  • Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.
  • Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.
  • Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.
  • Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.
  • Champion security, quality, testing, observability, resilience and performance.
  • Identify technical risks and help teams navigate them.
  • Evaluate technologies and patterns based on their value to SchemeServe rather than their popularity elsewhere.
  • Balance long-term engineering quality with short-term business needs.

  • Be a generally awesome person.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems and API design.
  • Experience with mature legacy applications and modern service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong cloud architecture experience, ideally Azure.
  • Excellent understanding of databases, security, testing, maintainability and modern software delivery.
  • Experience shaping engineering principles and practices across teams.
  • A track record of making engineers around you better through mentoring, coaching and technical leadership.
  • The ability to challenge experienced engineers constructively without becoming a gatekeeper.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held – the confidence to challenge and the humility to change your mind.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to influence without relying on authority.
  • Excellent technical judgement, balancing quality, complexity, risk, cost and business value.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who asks:

"What's the right solution for us?"

rather than:

"What's the way everyone else is doing it?"

Nice To Have


  • Experience modernising large monolithic applications.
  • Commercial TypeScript backend experience.
  • Cloudflare or edge technology experience.
  • SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Financial services, insurance or another regulated industry.
  • Observability, platform engineering or SRE experience.

You don't need to tick every box.

If you've got the technical depth, judgement and ability to make engineers around you better, we'd rather have a conversation than lose a great candidate because you haven't used one particular technology.

What Success Looks Like



Within your first year:


  • Engineers are making stronger technical and architectural decisions with greater confidence.
  • Our engineering principles are understood rather than blindly followed.

  • Security, reliability, maintainability and performance concerns are identified earlier.

Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

The role

You will report directly to the CTO and work alongside engineering, product, legal engineering and AI from the start. Your direct team is small today, three designers, and you will shape how it grows from here.

Your starting point is not a design backlog handed to you in advance. It is the product strategy, growth ambition, and AI-first operating model, and you will use that context to set the design agenda.

Orbital is at an inflection point. The product is live and trusted by some of the most demanding real estate legal professionals in the world. The challenge now is not building something from scratch but making it significantly better: cleaner, faster, and genuinely easier to trust. As the product scales across the UK and US, the design function needs to grow with it, and you will be the person who builds it.

What you'll do

Lead from the product.

Your first team is the product engineering leadership team. You will be part of product, commercial, and strategic conversations, bringing a strategic design perspective to business challenges rather than representing the design function in isolation. From there, you will form your own view on where the product experience is constraining growth, where the interface is creating friction for users, and what needs to change. You will help the leadership team pressure-test product decisions against user reality, spot where information architecture, interaction patterns, or visual clarity are becoming bottlenecks, and ensure that how we design is aligned with where the business is heading.

Set the design agenda from product context.

You will not be given a predefined project list. You will assess what you learn from the product, the users, and the business and set the design priorities from there. That means making sure areas like information architecture, interaction design, design systems, user research, and AI interface patterns are pointed at the right problems and prioritised accordingly. A major part of the brief is translating current product realities into a sharper design mandate and challenging existing assumptions when the evidence demands it.

Define what AI-native design looks like here.

The hardest design problems at Orbital are not aesthetic. They are epistemic. How do you help a real estate lawyer trust an AI output enough to put their name to it? How do you present the reasoning behind a 50-document analysis in a way that a partner can review in 20 minutes? How do you make agentic behaviour feel controllable to a professional who is accountable for the outcome? You will set the standard for how Orbital answers those questions, shape the interaction patterns that distinguish our product from everything else in the market, and hold the wider team accountable for the quality of the experience we ship.

Build the design function.

You will be the consistent presence the design team anchors around. You will invest in their growth, develop clear ownership within the function, and be accountable for the team's development over time, not just its immediate output. Over time you will shape a high-leverage design function that combines strong craft, deep user understanding, and a genuine instinct for where AI changes the rules.

Requirements

The must-haves

  • Significant experience leading product design at a senior level at a scaling B2B tech company. You bring real depth across the design discipline. That foundation is essential, but what sets you apart is the ability to operate beyond it.

  • A track record of sitting at the product leadership table and influencing business decisions, not just delivering a design agenda within one.

  • Experience scaling a design function through a high-growth phase, with the judgment to know what process and structure matters at each stage and what slows you down.

  • You have designed AI-native products. Not tools with AI bolted on. You have worked through the real problems: explainability, trust, agentic UX, confidence signals. You have opinions formed from real experience.

  • You have designed for expert professional users, people who know their domain better than any designer ever will, and you understand how to design for that dynamic without condescending or oversimplifying.

  • Strong commercial instincts. You understand how product design affects adoption, retention, and revenue, and you can connect design decisions to business outcomes.

  • The ability to translate product context into a design strategy and challenge existing priorities when the evidence demands it.

  • Experience leading through a design team, setting direction and standards without owning every deliverable.

And a few nice-to-haves

  • Direct experience of a Series B to Series C growth journey.

  • Built a design function from an early-stage base rather than inherited one.

  • Familiarity with legal tech, fintech, compliance tech or another domain where precision and professional accountability shape every design decision.

  • Experience building or significantly evolving a design system that improved team velocity at scale.

Why you'll love it here

  • You will join a company at a genuine inflection point, with real influence at the product engineering leadership table from day one.

  • You will shape the design function rather than inherit one, with room to build it around craft, research, and AI-first thinking.

  • The design problems here are some of the most interesting and challenging in the market.

  • You will be part of a collaborative, highly ambitious team where the standard is high and the ownership is real.

Benefits 🌟

🧑 💻 We believe in flexibility, but we're also big on in-person collaboration. This role is based in our London office with an expectation of multiple days in the office per week. It's about being present when it matters, and balancing autonomy with commitment.

🏢 Equity options in a fast-growing startup

🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

📚 Personal development budget and learning opportunities

🍔 Free lunch on Wednesdays and Deliveroo budget for late nights

🚲 Cycle-to-work scheme

📚 A bias toward experimentation, rapid learning, and iterating quickly based on real feedback

We're in the process of building an inclusive, welcoming culture where everyone feels seen and valued. Expect regular team off-sites, shared lunches, and social events, with something for everyone.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

title: Head of Digital Growth & E-Commerce – D2C / Health & Wellness (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst nicht einfach ein weiteres Marketing‑Board leiten, du willst das komplette digitale Wachstum eines Premium‑D2C‑Marktes eigenverantwortlich steuern.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Marken‑Auftritte, hier geht es um messbare Profitabilität, Skalierung und direkte Impact‑Entscheidungen.

Unser Kunde

Ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen im Gesundheits‑ und Wellness‑Segment, das Premium‑Nahrungsergänzungen und naturheilkundliche Produkte direkt an End‑Kunden verkauft. Mit rund 60 Mitarbeitenden und einem Jahresumsatz im siebenstelligen Bereich agiert es als D2C‑Marktführer in Deutschland. Das Unternehmen kombiniert schnelle Entscheidungswege, hohe Investitionsbereitschaft und ein starkes Gesundheits‑ und Nachhaltigkeits‑Commitment.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Hohe Vergütung bis zu 120 k € + 10–20 % Bonus – deine Leistung wird direkt belohnt

  • Vollständige Budget‑ und P&L‑Verantwortung – du bestimmst, wo das Geld hinfließt

  • Direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung – kurzer Entscheidungsweg, großer Impact

  • Skalierung eines Premium‑D2C‑Marktes im Health‑&‑Wellness‑Segment – Wachstum mit Sinn

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aktive Neukundenakquise: SEA/Google Ads, Paid Social, SEO strategisch steuern

  • Budgetverteilung: Wirtschaftlichen Beitrag bewerten, neue Kanäle und GEOs priorisieren

  • Testing Framework etablieren: Zielgruppen, Creatives und Landingpages systematisch testen und skalieren

  • E‑Commerce‑Roadmap verantworten: Customer Journey, PDPs, Navigation, Merchandising, Checkout optimieren

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im D2C‑E‑Commerce, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in derselben Firma, mit nachweisbarem, profitablen Wachstum über mehrere Jahre

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Unnachweisbare KPI‑Erfolge – wir brauchen harte Zahlen, nicht vage Aussagen

  • Häufige Jobwechsel alle 1-2 Jahre (Job‑Hopper) – absoluter Dealbreaker

  • Fehlende Deutschkenntnisse auf C2‑Niveau – Kommunikation muss präzise sein

Deine Benefits

  • Attraktives Gesamtpaket: €80–120 k Fixgehalt + 10–20 % Bonus, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und zusätzlicher Wachstumsbonus

  • Hybrid‑Modell: 2 Home‑Office‑Tage pro Woche, flexible Arbeitszeiten, 31 Urlaubstage

  • Jahres‑Gesundheitsgutschein, 25 % Mitarbeiterrabatt, Corporate‑Benefits‑Programm, Mental‑Health‑Support (OpenUp)

  • Moderne Büroausstattung: kostenlose Wasser‑ und Matcha‑Flatrate in allen Küchen

  • Regelmäßige Team‑Events und Firmenausflüge – Gemeinschaft wird gelebt

  • Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – schnelle Entscheidungen, hoher Gestaltungsspielraum

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Vollständige Ownership über Budget, Strategie und Ergebnis – du bestimmst die Richtung

  • Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Head of Digital Growth & E-Commerce – D2C / Health & Wellness (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Head of Growth, Head of E‑Commerce, Director of Digital Growth, Head of Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing Lead, E‑Commerce Director heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du nachweisbare D2C‑Erfolge, starke kommerzielle Urteilskraft und eine Hands‑on‑Mentalität mitbringst.

title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende Immoblien-Intelligence-Plattform für ESG und Wert-Management in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Als Head of Engineering übernimmst du die Führung unseres aktuell rund 10-köpfigen Engineering-Teams und baust es weiter aus. Du hilfst deinem Team, ambitioniert zu liefern: kontinuierliche Verbesserungen für unsere bestehenden Kunden, aber auch neue Prototypen und Innovationen, die unser Geschäftsmodell erweitern. Gleichzeitig sorgst du für Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit im Team, damit alle jeden Tag ein Stück besser werden.

Du bist ein starker Sparringspartner und denkst in Systemen: Gemeinsam mit unserem C-Level, dem Product- und Data-Team sowie unseren Kunden entwickelst du unsere Produktstrategie weiter und findest technisch tragfähige, smarte Lösungen. Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik.

Technisch baust du unsere Architektur so, dass sie mit uns skaliert und Raum für Innovation lässt - etwa bei der Integration von AI-Komponenten und Datenpipelines. Dabei hast du bei uns freie Hand: Neues ausprobieren, den Tech-Stack weiterentwickeln und auch Kapazität für technisches Fundament und Tech Debt einplanen.

So hilfst du auch unseren Sales- und Customer-Success-Teams, neue Kunden zu gewinnen - und baust dir damit deine eigene User- und Fan-Base auf. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

Tech-Stack: TypeScript (Full Stack, React im Frontend, NestJS im Backend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL RDS, AWS ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, Claude

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Du holst das Beste aus agentic engineering raus und erweiterst zusammen mit deinem Team die Plattform um eine 360°-Sicht auf die Immobilie.
  • Du hast das Team schneller liefern lassen - indem du es unterstützt, die Can-do-Mentalität stärkst und den Fokus auf die wirklich wichtigen Dinge setzt - bei Produkten und Architektur-Projekten.
  • Du hast das Team um starke Talente erweitert.
  • Du weißt, was jede Person in deinem Team antreibt - und hast ihr geholfen, die eigene Performance aufs nächste Level zu heben.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Software-Engineering-Führung und -Architektur, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz beim Skalieren von Engineering-Teams bei gleichzeitig hoher Shipping-Geschwindigkeit - idealerweise in einem Nicht-Konzernumfeld.
  • Du liebst es, Teams wachsen zu lassen, sie in ihrer Entwicklung zu unterstützen und ihnen gleichzeitig ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen.
  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit den genannten Frontend- und Backend-Technologien sowie modernen Tech-Stacks - nicht, indem du alles selbst codest, sondern indem du dein Team befähigst.
  • Du denkst in Systemen und löst Probleme konsequent aus einer First-Principles-Perspektive.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau bzw. C1 und fließend Englisch.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Team, Architektur, ein Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar: im Revenue, im Produkt und darin, wie das Engineering-Team in einem Jahr arbeitet.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 3,5 Tage/Woche.

30 Urlaubstage · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · Team-Events
