title: Investment Director - Property Sales
descriptionHtml:
We are building the operating system and wealth management platform for buy-to-let investing. Our mission is to make professional, institutional-grade property investing open to everyone.

GetGround is the all-in-one UK property investment platform. Investors use it to set up and run limited companies, arrange mortgages, manage lettings, handle accounting and tax, and track performance in one place.

  • Over £2.5bn of property administered on the platform

  • 30,000+ active customers and a database of 120,000+ property investors

  • A network of 1,700+ partners, including lenders, mortgage brokers, financial advisers, accountants and tax specialists

  • Offices in the UK, Hong Kong, Singapore and Dubai

  • Backed by leading FinTech and WealthTech investors and angels

BuyAssociation brings 20 years of direct-to-developer relationships. That gives our investors access to some of the best investment property in the market, often before it reaches the open market.

Together, we cover the full investor journey: find the right asset, buy it in the right structure, then let the platform manage and grow it.

Why join us

If you've built a career in property sales and want to move into AI-first fintech and proptech, this is your chance. You keep doing what you're great at – selling property – but with a far stronger proposition behind you.

  • Sell more than a property. Every deal comes with a full ownership solution: company structure, finance, lettings, management and reporting, all run by GetGround.

  • Better stock, warmer leads. BuyAssociation's developer relationships give you access to quality stock. Our 120,000+ investor database, partner network and marketing engine keep your pipeline full.

  • AI-first tooling. We build with AI at the core, so you spend less time on admin and more time with clients.

  • Long-term relationships, not one-off sales. Investors stay on the platform, so you can grow with them from their first property to a full portfolio.

  • Enterprise exposure. In 2026 we expanded into enterprise B2B partnerships. You'll sell to institutional clients alongside private investors – experience that is rare in property sales.

  • Startup pace, real scale. A fast-moving team disrupting a traditional industry, with £2.5bn+ of property already on the platform.

  • Uncapped earnings. A very competitive base for the property industry, with unlimited commission potential.

What you'll do

You'll help investors acquire new assets for their portfolios, which GetGround then structures, manages and runs. You'll work across private investors and enterprise partners.

Investor sales

  • Own the full sales cycle, from first conversation to completion, for UK and international buy-to-let investors

  • Understand each investor's goals, budget and strategy, and match them with suitable stock from our developer network

  • Present the full GetGround proposition: ownership structure, mortgage, lettings and ongoing management

  • Manage a pipeline of inbound leads, database opportunities and partner referrals, and generate your own

  • Guide investors through reservation, legal, finance and completion, working with developers, solicitors and our in-house mortgage team

  • Build long-term relationships and grow investors from first purchase to multi-property portfolios

Enterprise and B2B sales

We are expanding into enterprise B2B partnerships. This opens up opportunities to sell to institutional clients, giving you exposure to B2B sales alongside our core B2C investor business.

Ways of working

  • Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets

  • Keep HubSpot up to date and use data to manage your pipeline and forecast

  • Share market insight with the Head of Investment Sales to shape stock, pricing and proposition

  • Stay current on the UK property market, developer launches and buy-to-let trends

What we're looking for

  • A proven track record in property sales – ideally new-build, off-plan or investment property

title: Investor Relations Associate
descriptionHtml:

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

The role
We're hiring an Investor Relations Associate to grow the investor side of Pairs: the family offices, VCs and strategic investors our founders raise from. You'll support our senior investor team on live mandates and, from day one, build relationships of your own. You don't need a decade of experience or an investing background. Apply through our short form. Tell us about the network you've built, how you built it, and roughly how many company-investor introductions you've made.

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. title: IT System Engineer (w/m/d), 80–100 %
descriptionHtml:
Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen.

Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht.

Über Dukers

Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen.

Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen.

Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson.

  • Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online.

  • Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig.

  • Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit.

  • Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt.

Womit du arbeitest

  • Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure

  • Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox

  • Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba

  • Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco

  • Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben

  • Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender

  • Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort

  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt.

Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze

Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung.

Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan.

Was dich bei Dukers erwartet

  • Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest.

  • Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv.

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn.

  • Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen.

  • Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit.

  • E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation.

  • Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung.

Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Wer eine Umgebung betreut, kennt sie am besten – also liegt die Entscheidung dort, wo das Wissen ist. Siehst du eine bessere Lösung, bringst du sie ein, und wir setzen sie gemeinsam um.

Lernen wir uns kennen

Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne.

Deine Ansprechpersonen:

  • Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen.

  • Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen.

title: Junior Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

You'll join a small but ambitious Legal team with a broad remit, working with every part of the business — from Product and Engineering to Credit Risk, Marketing and People. Lendable is an FCA-regulated lender operating in the UK, US and Mexico, so you'll get early exposure to regulated products and new markets. As Lendable grows, this role is focused on commercial contracts, product and corporate work. You'll own matters end to end, explain legal issues clearly to non-lawyers, and weigh the legal position against what the business is trying to achieve.

What you'll be doing

  • Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements. You'll lead on supplier and customer contracts, engagement letters and NDAs, and support on partnership and other strategic contracts as you build towards leading them

  • Manage our contract review process, including triaging incoming requests, providing templates and reviews, and managing the e-signature process (for example DocuSign) through to completion

  • Respond to day-to-day legal queries from the business and our counterparties

  • Drive process and knowledge management by building and maintaining document repositories, administering our contract management and AI tooling and helping us develop processes to support contract review and negotiation

  • Support on intellectual property matters and litigious matters as they arise

  • Take on company secretarial and governance work

  • Support corporate and transactional work, including KYC / due diligence requests and diligence reviews on corporate projects

  • Work closely with the rest of the Legal team to deliver timely, first-class legal support

How you’ll make an impact

  • You'll help drive the business forward by taking the initiative and embracing work beyond your comfort zone

  • You'll get to grips with new markets and financial products, bringing energy and curiosity to each new challenge


What we're looking for

  • NQ - 2PQE, qualified in England & Wales, or in another common law jurisdiction with relevant UK experience

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, including explaining legal issues to non-lawyers

  • Strong organisation: you can run multiple matters at once and prioritise them independently

  • Comfortable with pace and change, and keen to take ownership of a broad remit rather than a narrow specialism

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Junior TechOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Hozah

Hozah makes parking automatic. Our cameras recognise your car when you arrive and payment happens by itself when you leave. No apps, no machines, no tickets. We were named PayTech Company of the Year, we sit in Deloitte's list of the 50 fastest growing tech companies in the UK, and we are expanding our estate of automated car parks across the country.

Every site runs on ANPR cameras, payment kiosks, edge devices and 4G connectivity, and all of it has to work around the clock. The TechOps team keeps that estate healthy, and we are looking for a junior engineer to join it.

The role

You will be hands-on from day one, helping to monitor, maintain and fix the technology running in car parks across the country. When a camera drops offline, a kiosk misbehaves or a site stops reporting data, you will be part of the team that works out why and puts it right, usually remotely.

You will learn a genuinely broad set of skills in one role: networking, IoT devices, monitoring, APIs, databases and cloud systems, all on a live estate where your work has visible impact the same day. You will be coached and supported as you grow, with clear standards, documented processes and experienced engineers around you.

What you'll be doing

  • Monitoring the health of cameras, kiosks and network equipment across 150+ car parks, and acting when something looks wrong.

  • Diagnosing and fixing faults across devices, networks and our backend platform, working through problems methodically.

  • Preparing, configuring and shipping hardware for new sites, and supporting site launches.

  • Keeping inventory, configuration records and documentation accurate and up to date.

  • Managing your tickets in Jira with clear notes, sensible prioritisation and proper follow-through.

  • Learning constantly: from the TechOps team, from our developers, and from the estate itself.

What we're looking for

This is a junior role. We care more about fundamentals, honesty and appetite to learn than years of experience.

  • Around 1–2 years of hands-on experience in IT support, infrastructure or technical operations, or strong fundamentals you can demonstrate from projects, a home lab or study.

  • Networking basics you can explain in plain English: what a switch and a router do, what an IP address is, what a VPN is for.

  • A structured instinct when something goes offline: check power, check the network, check the device, in that order.

  • Some awareness of APIs and SQL. You do not need to be fluent; knowing what they are and wanting to use them is enough.

  • Solid Windows knowledge: event logs, command line, system configuration.

  • Organised, reliable and calm when something breaks on a live site.

What this role isn't

  • Corporate IT support. The users of our systems are cameras and cars, and the work is looking after a distributed technology estate.

  • A narrow role. You will touch hardware, networking, software and data in the same week.

  • A dead end. The team is growing, the estate is growing, and there is a clear path to more senior TechOps work as you develop.

Salary, location and working pattern

  • 4 days a week in our Croydon office, 1 day from home, with occasional site visits.

  • Free breakfast, lunch, drinks and snacks in the office, excellent transport links, and two friendly office dogs.

  • You will need the right to work in the UK. A full UK driving licence is handy for site visits.

Die Wiese Dental Beratungs GmbH unterstützt Gesundheitsunternehmen beim Wachstum mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Personalgewinnung und Mitarbeiterbindung. Unser Team arbeitet in München-Bogenhausen in den Bavaria Towers auf 800 qm Fläche an messbaren Ergebnissen für Unternehmen der Gesundheitsbranche.

Kundenmanagement | Beschwerdemanagement | Leistungsorientierte Vergütung

Du kannst gut mit Menschen umgehen, lässt dich auch von schwierigen Gesprächen nicht aus der Ruhe bringen und möchtest, dass sich dein Einsatz finanziell auszahlt? Dann bist du bei Visidental genau richtig!

Wir suchen eine kommunikationsstarke, durchsetzungsfähige und strukturierte Persönlichkeit, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Freude daran hat, auch anspruchsvolle Kundenbeziehungen professionell zu betreuen.

Bei uns erwartet dich keine klassische Kundenservice-Stelle, in der du den ganzen Tag dieselben Anfragen abarbeitest. Du erhältst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, betreust Kunden eigenständig und hast die Möglichkeit, deine Ergebnisse und damit auch deine finanzielle Entwicklung aktiv zu beeinflussen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Kundenbetreuung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für einen definierten Kundenbereich und bist Ansprechpartner für Kundenanliegen, Rückfragen und Beschwerden.

  • Professionelles Beschwerdemanagement: Du kümmerst dich um anspruchsvolle Kundenanliegen, findest passende Lösungen und führst auch schwierige Gespräche souverän und zielorientiert.

  • Schriftliche Kommunikation: Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Kommunikation per E-Mail. Je nach Situation führst du ergänzend Telefonate oder Videogespräche.

  • Strukturierte Fallbearbeitung: Du analysierst Sachverhalte, priorisierst Anliegen, dokumentierst Vereinbarungen und sorgst dafür, dass offene Vorgänge konsequent bearbeitet werden.

  • Wirtschaftliches Kundenmanagement: Du behältst neben der Kundenzufriedenheit auch die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen im Blick und triffst Entscheidungen mit Augenmaß.

  • Zielorientiertes Arbeiten: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich auf gemeinsam vereinbarte Ziele hin und kannst dir durch deine Leistung attraktive zusätzliche Vergütungen sichern.

Das bringst du mit

Wir suchen keinen bestimmten Lebenslauf, sondern die richtige Persönlichkeit.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst dich schriftlich hervorragend ausdrücken und findest auch in schwierigen Situationen die richtigen Worte.

  • Durchsetzungsvermögen: Du kannst freundlich, aber bestimmt kommunizieren, Grenzen setzen und deinen Standpunkt souverän vertreten.

  • Belastbarkeit: Beschwerden, Kritik oder Ablehnung bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept. Du nimmst Dinge nicht persönlich und behältst einen kühlen Kopf.

  • Struktur und Organisation: Du kannst mehrere Vorgänge parallel bearbeiten, behältst den Überblick und arbeitest zuverlässig.

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du verstehst komplexere Sachverhalte schnell, erkennst Zusammenhänge und findest eigenständig praktikable Lösungen.

  • Wirtschaftliches Denken: Du hast ein Gespür für sinnvolle Entscheidungen und arbeitest gerne ergebnisorientiert.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden Schritt vorgibt, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Dinge selbstständig zum Abschluss.

Erfahrungen im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement, Vertrieb, Account Management oder in der kaufmännischen Sachbearbeitung sind von Vorteil. Auch motivierte Quereinsteiger mit der passenden Persönlichkeit sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Das bieten wir dir

Deine Leistung soll sich lohnen.

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Du erhältst eine Kombination aus fixer Vergütung und leistungsabhängigen zusätzlichen Verdienstmöglichkeiten.

  • Überdurchschnittliches Einkommenspotenzial: Bei entsprechender Zielerreichung und überdurchschnittlicher Performance sind attraktive zusätzliche Einkünfte möglich. Deine Entwicklung ist dabei nicht ausschließlich an klassische Gehaltserhöhungen gebunden.

  • Transparente Zielvereinbarungen: Deine Leistung wird anhand gemeinsam definierter Ziele bewertet. Gute Ergebnisse werden finanziell honoriert.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du erhältst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und kannst deine Arbeit selbstständig gestalten.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen und dich weiterentwickeln möchtest, stehen dir bei uns entsprechende Perspektiven offen.

  • Wiese Dental-Benefits: Zusätzlich profitierst du von unseren weiteren Mitarbeiterangeboten und Arbeitgeberleistungen.

Wen wir besonders suchen

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht bei jeder kritischen E-Mail nervös wird, sondern sich denkt: „Das bekomme ich gelöst.“

Jemanden, der freundlich bleiben kann, ohne sich alles gefallen zu lassen. Der gerne kommuniziert, aber auch weiß, wann eine klare Ansage notwendig ist. Und jemanden, der nicht nur seine Aufgaben erledigen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen und sich durch gute Leistung auch finanziell weiterentwickeln möchte.

Du erkennst dich darin wieder? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Bewirb dich jetzt bei Wiese Dental als Kundenmanager (m/w/d).

descriptionHtml:
Über batterium

Seit 2011 arbeiten mittlerweile über 70 Mitarbeiter tagtäglich daran, dass wir unseren Kunden starke und innovative Produkte zu einem fairen Preis bieten können.

Im Bereich ECTIVE entwickeln und vertreiben wir Produkte und Systemlösungen für mobile und autarke Stromversorgung im Caravaning-Bereich - von Lithium-Batterien über Wechselrichter und Ladegeräte bis hin zu vernetzten Systemlösungen.

Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kunden, beantwortest ihre Fragen und findest schnelle Lösungen für ihre Anliegen. title: LCA Working Student
descriptionHtml:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Join our LCA team as a Working Student (10-20 h/week) and support the work that sits underneath every Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) we produce. Your focus will be raw material matching, the backbone of every EPD and LCA. You will work with the ecoinvent database and our Emidat Ecomapping tool, and research LCA topics such as product category rule (PCR) requirements. You'll gain hands-on experience supporting the day-to-day LCA team, who are responsible for the correct calculation of LCA results in the Emidat App.
At the same time, you'll dive into the building materials industry itself — getting to know manufacturers of cement, steel, windows, construction chemicals, asphalt, electronic building equipment, and many more, and understanding how differently each of them approaches EPDs and LCAs. This gives you insight into a diverse product spectrum with different peculiarities from an LCA perspective, which is valuable for building broader experience in LCA.
There is also the long-term opportunity to support and supervise a practical master's thesis within the Emidat environment. Our LCA team has experience supervising academic theses.

In the first 6 months, you will

  • Match raw materials: Carry out raw material matchings, mapping the product's input materials to the ecoinvent database. Ecoinvent is the most widely used environmental database for LCA worldwide, so in-depth knowledge of it is a core advantage for working with LCAs. In the material mapping, you'll be supported by our Emidat Ecomapping tool.

  • Research LCA topics: Look into LCA questions as they come up, such as PCR requirements. Experience the process of translating LCA calculation rules into software logic that delivers both correct results and usability for customers.

  • Support the LCA team: Back up the LCA team in its day-to-day business. Gain first insights into customer requests with varying levels of LCA experience — a crucial skill for working as, e.g., an LCA consultant.

What you will bring to this role

Minimum requirements

  • Studies: You are enrolled in a degree programme in LCA, sustainability, chemistry or materials science.

  • First LCA experience: Experience working with Life Cycle Assessments, whether through coursework, a thesis, an internship or preferably, a previous intern/working student role.

  • Database: Hands on experience using the Ecoinvent database to make assessments, or run matchings

  • AI native: Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate a workflow, analyse data, or accelerate a deliverable — comfortable experimenting with new AI features as they emerge.

  • Project Management: Demonstrated previous experience taking projects from start to finish - owning, structuring and driving the measurable outcomes.

  • Languages: Business fluent in English (C1/C2).

Nice to have’s

  • Language: Fluency in German.

  • Experience: Working with Emidat or another common LCA software

  • Industry Interest: Relevant work experience, education or interest in the sector. Demonstrated through engagement with climate topics, the building materials / construction industry, or how software can capture complex technical processes.

How we support you

Your manager / team lead will be

  • Benedikt Dellawalle - Team Lead, LCA

You will work closely with

  • Anna Sander-Titgemeyer, LCA Expert

  • Jonas van der Ham, LCA Expert

  • Areeba Qureshi, LCA Expert

  • Elahe Shirkhan, LCA Expert

See our full benefits HERE, including;

  • 💸 Competitive hourly rate

  • 🏖️ 25 days of vacation days per year (pro rata)

  • 📚 €5,000 Learning Budget

Admin:

  • Role type: Part-Time Working Student, 10-20 hours per week

  • Start date & Length: ASAP, for a minimum 6 months

  • Location: Munich, Germany

  • Office Requirement: Office Based

  • Visa / Relocation: Preference will be given to candidates already based in Munich and that do not require visa sponsorship.

Compensation: €20 – €24 per hour

  • Working Student • Hourly rate €20 – €24 per hour

title: Lead AI Enablement Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Lead AI Enablement Engineer

Location: Belfast

Department: Engineering Enablement

Reports to: VP Enablement

Employment Type: Full time

About EverQuote

EverQuote’s vision is to make it more efficient to shop for and buy insurance with confidence. We use data, technology and marketplace expertise to connect insurance shoppers with providers and help our customers grow their businesses.

As AI becomes part of everyday work across the organisation, we want every colleague, technical or not, to get real value from it. Our enablement teams make that possible by turning new AI capabilities into reliable, trusted services.

About the team

The Lead AI Enablement Engineer sits within Engineering Enablement and owns the integration, usability and adoption of EverQuote’s enterprise AI services.

You will also partner with IT, Security and Platform Engineering on service support and controls, and with data owners on access, privacy and auditability.

About the role

Help everyone across our organisation get more value from AI. We are looking for a hands-on Lead AI Enablement Engineer to make our AI products and services connected, reliable and useful in everyday work across Finance, Operations, HR, Sales, Engineering and beyond.

We already use Claude, and there is significant opportunity to improve the experience through relevant features, connectors, skills and access to trusted knowledge. You will turn that opportunity into working services and practical ways of working that colleagues adopt and value, while evolving our capabilities as AI technology advances.

You will lead the technical integration and continuous improvement of these services, combining engineering depth with curiosity about LLMs and a strong customer focus. The role combines hands-on delivery with technical leadership and mentoring.

You will shape how an entire organisation works with AI. You will have the opportunity to explore new capabilities, turn promising ideas into dependable services and see the impact directly in colleagues’ daily work. Your technical decisions and customer insight will help define a new AI capability and how it evolves.

What you’ll do:

Own the AI service roadmap:

  • Understand how colleagues work and identify friction.
  • Prioritise improvements with department leads.
  • Treat technical and non-technical employees as customers, and test changes with them.

Integrate AI into everyday work

  • Configure and administer enterprise AI products.
  • Work closely with other enablement teams to make sure the tooling is fully integrated.
  • Work closely with InfoSec to make sure risks and standards have been met.
  • Build connectors, MCP integrations, APIs and lightweight services that connect approved tools, business systems and knowledge sources.
  • Keep permissions and data access aligned with users’ existing entitlements.

Turn new capabilities into useful services

  • Track model releases, product features and emerging tools.
  • Evaluate quality, usability, cost and risk against real tasks.
  • Recommend, pilot and roll out improvements with clear guidance and a way to reverse unsuccessful changes.

Create reusable capabilities

  • Make skills, shared instructions, workflow templates and agents discoverable, with clear owners, testing and version control.
  • Help teams adapt proven approaches to their own work.

Show colleagues what is possible

  • Run practical demonstrations, workshops, office hours and hands-on sessions using real business workflows.
  • Build a network of departmental champions.
  • Make guidance accessible to different confidence and skill levels.

Own the end-user experience

  • Monitor integration health, answer quality and user feedback.
  • Investigate failures and recurring friction.
  • Coordinate fixes, vendor escalations, change communications and support arrangements with IT, Security and Platform Engineering.

Provide technical leadership

  • Establish integration and evaluation standards.
  • Mentor others and shape vendor decisions.
  • Continuously keep up to date with the latest LLM releases and harnesses to better inform the direction of the organisation.
  • Partner with Security and data owners on access, privacy, auditability and safe tool use.

What we’re looking for:

  • 10 years experience in software development with 3+ years in AI
  • Strong hands-on engineering experience building and supporting integrations, internal tools or enterprise services: you write maintainable code, work with APIs and authentication, and diagnose problems across connected systems.
  • Practical experience applying LLMs and AI tools to real workflows used by other people, with an understanding of context, retrieval, tool use and evaluation, the limits of model outputs, and when human review is needed.
  • A sustained interest in AI tooling, demonstrated through experimentation and working solutions. You follow developments actively and can explain which changes are worth adopting, which need more testing and which add little value.
  • A customer-focused approach: you listen, observe how work happens and stay involved until the solution is useful. You can support a non-technical colleague and discuss integration trade-offs with an engineer.
  • Evidence of technical leadership, prioritisation and cross-functional delivery: you can turn broad needs into a practical roadmap, set standards and bring others with you through coaching and clear communication.
  • Experience delivering reliable services with appropriate access controls, testing, monitoring and documentation, and taking ownership of how a capability performs after launch.
  • You do not need experience with every product or tool listed, but experience in several would be valuable:
    • Claude Enterprise or similar enterprise AI products.
    • MCP, reusable skills and agent workflows.
    • Enterprise search and knowledge integration.
    • Python or TypeScript.
    • AWS.
    • SaaS administration, SSO and OAuth.
    • AI adoption programmes and communities of practice.

How you work

You put customers first: You observe how work actually happens, test changes with the people who will use them and stay involved until the solution is useful.

You are evidence-led: You evaluate new capabilities against real tasks, establish baselines with users and use evidence to improve or retire capabilities.

You stay curious: You experiment, follow developments in AI and separate changes worth adopting from those that add little value.

You own the outcome: You take responsibility for how a capability performs after launch, not only for getting it live.

You bring others with you: You mentor, set standards and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues, with departmental champions and with vendors.

What success looks like:

In your first 90 days, you will have:

  • Assessed our current AI services, feature availability, integration gaps and user experience.
  • Agreed a prioritised roadmap.
  • Delivered a small set of valuable integrations and reusable workflows across several departments.
  • Established practical enablement sessions and a feedback loop.

Over time, success means:

  • Sustained adoption across business functions.
  • Reliable integrations.
  • Better user satisfaction.
  • Measurable improvements in task time or output quality.

You will establish baselines with users, track cost alongside benefit, and use evidence to improve or retire capabilities. Feature launches and licence activation alone are not measures of success.

Our values

At EverQuote, how we achieve results matters as much as the results themselves.

  • Be Tenacious: We aim high, move quickly and persist through difficult technical and organisational problems.
  • Help Customers Win: We prioritise work that creates meaningful and sustainable value for our customers.
  • Follow the Data: We use evidence to guide decisions and measure outcomes.
  • Strengthen Our Team: We communicate directly, share knowledge and leave teams and systems stronger than we found them.

Equal opportunity

EverQuote is committed to equal opportunity employment and to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and consider qualified candidates without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law.

Reasonable Adjustments

We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations at any stage of the interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to arrange them.

or more information, visit https://investors.everquote.com and follow on LinkedIn.

  • Kommunikation: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Entscheidungen verständlich zu vermitteln. 

Du hast genug davon, bestehende Strukturen nur Stück für Stück zu optimieren und möchtest wieder etwas von Grund auf aufbauen? Dann ist jetzt der richtige Zeitpunkt, deine Erfahrung in eine neu entstehende IT-Architektur einzubringen.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention. 

About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Lead Country Commercial Manager to scale revenue growth across our Accounting, Tax and Payroll products (part of our BMS suite, known internally as ‘Admin Services’) and build an indirect distribution channel via Partners & Accountants.

You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams (mainly Marketing, Product, Finance) to understand funnel conversion, campaign(s) performance and product prioritisation, whilst owning competitor and market insight and leading new product go-to-market (GTM) launch plans. Excellent organisation, strategy and communication skills essential.

Key areas of this role:

  • Revenue Ownership & Forecasting: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine commercial projections for the Accounting, Tax & Payroll products ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.
  • Accountants Strategy & GTM planning: Research UK Accountants market and build a clear, concise and financially robust indirect model to help Tide scale their BMS products and others with Accountants.
  • Competitor and Market insight: Regularly analyse key competitor movements and wider industry trends - relevant to Accounting, Tax, Payroll and Accountants - translating insight into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition.

  • Product Development: Partner with the Product teams to assess opportunities to shape product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting  successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.
  • Launch Strategy: Support new feature launches across channels and operational teams to deliver best-in-class experiments. 
  • Stakeholder Management: High levels of communication with a wide range of stakeholders, including Tide’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives.
  • Member Obsession: You will be or become an expert in the core motivations of our members in order to focus on bringing their voice to commercial and product design discussions.

What we are looking for 

  • Strong commercial acumen:  Proven experience in driving commercial impact, partnering with finance to understand performance and identify opportunities to improve.  Able to set and track clear KPIs across all initiatives to meet revenue goals.
  • Accountancy software experience: Understanding of software and experience scaling software at either an Accountancy software company or with Accountants.
  • 5+ years’ experience leading ‘always on’ activity to drive commercial performance.   This will ideally be with specific experience in Accounting, Invoicing or Expense Management products, ideally in a fintech environment – key is demonstrated ability to plan and deliver consistent activity that drives commercial impact.
  • Strong analytical mindset: Able to review and interpret data to develop hypotheses and assumptions, turning insights into clear, actionable plans.
  • Proven GTM track record – delivering holistic, high impact omni-channel campaigns  (across sales, CRM, in-app contact points)
  • Exceptional project management skills, able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment.
  • Creative collaborator: Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence.
  • Self-starter attitude: Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift.

What you’ll get in return

title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

title: Lead / Principal Engineer - Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
A different kind of organisation

  • High trust, transparency, and autonomy
  • Small teams, high ownership, flat structures
  • Radical compensation transparency
  • Sense of ownership in collective success
  • Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft

The role

As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role  and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.

What the work looks like

We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:

  • Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.
  • Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.
  • Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.
  • Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.

What you'll do

Frame Problems & Propose Solutions

  • Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.
  • Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Lead Through Technical Excellence

  • Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.
  • Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems  and the practices that keep them that way.

Influence, Advise, and align

  • Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.
  • Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams
  • Converge competing priorities into a path forward.
  • Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.

Operate Across Technology Domains

Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.

You'll thrive here if

  • You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity.
  • You think in systems, not isolated parts.
  • You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you.
  • You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail.
  • You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast.
  • You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem.

What we're looking for

  • Demonstrable building software systems in complex environments.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot.
  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale.
  • Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs.
  • Direct experience working with customers and business stakeholders.

What will you experience in terms of culture at Sahaj?

  • A culture of trust, respect and transparency
  • Opportunity to collaborate with some of the finest minds in the industry
  • Work across multiple domains

What are the benefits of being at Sahaj?

  • Unlimited leaves
  • Life insurance & private health insurance
  • No hierarchy
  • Open Salaries

title: Lead Product Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo RetailTech
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business. C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Lead Product Manager, tu pilotes des projets produits complexes en portant la vision produit, en orchestrant le delivery et en garantissant la création de valeur pour le client comme pour les équipes. - Définir et porter la stratégie produit avec le client : modélisation de la valeur, architecture produit, EPICs, arbitrage des trade-offs et alignement technico-fonctionnel. - Assurer un delivery réussi en coordonnant plusieurs squads pour livrer des projets complexes dans les temps, le budget et le niveau de qualité attendu. - Créer les conditions de réussite des équipes en définissant le bon set-up (équipes Theodo ou partenaires), en négociant les moyens nécessaires et en adaptant l’organisation aux contraintes du projet. - Apporter de la visibilité et de la clarté via des dispositifs de gouvernance adaptés, pour aligner l’ensemble des parties prenantes. -Selon la composition de l'équipe, tu pourras être responsable de faire monter en compétence les Products Managers, en créant un environnement propice à leur réussite, leur montée en compétences et leur projection chez le client et/ou chez Theodo. - Garantir la satisfaction client sur le long terme, en construisant une relation de confiance, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités et en collaborant avec les équipes Sales, Staffing et People. Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. Tes perspectives d'évolution : Les voies qui s’ouvrent à toi ensuite : - devenir Group PM et manager les Lead PM d'un grand compte - t’orienter vers un rôle plus commercial sur d’autres grands comptes : Key Account Manager - mettre ton expertise de gestion de projets complexes à profit dans un rôle de COO ou CPO Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, avec plus de 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle, dont au moins 4 ans en product management (Senior PM / Lead PM / Head of Product), en startup, ESN ou cabinet de conseil. - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. - Excellente aisance relationnelle et client : capable de créer une relation de confiance, d’échanger avec des interlocuteurs de top management, et à l’aise dans des contextes grands comptes. - Posture client first : disponible, réactif·ve, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours, d’anticiper les besoins et de gérer des situations sensibles. - Solides compétences en négociation et management : écoute active, questionnement, capacité à challenger, à gérer le conflit et à délivrer des feedbacks exigeants avec calme et clarté, dans une logique de progression collective. - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

Saga is a legal innovation company on a mission to remove the friction between legal expertise and real-world impact, so lawyers can focus on what matters the most: people, ethics, and impact. Founded in Norway and built for the legal profession from day one, we integrate with local legal sources across multiple jurisdictions and are currently available in 12 languages. In just 18 months, we've grown to 80+ employees and 5,000+ users across 20+ countries - with market leadership in Norway and The Netherlands, and active expansion across Europe. We believe technology shouldn't replace legal reasoning, but strengthen it - so the law can work as it's meant to: aligned, accountable, and capable of delivering justice for everyone.

As we grow, we're looking for someone at an unusual and valuable intersection: a legal professional ready to step into thought leadership, marketing, growth, and technology - and help us speak credibly to legal professionals while opening doors into the communities where they already gather.

Your role as a Legal AI Growth Manager

Building trust in the legal profession starts with understanding the people behind it. That's why we're looking for a legal professional who can help Saga build meaningful relationships, strengthen our presence in the Dutch legal market and connect with the communities where legal professionals exchange ideas and knowledge.

As Saga's first Legal AI Growth Manager, you'll join the Marketing & Growth team and work closely with Legal Engineering, Sales and Product. This role is an opportunity for a jurist, paralegal, legal counsel or lawyer who's curious about taking their career beyond traditional legal practice, bringing their legal expertise and professional network into the world of technology, marketing and growth.

This is a new role with room to shape it. You'll have the freedom to explore ideas, build initiatives from the ground up and develop approaches that can grow with Saga.


What you'll be doing

  • Build relationships and partnerships with lawyers, law firms, bar associations, alumni networks and legal innovators across the Netherlands.

  • Create thought leadership and educational content, translating legal insights and practical AI use cases into relevant articles, interviews and campaigns.

  • Grow the legal community through roundtables, workshops, webinars and networking initiatives.

  • Represent Saga at legal events and conferences, building connections and identifying new opportunities.

  • Bring market insights and customer feedback into Marketing, Product and Legal Engineering.

  • Support go-to-market and product marketing, working with Sales and Marketing to communicate Saga's value to legal professionals.

  • Develop advocacy initiatives that turn engaged customers and community members into long-term champions of Saga.

What you'll bring

  • A legal education and professional experience as a lawyer, jurist, legal counsel, paralegal or in a similar role.

  • Familiarity with the Dutch legal market and connections through professional associations, networks or industry events.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make legal and technical topics clear and engaging.

  • A natural ability to connect people, build relationships and create opportunities

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, curiosity and confidence to take initiative.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools and an interest in how they're changing legal practice.

  • Native or near-native Dutch and fluent English.

Our team & culture

We're a team of lawyers, engineers, designers, and builders across multiple countries, with a startup mindset - flexible, fast-moving, and focused on what matters. We don't believe in rigid structures or unnecessary processes, but we do believe in discipline: showing up consistently, following through, and holding ourselves to a high standard.

Outside of work, many of us are active in sports - running, skiing, hiking - not as a mandate, but because we're drawn to the same mindset sport builds: consistency, resilience, and a long-term view. If you thrive in a flat, high-ownership environment, you'll feel right at home.

Why join Saga

Take your legal career in a new direction, without leaving your expertise behind.

You'll join an international team of lawyers, engineers, builders, and commercial professionals working to make legal AI genuinely useful and accessible. We keep structures light, encourage ownership and give people room to experiment, learn and make an impact.

  • Salary: Up to €5,500 gross per month (all-inclusive, based on a 40-hour week), depending on experience.

  • Career development: A transition into legal tech, marketing and growth, with support and mentorship.

  • Ownership: The opportunity to shape a new role and build initiatives from the ground up.

  • Learning budget: An annual budget for courses, conferences and development.

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working with our Amsterdam hub.

  • International team: An English-first environment with Norwegian roots and a growing European presence.

title: Legal Counsel, Commercial & IP
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

⚖️ Our Legal team

The Legal team is at the heart of Joko’s growth and protection. We navigate the complexities of contracts, regulations, and risk management to ensure the company operates smoothly and seizes opportunities with confidence.

We handle all legal matters: Contracts, Corporate, Labor, Data protection, IP etc… enabling other teams to innovate with confidence.

Leveraging our expertise and external partners, we collaborate with all functions to protect Joko’s interests efficiently and proactively.

🚀 What you will do

As Legal Counsel, Commercial & IP, you will work hand in hand with our business teams to negotiate the partnerships that drive Joko's growth, and you will own our contracts, IP, commercial disputes and insurance. You will report directly to the Head of Legal (Maya).

🛡️ IP and technology

  • Define the legal framework for Juno, our AI shopping assistant: our rights to merchant content and catalogue data, the use of third-party brands and logos in the app and our marketing, and the ownership of AI-generated content.

  • Protect the Joko brands across our markets with our IP counsel, from trademarks, domain names, oppositions and renewals to action against third parties that infringe our rights.

  • Work with Product and Marketing to secure new features and brands before they launch.

🤝 Deals and commercial relationships

  • Sit alongside the business teams in their negotiations with merchants and brands: partnership agreements, data-sharing contracts, CPG and B2B deals, and the contracts for our new business lines.

  • Structure our merchant and brand relationships so they hold up under French and EU rules on restrictive commercial practices, including significant imbalance and the abrupt termination of established commercial relationships.

  • Lead or support the negotiation of contracts on exclusivity, most-favoured-nation, competition law risks and parity clauses.

  • Build the templates, playbooks, red lines and fallback positions the business teams use every day, and turn them into AI skills.

⚖️ Disputes and risk

  • Handle disputes with merchants, partners and suppliers together with the teams who own the relationship, from formal notices to settlement, protecting both our position and the relationship.

  • Brief and manage our litigation counsel when a dispute goes to court.

  • Own our insurance programme (D&O, cyber, travel and any new line), from renewals to claims, and build an international programme with our brokers so coverage follows us into each new country.

🙌 Who you are

  • You have 4 to 6 years of experience in commercial or IP/IT law, including time in a top-tier law firm. In-house experience in a tech or consumer company is a strong plus.

  • You have negotiated complex commercial agreements directly with counterparties, in French and in English, and you enjoy it.

  • Experience in commercial disputes, restrictive commercial practices or IP/IT matters related to AI is a strong plus.

  • You understand how a business makes money, and you use the contract to support it rather than to slow it down.

  • You turn your positions into templates and playbooks that non-lawyers can use on their own.

  • You hold a Master's degree in business law, IP/IT law or contract law from a leading French law school. Admission to the Paris Bar is a plus.

  • You are fluent in French and English. Another European language is a plus.

  • You write clearly, you decide with incomplete information, and you like the pace of a scale-up.

  • You are curious about AI and want to learn how to build the tools that change legal work.

What we tell you upfront. Until the three poles are staffed, every Legal Counsel works across the full legal scope with the Head of Legal. Functional ownership is formalised as soon as the Commercial & IP and Product & Privacy seats are both filled.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €65K – €95K • Offers Equity
