title: Legal Engineer - Applied AI Knowledge
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

Legal AI is inventing its best practices in real time, and this role sits where that happens. You'll sit within the Legal Engineering team and work hand in hand with Product at one of the fastest-growing legal AI companies in the world, seeing new capabilities before almost anyone else, experimenting with them against real legal work, and turning what you learn into the standards a global function runs on. In a year here, you will see and vet more legal AI use cases than most people in the industry see in a career, working directly with some of the best legal engineers in the industry.

This is a judgement role, not a filing one. You'll be the person who vets the skills, workflows and use cases the function ships: testing them hands-on, separating the genuinely strong from the merely plausible, and quality-controlling practice-area workflows so that what carries the Legora name is consistently excellent. You'll research and experiment with prompting techniques and applied AI methods, author the exemplar use cases the rest of the function copies, and teach what you learn: delivering technical onboarding for new Legal Engineers in your region and broadcasting best practices to the team worldwide. And because judgement needs grounding, around 30% of your time stays on live client work, chosen for what it teaches.

Specifically, you will

• Vet the Skills Library and Legal Engineering outputs against the quality bar: review skills, workflows and use cases hands-on before they go live, and quality-control practice-area workflows for consistency.

• Research and experiment with prompting techniques, skill patterns and emerging AI methods, and turn what works into best practices the whole function adopts.

• Author the reference use cases that show what great looks like, published as the exemplars others copy.

• Work closely with the Product team on up-and-coming capabilities: early hands-on testing, the first best practices for new features, and structured feedback from real use.

• Produce materials that would support the technical onboarding and training for new Legal Engineers in your region, such as best practices to create use cases etc.

• Communicate new best practices, exemplars and platform changes to the Legal Engineering team worldwide.

• Support the flagship demos our CEO and C-suite take on stage at the industry’s biggest events: use case preparation, fixtures and rehearsal support.

• Oversee the quality and currency of the use case and skills libraries, including coordination across regions

• Spend roughly 30% of your time on live client work, selected for what it feeds back into the standards and libraries.

What you bring

You're a lawyer with real practice experience who has become genuinely technical: maybe you did a coding bootcamp, maybe you taught yourself, but either way you're the person colleagues ask how something actually works. You live in AI tools, and it shows: you can tell a strong use case from a plausible-sounding weak one, you know why a prompt underperforms before you've finished reading it, and you hold both halves of the judgement this role needs: what makes a prompt run well, and what makes a legal output substantively right rather than merely fluent. When you vet, you vet properly: line by line against the source, with the discipline to put the AI down when the job calls for your own eyes.

We're looking for

• A qualified lawyer with solid practice experience at a leading firm or in-house team, or equivalent: enough substantive judgement to vet outputs across practice areas.

• Real technical prowess: comfortable with code or scripting (a bootcamp or self-taught background counts entirely), and fluent in the mechanics of how AI tools actually behave.

• A heavy, habitual user of AI, ideally legal AI, with sharp prompt and use case discernment: able to rank a strong prompt against a mediocre one, articulate exactly why, and improve it.

• Visible pride in the craft of prompting and use case design: someone who wants to be the reference point for what good looks like.

• Rigour in review: line-by-line verification against source, and the judgement to know exactly when not to use AI.

• Comfortable running high-throughput workstreams: you triage well, keep many threads moving, and build process where volume demands it.

• Experience building skills, workflows or automations in a legal AI platform is a strong plus.

• Good to have: an M&A or wider transactional background, or deal coordination experience.

Where this role can go

This role is built to grow with the field itself. Applied legal AI knowledge barely exists as a discipline yet, and nobody accumulates evidence faster than the person vetting and testing the entire output of a global function. Do this job well and you are positioned to become one of the industry’s recognised voices on what good looks like. Inside Legora, the role is designed to grow into owning applied AI knowledge globally: the standards, techniques and systems every region operates on. Growth is subject to performance and company need, but the direction is deliberate: master the material here first, then define the standard for the industry.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
descriptionHtml:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.

This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.

We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.

How you’ll work

  • You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

  • You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.

  • You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab.

Key responsibilities:

Hybrid bioprocess modelling

  • Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data.

  • Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics.

  • Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data.

  • Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations.

  • Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings.

Transfer across organisms and scales

  • Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast.

  • Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data.

  • Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up.

Real-time Model-Predictive Control

  • Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically.

  • Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation).

  • Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts

  • Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity.

Qualifications:

  • PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience.

  • Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish.

  • Demonstrated evidence of research contributions, including (but not limited to): peer-reviewed journal or conference papers, conference attendance, open-source contributions.

  • Strong Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., PyTorch/JAX, scikit-learn).

  • Hands-on experience building models of dynamical systems or time-series data, ideally combining mechanistic and data-driven approaches.

  • Experience working with frontier coding models, including multi-agent orchestration.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-ML partners.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with bioprocess or fermentation data, ideally from bioreactors at more than one scale

  • Experience with Raman, NIR, or other spectroscopic data and chemometrics (e.g., PLS)

  • Background in model-predictive control, reinforcement learning, or optimal control

  • Experience with transfer learning, domain adaptation, or representation learning on biological data

  • Familiarity with genome-scale metabolic models or kinetic modelling

  • Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, or design of experiments

  • Experience in collaborative or publicly funded research projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, Eurostars)

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation through salary + stock options; we are looking to build a small but mighty team and think about compensation along those lines;

  • Build your research profile: Work on open problems with leading European academic and industrial partners, with the intention to present and publish your work;

  • A beautiful office in the heart of Munich, or remote work option with occasional travel

  • eGym WellPass membership

title: Managing Principal – Capital Markets
descriptionHtml:
Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

Nos marqueurs distinctifs

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte
    Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure
    Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence
    Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.
  • Un esprit “One Capco”
    Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive
    L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  1. Stratégie & Transformation
  2. Finance, Risque & Conformité
  3. Product, Innovation & Design
  4. Data & Analytics
  5. Conseil Tech (Advisory)
  6. Engineering (Delivery)

Descriptif du poste

En tant que Managing Principal au sein de Capco France dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients, Banque de Financement et d’Investissement, Asset Servicers et Asset Managers, en France et à l’international, afin de contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

En collaboration avec les autres partners en charge des comptes clients et nos practices, vous serez en charge d’identifier et de transformer de nouvelles opportunités d’affaires auprès de nos clients.

Dans ce cadre, vous piloterez également l’exécution des projets vendus, qui sont de nature complexe et à forte valeur ajoutée, couvrant l’un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants :

  • Transformation organisationnelle et opérationnelle : Redéfinir les modèles opérationnels, organisationnels et l’architecture fonctionnelle pour les départements de marchés de capitaux (Front, Middle, Back-office, Risques), déploiement de processus optimisés et alignés sur les meilleures pratiques du marché.
  • Cadrage et gestion de programmes complexes : superviser, du cadrage à la mise en œuvre, des plans moyen-termes et des projets de transformation à grande échelle (ex : refonte des systèmes, mise en conformité réglementaire, réorganisation…).
  • Accompagnement de projets réglementaires : Accompagner les clients dans la mise en conformité avec les principales réglementations des marchés de capitaux (MiFID 2, EMIR, Dodd-Frank, PRIIPS, SFTR, FATCA…).
  • Transformation Finance & Risques : Refonte des dispositifs de contrôle des risques (marché, contrepartie, crédit, opérationnels), des outils et processus de reporting, pilotage de la performance.
  • Mise en œuvre de technologies et d’innovations : concevoir des architectures fonctionnelles alignées avec les stratégies métiers, superviser l'implémentation de progiciels financiers (ex. : Murex, Calypso, Simcorp…) et de nouvelles technologies innovantes (IA, automatisation des processus, big data, blockchain) pour améliorer la performance des opérations de marché.
  • Stratégie et gouvernance de la donnée : définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de gestion des données, accompagner les enjeux d’exploitation, de confidentialité et de sécurité des données.

Au-delà de vos interventions et des missions que vous superviserez, votre rôle consistera également à assurer :

  • Le développement commercial du cabinet dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux : pilotage de relations clients en direct ou en appui des équipes clients, origination d’opportunités business, contribution à la transformation des opportunités en missions concrètes.
  • Le développement de nos offres et services et la croissance des équipes Marché de Capitaux : développement de contenu, partage de nos visions et convictions, développement des compétences internes (recrutement et formation).

Savoir-Faire et Savoir-être

Les caractéristiques suivantes sont requises :

  • Expérience :
    • 12/15 ans d’expérience minimum dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux, dont un minimum de 7/8 ans dans le Conseil.
    • Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de programmes et projets de transformation complexes, depuis le cadrage jusqu’au pilotage, et dans des missions métiers (gestion post-trade, finance, risque et conformité) et/ou technologiques.
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Expertise en stratégie d’une banque de financement et d’Investissement, de son architecture fonctionnelle, de son organisation, de ses métiers et processus et de ses enjeux.
    • Maîtrise des méthodes de gestion de programme / projet, en cycle V ou en agile.
    • Connaissance des instruments financiers et des principes de gestion des risques (marché, contrepartie et crédit).
    • Connaissance des progiciels de marché.
    • Connaissance des nouvelles technologies, des progiciels de marché et des systèmes d’informations des BFI, ainsi qu’une expérience dans le cadrage ou la réalisation de projets de transformation IT dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux serait un réel atout pour ce poste.
  • Soft skills :
    • Leadership avéré et capacité à encadrer des équipes seniors.
    • Excellent niveau de communication, grande aisance rédactionnelle.
    • Fortes compétences en gestion de la relation client.
    • Esprit analytique et capacité à structurer des démarches et à résoudre des problématiques complexes.
    • Orienté résultats, avec un sens aigu du client et de ses enjeux métiers et technologiques.
    • Forte autonomie en matière de relation client, de développement commercial, de pilotage de missions et de développement des collaborateurs.
    • Appétence à challenger le statuquo et capacité à s’adapter aux évolutions technologiques
  • Formation et langues
    • Diplômé(e) d’une grande école d’ingénieurs ou école de commerce (Bac+5)
    • Maîtrise impérative du français et de l’anglais dans un environnement professionnel.
    • Vous savez évoluer dans un contexte international.


Chez Capco, nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an
  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work ®.
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :
    • #BeYourselfAtWork
    • Woman@capco
    • RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)
    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles

title: Mechanical Analyses Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented Mechanical Analyses Engineer to help us in our mission by contributing to the development, justification and validation of our vehicle. You will work closely with our CAD, thermal and mechanism engineers to optimize together the vehicle mechanical design. You will be part of the Nyx Design Office and will report to the Principal Mechanical Engineer.

  • Design and analyze both metallic and composite structures using advanced materials (e.g., space-graded aluminum alloys, CFRP, honeycomb panels).

  • Support the structural development collaborating with external suppliers, from concept to delivery.

  • Develop and manage technical specifications, statements of work, and interface control documents.

  • Ensure supplier designs meet performance, quality, and schedule requirements.

  • Contribute to the overall mechanical architecture of the spacecraft.

  • Ensure proper integration of structural components with other subsystems (thermal, avionics...).

  • Perform or oversee structural analyses (FEA) to validate designs under launch, orbital and reentry environments.

  • Support environmental testing and qualification campaigns.

  • Generate detailed design documentation and verification plans.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant space industry standards (e.g., ECSS, NASA, ISO).

What We Would Love to See from You

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in mechanical design and architecture, preferably in the space or aerospace sector.

  • Strong expertise in composite and or metallic materials and structures sizing.

  • Proficiency in FEA tools (Nastran and Hyperworks).

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

  • Familiarity with manufacturing techniques (e.g., milling, out-of-autoclave curing, ...).

Skills and Behaviors:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly and concisely,

title: Mechanical Systems Engineer - Landing Gear (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will take a leading role in defining, integrating and certifying the retractable landing gear system of a clean-sheet battery-electric aircraft, including extension/retraction actuation, wheels & brakes, tires, steering, anti-skid functions and associated indication sub-systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, avionics, and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define and derive system-level requirements for the landing gear system based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

  • Contribute to the definition and development of the landing gear system to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

  • Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between the landing gear system and other aircraft systems and structures.

  • Define system-level verification and validation strategies, including support for ground and flight test campaigns and qualification testing of landing gear equipment and assemblies.

  • Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for landing gear system integration.

  • Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

  • Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

 

Your Profile:

  • Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft retractable landing gear systems.

  • Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

  • Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

  • Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems is a plus.

  • Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme would be beneficial.

  • Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for landing gear systems on CS-23 aircraft program is a plus.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

title: Meewerkstage Landschapsarchitectuur
descriptionHtml:

Bouw mee aan een duurzame leefomgeving, met het landschap als stevig fundament voor wonen, werken en recreëren.

Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, je team én campus recruiter Noortje op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep vol gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomen we namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiaires. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar verbinden met anderen voorop staat. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren.
En ook als lid van Young Movares, onze jongerenvereniging, staan er regelmatig leuke activiteiten in je agenda. Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer, je krijgt een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, en je krijgt volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en een goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je:


• Een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;
• Ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans;
• Leuke collega’s en een afstudeerplek in hartje Den Bosch.
En er is méér. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook:
• Bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat;
• Lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s.

Jouw team bij Movares

Voor jou als meewerkstagiair(e) Landschap is er plek in team Stedenbouw en Landschap. Ons team werkt vanuit de hub 's-Hertogenbosch aan projecten die de kwaliteit van de leefomgeving verbeteren. We combineren creativiteit met technische kennis om integrale oplossingen te ontwerpen voor stedelijke en landschappelijke vraagstukken. Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team van ontwerpers en adviseurs, waarin intensief wordt samengewerkt met specialisten op het gebied van onder andere planologie, mobiliteit en ecologie. We zijn een hecht team waarin we op locatie samenwerken en elkaar helpen vanzelfsprekend is. Kortom, je komt in een omgeving waar vakinhoudelijke uitdaging en een fijne werksfeer hand in hand gaan. Samen zorgen we voor een toekomstbestendige en inspirerende leefomgeving.

title: Mixed-signal IC Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out.

Responsibilities

  • Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic.

  • Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others.

  • Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements.

  • Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out.

  • Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance.

  • Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths.

  • Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments.

  • Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs.

  • Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus.

  • Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

title: Offre de stage – Design et fabrication d’un circuit électronique flexible pour capteur de gaz portable – 5 à 6 mois
descriptionHtml:
English version

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s'engager au sein d'une institution où la science et l'innovation construisent un avenir plus durable. C'est une école d'excellence où chacun a la possibilité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs de France et reconnue à l'international, notre école, membre de l'Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en s'engageant activement face aux grands enjeux industriels, numériques et environnementaux. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 membres du personnel et 2 500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : allier excellence académique, recherche de pointe et impact sociétal positif.

L'Institut Mines-Télécom rassemble les plus grandes Écoles françaises pour relever les grands défis industriels, numériques, énergétiques et environnementaux. Avec ses huit Grandes Écoles publiques et ses deux Graduate Schools affiliées, il constitue le premier institut public dédié à la formation des ingénieurs et des managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable en formant les leaders qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Le département d'électronique flexible développe des connaissances technologiques et scientifiques dans le domaine de l'électronique souple. Le département dispose d'une solide expertise dans la caractérisation électrique et mécanique des matériaux et des interfaces. Ses activités sont regroupées au sein d'une plateforme de 660 m². Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Au sein du département d’électronique flexible (FEL) du Centre de Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), le/la candidat(e) combinera passion des science et désir d’impact sociétal.

Ce stage fait partie du projet de recherche Sens-CO qui met en partenariat l’Université Gustave Eiffel, l’Ecole polytechnique et l’Ecole des mines de Saint-Etienne. Ce projet vise à développer un capteur de gaz NOx et COx portable pour un monitoring environnemental en continu. La résistance interne du capteur varie avec la concentration de gaz mesurée. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique et de permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact. Ce circuit doit permettre une mesure portable et nécessite donc d’être réalisé sur un substrat flexible.

Le/la candidat(e) devra ainsi, à partir d’un design réalisé sur PCB rigide, transposer cette interface de capteur de gaz sur un substrat souple en tenant compte des enjeux liés à ces méthodes. Compte tenu de la grande valeur des résistances à mesurer, le PCB final devra permettre :

· Une mesure précise de grandes valeurs de résistance

· Un faible-bruit et résistance aux interférences électromagnétiques, en tenant compte de l’agencement des composants pour permettre de garantir une flexibilité maximale.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons :

Vous êtes actuellement en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur en spécialisation génie électrique, électronique, systèmes embarqués ou domaines associés.

Vous devez :

· Présenter un fort intérêt pour l’électronique, les systèmes embarqués et la fabrication (soudure, routage et réalisation de circuits électronique).

· Présenter une expérience avec les outils de conception de circuits électriques ainsi qu’en conception de PCB et qu’en compatibilité électromagnétique.

Une approche expérimentale et une connaissance de conception de circuits imprimés sont essentielles.


🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST).

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle représentant 11 millions d'euros par an, principalement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique, La Rotonde, engagé depuis 25 ans dans la médiation scientifique et accueillant plus de 50 000 visiteurs par an.

  • Frais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75% (sous conditions),

  • Foyer du personnel (activités sportives, culturelles, avantages CE sur des loisirs et temps de convivialité),

  • 1 jour de congé par mois (à poser sous réserve de l'accord du tuteur)

📩 Postulez Maintenant !

· Durée du stage : 5 à 6 mois

Le poste est ouvert à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap. title: Operations Manager (m/w/d) für Wärmecontracting
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Kola NetZero bringt Eigentümer von Mehrfamilienhäusern mit einem führenden Anbieter für Wärmecontracting zusammen: Der Eigentümer bekommt eine neue, klimafreundliche Heizzentrale ohne eigene Investition, der Anbieter betreibt sie 15 Jahre lang, und wir begleiten den Weg von der ersten Anfrage bis zur Unterschrift. Hinter Kola NetZero steht die Kola Invest GmbH, ein Hamburger Family Office mit Fokus auf Wohnimmobilien.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit großem Ziel: mehrere tausend Wohneinheiten pro Monat in die Wärmewende zu bringen. Dafür bauen wir gerade das Backoffice auf, das aus eingereichten Objekten vertragsreife Projekte macht. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und prägst, wie wir arbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben

Du verantwortest den Weg eines Objekts vom Eingang bis zur Freigabe durch den Anbieter. Konkret:

  • Pipeline steuern: 50 bis 100 Objekte gleichzeitig im Prozess halten. Du weißt jederzeit, welches Objekt in welcher Phase steckt, was blockiert und was als Nächstes dran ist, und berichtest das wöchentlich an die Geschäftsführung.

  • Objekteingang prüfen: Energieausweise, Heizkostenabrechnungen, Gasrechnungen und Objektlisten der Eigentümer sichten, Daten in unsere Portfolioliste übertragen und auf Vollständigkeit prüfen.

  • Technischen Fit bewerten: Zentral oder dezentral, Energieträger, Kesselalter, Anzahl Wohneinheiten, Warmwasserbereitung. Du entscheidest mit, welche Objekte an den Anbieter gehen und welche nicht.

  • Vergleichsrechnungen erstellen: Kosten heute gegen Kosten mit Contracting über 15 Jahre (Brennstoff, CO2-Preis, Wartung, Investition) mit unseren Tools aufbereiten und dem Eigentümer erklären können.

  • Beteiligte koordinieren: Eigentümer, Hausverwaltung, Messdienst, Vertrieb und Technik des Anbieters und unsere Vermittlungspartner. Du holst fehlende Unterlagen ein, hältst Fristen nach und vermittelst, wenn es hakt.

  • Übergabe an den Anbieter: Objekte in das gemeinsame Portfolio-Sheet einstellen, Status pflegen, Begehungen koordinieren und den Vertragsprozess bis zur Unterschrift treiben.

  • Partner-Netzwerk abrechnen: Vermittelte Objekte den Partnern zuordnen und Provisionen vorbereiten.

  • Prozesse und Tools aufbauen: Du definierst, wann ein Objekt „vollständig“ und wann es „vertragsreif“ ist, schreibst die Abläufe auf und automatisierst mit Google Sheets, Drive und KI-gestützten Auswertungen, was heute Handarbeit ist.

Dein Profil

Erfahrung

  • 3 bis 7 Jahre in einer Rolle, in der du viele Vorgänge parallel koordiniert hast, zum Beispiel:

  • Projektleitung oder Projektassistenz bei einem Heizungsbauer, Energieversorger, Messdienst oder Contracting-Anbieter

  • Objektmanagement oder Teamleitung in einer größeren Hausverwaltung

  • Operations oder Customer Success in einem PropTech- oder Energie-Startup

  • Projektsteuerung bei Sanierungen und Modernisierungen im Wohnungsbestand

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium, zum Beispiel Immobilienkaufmann/-frau, Versorgungstechnik, Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaft.

Projektmanagement

  • Du hältst 80 Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft, ohne dass einer liegen bleibt, und entscheidest selbst, was Vorrang hat.

  • Du kannst mit Eigentümern, Hausverwaltungen und Technikern gleichermaßen reden und hakst freundlich nach, auch zum dritten Mal wegen derselben Abrechnung.

  • Du definierst Übergabepunkte und Fristen, hältst sie nach und kannst jederzeit sagen, wo die Pipeline steht.

Fachlich

  • Du kannst einen Energieausweis und eine Heizkostenabrechnung lesen und weißt, was eine Gasetagenheizung von einer Zentralheizung unterscheidet.

  • Du verstehst, wie eine Hausverwaltung arbeitet, was eine WEG ist und wer beim Eigentümer entscheidet.

  • Du rechnest gern, prüfst Zahlen auf Plausibilität und kannst eine Vergleichsrechnung erklären.

Arbeitsweise und Tools

  • Sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets, idealerweise hast du schon ein CRM oder Ticketsystem betrieben.

  • Du schreibst Prozesse selbst auf und verbesserst sie, statt sie nur abzuarbeiten.

  • Offen für KI-Tools im Alltag, weil ein großer Teil der Dokumentenauswertung darüber läuft.

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher.

Pluspunkte: Kenntnisse im GEG oder CO2KostAufG, Erfahrung mit Wärmecontracting oder Energieberatung, Aufbau eines Backoffice von null.

Was wir nicht suchen: Reine Sachbearbeitung ohne Koordinationserfahrung, oder Konzern-PMO mit Projekten, die 200 Tage Vorlauf haben. Bei uns sind die Projekte klein, viele und schnell.

Was wir bieten

  • Eine Rolle mit direktem Einfluss: Jedes Objekt, das du vertragsreif machst, ersetzt eine alte Gas- oder Ölheizung.

  • Aufbauarbeit statt Verwaltung: Du definierst die Prozesse, die später ein Team von 4 bis 5 Leuten nutzt, und wächst mit in die Leitung von Operations.

  • Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Geschäftsführern und mit dem Team unseres Contracting-Partners.

  • Festgehalt plus Beteiligung am Erfolg, abhängig von den vermittelten Wohneinheiten.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten, Büro in Hamburg

  • Moderne Tools: Google Workspace, KI-gestützte Auswertung von Unterlagen, keine Papierakten.

title: Partner - Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness, London
descriptionHtml:
Associate Partner/Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness
London, UK

About Ekimetrics

Ekimetrics transforms how organisations make critical business decisions. We combine our Eki.Decisions platform with embedded experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science, connecting decisions across business domains to drive real, scalable and lasting impact. Our dual purpose is Competitiveness and Sustainability, because lasting leadership is built on both.

With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong and Shanghai, we are committed to responsibility and frugality in AI, and to staying loyal to our values and DNA.

The opportunity

Marketing budgets are under the microscope, CFOs want proof, and AI is rewriting how performance is measured. Ekimetrics sits at the centre of that shift. Since 2006, we have helped some of the world’s leading brands turn Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and AI-powered measurement into confident investment decisions.

As an Associate Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness, you will be a senior leader of our London office. You will own a portfolio of strategic clients, shape how we grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business in the UK and build the next generation of Ekimetrics talent. You will work alongside the London General Manager and be trusted with increasing autonomy and strategic ownership.

What you will do

Lead strategic clients and world-class MMM delivery
  • Lead a portfolio of strategic, multi-account clients, or a major programme for a Tier 1 client, as Key Account Manager.
  • Define and drive the road map for each programme, from MMM and marketing effectiveness through to commercial and business-wide effectiveness, using our solutions model and the Eki.Decisions platform.
  • Safeguard scientific quality: robust MMM and econometrics, causal inference, incrementality and experimentation, and models clients can understand and trust.
  • Turn model outputs into decisions: budget optimisation, scenario planning and forecasting that change how clients allocate their investment.
  • Steer the delivery excellence, impact and profitability of your portfolio, securing the right teams for every programme.
  • Build and manage relationships with key media, platform and technology partners to drive innovation and growth across our accounts.
  • Share best practice and reusable assets across the Ekimetrics community.

Grow the business

  • Build long-term, trusted relationships with CMOs, CFOs and commercial leaders, securing renewals and positioning Ekimetrics as their strategic partner.
  • Identify and convert growth opportunities across your accounts, extending the value we deliver as client needs evolve.
  • Lead pitches and RFPs to win new logos and keep a strong pipeline.
  • Be the face of Ekimetrics in the market: speak at conferences and client forums, and lead thought leadership on the future of measurement, including AI and GenAI.
Build the team and the UK office
  • Lead by example, managing and coaching a team through regular 1:1s, performance reviews and talent assessments.
  • Play a key role in recruiting, developing and retaining top talent in London, and in succession planning for the office.
  • Contribute to our upskilling strategy with the Eki Academy team, and help shape the strategy of Ekimetrics globally and in the UK.
  • Champion our culture and values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity and Enjoyment.

What success looks like

Given the strategic nature of this role, this advert provides an overview of its scope and expectations. Detailed objectives, KPIs, commercial targets and strategic priorities are confidential and will be discussed with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage.

  • A portfolio of strategic accounts that delivers measurable client impact, strong delivery standards and sustainable commercial growth.
  • Trusted senior client relationships that lead to renewals, broader partnerships and long-term value.
  • Healthy profitability, supported by disciplined management of scope, resources and delivery.
  • A strong contribution to new business, through the origination and conversion of opportunities.
  • A visible market presence that strengthens Ekimetrics’ reputation and opens doors.
  • An engaged, high-performing team, with developing leaders and clear succession opportunities.
  • A meaningful contribution to the direction and performance of the UK business.

About You

Ideally, you have:

  • Extensive experience leading strategic client relationships and complex programmes in consulting or a comparable professional services environment, typically gained over 15 or more years.
  • Accountability for the commercial performance of a portfolio, including revenue growth, profitability and resource decisions.
  • Deep expertise in marketing effectiveness and MMM, with a track record of turning analytical work into decisions at senior client level.
  • Strong grounding in econometrics and statistical modelling, with the technical judgement to challenge assumptions, guide specialists and safeguard scientific quality.
  • A clear understanding of how complementary approaches—including incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution—support a coherent measurement strategy.
  • An informed perspective on the role of AI and data science in marketing effectiveness and business decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK market and an established network, with the credibility to build senior relationships and create commercial opportunities.
  • A track record of advising CMOs, CFOs, Chief Commercial Officers or Chief Data Officers, securing renewals and expanding strategic partnerships.
  • Experience originating and winning new business, including leading pitches, RFPs and commercial negotiations.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to translate ambition into priorities, align resources and manage commercial trade-offs.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into a clear recommendation and influence executive decisions.
  • A track record of developing high-performing teams and future leaders, alongside contributions to recruitment and succession planning.
  • The confidence to take ownership and make decisions autonomously, combined with a collaborative approach across clients, teams and geographies.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics or a related field, and fluent English.
  • An entrepreneurial outlook and the motivation to help shape a growing UK business within an international organisation.

Why join us?

At Ekimetrics, your ideas truly matter. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and encourage you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. We thrive on collaboration, learning and growing together, through personalised career paths, challenging projects and mentorship and we believe in enjoying what we do.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our commitment to CSR, and we are part of the French Tech 120, the group of top French scale-ups recognised for their potential to become international leaders.

What we offer

  • A highly competitive package comprising base salary, sales and individual performance bonuses, a £5,000 corporate bonus and equity, so you share in the success you help build. Detailed bonus arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process.
  • A seat at the table: direct influence over the future of Ekimetrics in the UK, with the autonomy and backing to grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business.
  • The opportunity to advise leading brands on consequential investment decisions and work at the forefront of AI-powered decision-making.
  • An international community of in-house experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science.
  • Private medical cover with Vitality, alongside benefits including GP access, physiotherapy, mental health support, consultant care, optical and dental cover, and worldwide travel insurance.
  • Life assurance at four times salary, critical illness cover at twice salary, and a 4% matched pension contribution.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising with tenure to up to 30 days.
  • Wellbeing support through our employee assistance programme, including counselling, physiotherapy and unlimited GP access.
  • Continuous development through certifications, online learning, training and knowledge-sharing sessions, including the Eki.Academy catalogue and the Climate School.
  • A vibrant community, with team socials, offsite seminars, hackathons, recognition schemes and perks including discounted gym memberships and retail discounts.
  • Modern premises in the heart of London and flexible hybrid working.

As an employer, Ekimetrics offers equal employment opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability, or age. Ekimetrics strives to develop an inclusive work environment that reflects diversity within its teams.

title: Mitunternehmer:in für Social Media & Budgetierung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen eine Person, die bei BeginnerBudget als Gesellschafter:in einsteigen und die Zukunft des Unternehmens gemeinsam mit uns gestalten möchte.

Du budgetierst deine privaten Finanzen seit Jahren, stehst gerne vor der Kamera und möchtest eine bestehende Budgetierungsmarke unternehmerisch voranbringen?

Bei BeginnerBudget kannst du Mitinhaber:in werden, das Gesicht der Marke prägen und gemeinsam mit uns Verantwortung für die Unternehmensführung übernehmen. Dein eigener Verantwortungsbereich umfasst zunächst Social Media, Community und die Weiterentwicklung der Marke.

Dein Einstieg als Mitunternehmer:in

Wir möchten BeginnerBudget künftig gemeinsam mit dir als Gesellschafter:innen weiterführen. Dabei bringt jede Person ihre Stärken ein und verantwortet einen eigenen Bereich.

Du übernimmst die Führung von Marke, Social Media und Community. Du entwickelst diesen Bereich eigenverantwortlich weiter und bringst deine Ideen in die unternehmerische Ausrichtung von BeginnerBudget ein.

Deine Mitgesellschafter:innen bleiben aktiv an deiner Seite. Wir kümmern uns um die weiteren Unternehmensbereiche und treiben auch die betriebswirtschaftliche Entwicklung voran, beispielsweise durch Kalkulation, Planung und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe. Wichtige strategische Entscheidungen treffen wir gemeinsam.

Langfristig übernimmst du eine führende Rolle innerhalb unserer gemeinsamen Unternehmensführung. Wie sich die Verantwortungsbereiche weiterentwickeln, gestalten wir zusammen.

Wie wir deinen Einstieg, die Unternehmensbeteiligung und deine Vergütung ausgestalten, besprechen wir persönlich.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • Du wirst das Gesicht von BeginnerBudget und vertrittst die Marke nach außen.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Social-Media-Präsenz weiter, planst Inhalte und setzt sie selbst um.

  • Du stehst vor der Kamera und machst private Budgetierung verständlich, persönlich und alltagsnah.

  • Du baust unsere Community aus, pflegst den Austausch und verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse.

  • Du bringst Ideen für neue Produkte, Inhalte und Aktionen ein und entwickelst sie mit dem Team weiter.

  • Du setzt Prioritäten für deinen Bereich und trägst dazu bei, dass die Marke wächst und sich wirtschaftlich weiterentwickelt.

Das bringst du mit

Eigene Budgetierungserfahrung: Du planst dein Haushaltsbudget seit mehreren Jahren und kennst die Herausforderungen aus deinem Alltag.

Freude an Social Media: Du kannst Inhalte entwickeln und umsetzen und fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl.

Unternehmerischen Antrieb: Du möchtest als Mitinhaber:in Verantwortung tragen, Entscheidungen treffen und BeginnerBudget gemeinsam mit uns langfristig aufbauen.

Nähe zur Community: Du kannst zuhören, verständlich erklären und Menschen für das Thema begeistern.

Zeit und Verbindlichkeit: Du kannst dich zum Einstieg mindestens in Teilzeit einbringen und möchtest deine Rolle langfristig weiterentwickeln.

Deine Mitgesellschafter:innen und das Team an deiner Seite

Hinter BeginnerBudget steht ein eingespieltes, fünfköpfiges Team. Gemeinsam mit deinen Mitgesellschafter:innen übernimmt es die weiteren operativen Bereiche: Grafikdesign und gestalterische Umsetzung, Shopify, angebundene Systeme und Marktplätze sowie den Kundensupport.

Auch Produktentwicklung, Beschaffung, die Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferant:innen, Werbung und die Automatisierung interner Prozesse decken wir ab. Deine Produktideen entwickeln wir gemeinsam weiter und kümmern uns um die Umsetzung.

So kannst du dich auf deinen Verantwortungsbereich konzentrieren und auf ein bestehendes Team sowie aktive Mitgesellschafter:innen zurückgreifen. Gemeinsam bringen wir BeginnerBudget als Unternehmen voran.

Die Zusammenarbeit ist remote innerhalb Deutschlands vorgesehen.

Lass uns kennenlernen

Erzähl uns, wie du selbst budgetierst, welche Erfahrungen du mit Social Media mitbringst und warum du als Mitunternehmer:in bei BeginnerBudget einsteigen möchtest. Verlinke gerne eigene Kanäle oder Beispiele deiner Inhalte.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich und deine Ideen kennenzulernen.

title: Partnership Account Director
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!


YOUR MISSION

Please note - this is a field-based role.
We have an exciting opportunity to join Carwow in the role of Partnership Account
Director. In this role, you will lead SLT / Executive level working relationships with
the highest contact levels of our Enterprise / Franchise Dealer groups, embedding
Carwow as their most efficient, effective & valued stock sourcing partner across
various Sell My Car products.
You will work autonomously, ensuring revenue growth in line with company
growth targets in a high-performance culture. Our Partnership Account Directors
influence how Enterprise / Franchise Dealer groups communicate and work with
Carwow across their Dealerships to deliver results and efficiency.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Opening up and developing new partner relationships with target
    organisations using internal and external networking levers

  • Understanding the Carwow stock buying solution and where it stands in the
    market and be able to deliver highly polished and engaging sales
    presentations

  • Embed Carwow into the heart of all Dealer Partners as one of their most
    valued stock-sourcing solutions

  • Deliver long-term sustained revenue growth by increasing the number of
    the buyers on the platform and the volume of stock buying across your
    retailer network

  • Provide an outstanding level of account management to our partners and
    help them achieve their commercial objectives by thoroughly
    understanding the fundamentals of their businesses

  • Work closely with the Account Managers to help them deliver on joint
    business plans, identify areas of challenge and work these through at
    senior levels of the organisation

  • Develop strong, trusted relationships with the largest group contacts

  • Effectively manage CRM through Salesforce to maintain accurately & up to
    date data for you and your team.

  • Generate and collate contributions to product innovation and marketing
    initiatives.

  • Develop & maintain an in-depth understanding of how the automotive
    industry works

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • Experienced influencer and negotiator, with strong account management
    experience

  • Ability to analyse and manipulate data to identify and communicate
    opportunities and risks and deploy growth strategies.

  • Flexible communication skills

  • Proven ability to prioritise effectively to deliver on goals and objectives set

  • A high level of business acumen, analytical skills and a problem solver

  • Flexible and adaptable leadership style to positively lead teams through
    change

  • Energetic & enthusiastic, able to help other navigate change

  • Highly driven, motivated to win

  • Adept communication at SLT - Exec level

  • Commercially focused and highly numerate

  • An active listener with a high level of integrity

  • Strong influencer

  • Emotionally intelligent

  • Focused on the success of others

  • Solution-oriented – a problem solver

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Step one (Suitability & Experience): Interview with the Hiring Manager and
    Partnership Account Director (PAD) lead to deep-dive into your strategic
    experience, regional knowledge, and overall suitability for the role

  • Step two (Competency & Task-Based): A task-based interview focusing on
    commercial competency, strategic thinking, and ability to deliver in the role
    (e.g., a case study presentation).

  • Step three (Final & Leadership): A face-to-face interview with the Hiring
    Manager and key Senior Executive contacts in the business to assess your
    leadership style and commercial influence.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Competitive comp package

  • 28 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 35 with length of service, plus extras for house moves, weddings and more!

  • Employee-friendly share options

  • Pension scheme via Royal London - up to 5% company contribution

  • Bupa private healthcare insurance

  • Life Assurance - 4x annual salary

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave including up to 20 weeks' full pay maternity and shared parental leave, and 8 weeks' full partner pay, as well as fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • 'Work from abroad for a month' annual scheme

  • Generous learning and development budget

  • £500 home office budget

We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Payments Risk Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst II based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. In this role you will independently manage less-defined and more complex risk work while contributing to team projects and operational improvements. This role builds on Analyst I capability by recognising patterns, expanding findings, suggesting solutions, and applying sound judgement with minimal direction.

 

What you’ll be doing:

Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to:

  • Manage complex transaction, merchant, onboarding, fraud, credit, and compliance cases across risk queues, owning end-to-end assessments using merchant,business, account, transaction, and other risk signals.

  • Apply company, partner, supportability, and restricted-product policies to less-defined reviews with minimal direction, weighing competing factors and making sound decisions with imperfect information.

  • Use reports, risk signals, case trends, operational data, and web-service tools to identify emerging threats, high-risk or suspicious activity, and opportunities for proactive mitigation.

  • Balance portfolio protection and chargeback risk by assessing chargeback likelihood alongside the merchant’s capacity to repay.

  • Resolve compliance violations and complex cases, identify material risks, escalate unresolved issues appropriately, and contribute to resolution and follow-up.

  • Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and risk patterns across tools, workflows, queues, policies, and playbooks, and recommend practical improvements.

  • Produce concise case summaries, findings, recommendations, and decision rationale; maintain accurate documentation and contribute to knowledge material, playbooks, and team learning.

  • Lead complex customer communications and collaborate with Support, FS Merchant Services, Product, risk analysts, and other teams to resolve shared problems.

  • Contribute to incidents, complex reviews, trend investigations, projects, process improvements, and team best practices while prioritising competing work effectively.

What you need to bring:

We are looking for a highly analytical and collaborative professional with experience within a relevant analyst role along with:

  • 2 years of experience in payments, fraud, credit risk, compliance, or financial services operations or related discipline.

  • Exposure to structured workflows, case management, queues, or service-level targets.

  • Experience working with written procedures and maintaining accurate records.

  • Interest in deepening existing knowledge on fraud, credit risk, merchant risk, and payments and suggesting improvements based on said knowledge.

  • Knowledge of Card Scheme rules and regulations

  • Understanding of the full Chargeback flow and process - Understanding chargeback risk timeframes.

  • Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets

  • Good conceptual thinking with proven analytic, problem-solving and effective reporting skills

  • Experience managing structured case work with increasing complexity and limited direction.

  • Ability to work independently and make decisions based on available information

  • Ability to work in a dynamic fast-paced environment with tight deadlines

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

What’s in it for you:

Come live the Lightspeed Experience…

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about Fraud & Risk as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Flexible Paid Time Off - providing you the freedom to take time off however you like

  • Private Medical Insurance and cash health plan for optical, dental and more.

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 GBP per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the LifeWorks and Modern Health Apps- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Transit / parking benefit - for when you need to travel to the Belfast office

  • A variety of drinks & snacks in our offices in Belfast.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.
