title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Direction & Outcomes

  • Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
  • Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

Design System & Prototyping

  • Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
  • Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
  • Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
  • Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
  • 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
  • Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
  • Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
  • Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
  • Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
  • The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

As one of Germany's leading HealthTech companies, we are transforming discharge management by making it technology driven, patient centered, and free of bureaucracy. In addition to our market leading SaaS platform, we are developing AI solutions that radically simplify processes in clinics and for aftercare providers, relieve the burden on healthcare professionals, and put the focus back on patients. We currently connect over two thirds of all German hospitals with more than 650 rehabilitation clinics, and over 25,000 care and homecare providers. With around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we are continuing to grow and are looking for people with the right attitude who want to improve the healthcare system alongside us.

We're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What you'll work on

Aftercare provider operations are becoming increasingly complex and data driven. Bringing change is very hard, but we're not afraid. You'll build features that help care facilities, rehabilitation centers, and healthcare chains better allocate resources, unlock actionable insights from patient data, and integrate Recare seamlessly into their internal systems.

Our ambitious roadmap focuses on expanding our marketplace's receiver side with enhanced analytics tools, B2C platforms connecting providers directly with patients, expanded API integrations, and much more.

Secure communication is at our core. Our solution provides end to end encryption for healthcare professionals to safely exchange messages and patient data through both our applications and external API integrations.


In this role, you will:

  • Own a domain inside our core Go codebase, contributing to architecture decisions and code quality within your area

  • Work inside a well structured system with some standalone services around the edges, including an on premise gateway for hospital integrations, rather than a sprawling microservices estate

  • Step in and keep things moving when your lead is away, taking ownership with confidence rather than waiting for instruction

  • Contribute to pull requests, reviews, and technical discussions as a trusted senior voice on your team

We have several products in development that we are confident will significantly impact the German healthcare system. And yes, we're excited by the new opportunities AI unlocks for building powerful features for our customers and our own workflow.

What technologies you'll work with

  • Golang. Our entire backend codebase is in Golang, and we love it. It's easy to learn, it's strongly typed, the internal tooling is fantastic, and it compiles fast.

  • Postgres. We use Postgres for our databases and GORM to interface with it.

  • CI and DevOps. We use both CircleCI and GitHub Actions to run our unit and integration tests, visual regression tests built in house, and automated code analysis through SonarCloud. They're also used to deploy to our various environments.

We also dedicate some of our time to work on non business tasks, which means for instance:

  • Continuously optimising the backend code to offer the best user experience

  • Analysing and improving database slowdowns and issues

  • Internal automation, because we want to make our lives easier

  • Building additional tooling, such as performance profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in backend services and optimise resource usage

Our philosophy is that developers are owners of the code they write until it gets to production. We rely a lot on automated tests to ensure everything stays stable. The rule is that code could be deployed at any time, and manual QA is only involved in new feature validation.


This is what you can expect from us

  • Work with Purpose. Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals in the medical field.

  • Corporate Culture. We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work together towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility. Would you like to pick up your child from daycare? Do you enjoy exercising during lunchtime? We support you in achieving that balance. Besides flexible working hours, as a remote-first company we offer the flexibility to work 100% remotely from Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, France and Austria.

  • Edenred card, which you can use in the way that suits you best.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday, so you can celebrate with your loved ones.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Backend Engineer will include

  • Technical Ownership. Own a domain inside our Go codebase, contribute to architectural decisions and code quality within your area, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and suggest or implement improvements.

  • Stepping Up When Needed. Be ready to take charge of priorities and keep things moving if your lead is away, supporting and mentoring other engineers along the way without needing to manage a team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with product and design to translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate technical progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.

  • Delivery. Ship reliably against the team's roadmap, help break down features into deliverable tasks, and identify and remove blockers as they come up.

  • Building With AI. We are an AI company now, and that shows up in how we expect people to work, not just what we build. Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your day to day, whether that is accelerating how you write and review code, prototyping ideas faster, or finding smarter ways to work. We do not expect you to vibe code everything end to end, plenty of our best engineers still want to write the core of what they ship themselves and use AI to speed things up around the edges. What matters is real curiosity about where this is heading, not scepticism about whether any of this changes how software gets built.



What you will need to succeed as a Senior Backend Engineer:

  • We are looking for experienced developers. You have a CS degree or equivalent knowledge, and you have been coding full time professionally for 4 to 5 plus years

  • We're looking for someone with production experience in Golang, or another C family language with a real, demonstrable ability to operate in Go without hand holding

  • You have some experience supporting or mentoring other engineers, and you are looking for a strong individual contributor role rather than a path into people management

title: Senior Finance Manager
descriptionHtml:
About GRI

Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) is the independent nonprofit organization that is the architect of the common global language to assess and report on environmental, social, and economic impacts. GRI provides standards, tools, and training that empower organizations of all sizes to create sustainable, long-term value and unlock positive change in the world.

For over 25 years, GRI has led a global multi-stakeholder process to develop and refine rigorous yet practical approaches to sustainability reporting, which meet the needs of all stakeholders. The  GRI Standards, the world’s most widely used sustainability reporting standards, provide the building blocks for transparent reporting on impacts. Working at GRI, you will be part of unlocking positive change in the world. 

About the role

The Senior Manager Finance owns budgeting and financial analysis to support the CFO and budget holders in business decision-making. The role also oversees day-to-day finance operations, financial controls and external reporting, and provides line management and guidance to a finance colleague.

Driving automation and process improvement is a central part of the role, using digital tools and AI where appropriate to streamline workflows, automate reporting and reduce manual work. Initially focused on finance, this remit may expand to other processes across GRI in the longer term.

Delivery

Engagement

Experience supporting budgeting and forecasting and maintaining robust financial controls.

Knowledge and abilities

Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application to finance and administration; experience developing AI agents is a strong advantage.

title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Senior level

Senior Software Engineer. You own a product area: its architecture, how it is staged, its quality bar, and working out with customers what is needed. You may be the only engineer on a new product area, so you need to be able to work alone for weeks at a time and keep quality high without a peer reviewer. Other engineers will come to you for design review.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

  • Own the architecture and staging of a product area, and the quality bar for it.

  • Work out with customers what is needed, and give design review to other engineers.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.

  • You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.

  • You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.

  • You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.

  • You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.

  • You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.

  • You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.

  • You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.

  • You’ve owned a product area on your own, from first design to production, and staged it so each stage delivered something usable.

  • Ideally, you’ve modelled a domain in which the rules change over time (such as pricing, eligibility, tax or regulation) and can answer “what was true on a given date”.

  • You’ve kept quality high without a peer reviewer, and other engineers have come to you for design review.

You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.

We are hiring software engineers at two levels, Mid-level and Senior. This advert is for the Senior level. If you are earlier in your career, see our post for a Mid-Level Software Engineer.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working in the UK if you want it, with our London office next to East Croydon Station available to you.

  • Real ownership: mid-level engineers own whole features, and senior engineers own a product area.

  • A team that works with AI coding agents every day and measures what they do for us.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

descriptionHtml:

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will be Hozah’s first Site Reliability Engineer, and the person who owns how our platform runs. Our parking and payments systems take money from motorists (pay by web, Autopay, kiosks) and pay it on to landowners, and our ANPR enforcement runs around the clock. Those paths have to stay up and stay correct. You own the platform they run on: GKE and Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform for our Google Cloud organisation and projects, SOPS-encrypted secrets, the Semaphore CI/CD pipelines, Temporal for the ANPR workflows, and Postgres. You also own the reliability practice around it: uptime targets, alerting, on-call, incident response and the cost of running it all.

Product engineers keep ownership of the code in their services. You own the ground it runs on, and you make it easy for them to ship safely. Our engineers use AI coding tools every day, which means more code reaches production each week, so release safety and observability matter more than ever.

This is a new role. We are hiring a senior engineer to own cloud cost, uptime and on-call, set up a proper incident process, and make the platform something engineers trust. You’ll support all of Hozah’s engineering teams, and you’ll work daily with their engineers. The data engineer owns the data warehouse; you’ll work with them, and infrastructure for data still goes through engineering. This is a newly created role with no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the production platform: GKE and Kubernetes, Helm, Postgres, Temporal and the environments (staging and production) and how a change is promoted between them.

  • Own uptime and reliability. Agree service level objectives for the money-moving and enforcement paths with the engineers and the business, and alert a named owner when they are at risk.

  • Own on-call: the rota, the runbooks and the incident process, including postmortems that lead to changes rather than reports.

  • Own observability across Cloud Monitoring, Logging and Trace, so the team finds problems before motorists and clients do.

  • Own our infrastructure as code. Everything changes through Terraform and CI, with no console click-ops, including our SOPS-encrypted secrets.

  • Own the Semaphore CI/CD pipelines and safe release: rollbacks, progressive rollout and promotion between environments.

  • Own cloud cost. Know what we spend and why, reduce it with measured results, and keep it down as volume grows.

  • Work with product engineers as a partner and not a ticket queue: help them design for reliability, and review changes that affect production.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’ve owned production reliability for a Kubernetes-based platform (GKE, EKS or AKS) in the last 12 to 24 months, as the person who gets called when it breaks. You can say exactly what you were accountable for and what you personally changed.

  • You write and maintain infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and you’ve built CI/CD pipelines with safe release: rollbacks and promotion between environments. You can walk through a change of yours that went wrong, what it affected and what you changed afterwards.

  • You’ve cut cloud cost with a measured result and kept it down. You can say what you spent before and after, what you changed, and what you checked before you changed it.

  • You’ve set up or rebuilt on-call and incident response in a small team: the rota, the runbooks and the postmortems. You can describe the last real incident you handled and what changed because of it.

  • You’ve built observability and service level objectives that changed what got fixed, not just dashboards that nobody opened.

  • You work with product engineers without becoming a ticket queue. You can describe how you got engineers to take on reliability work themselves.

  • You use AI tools sensibly for operations work, and you know where not to. You can describe real recent use and a time you did not trust the output.

  • You’re comfortable setting your own priorities in a fast-moving SME, and you’re happy being the only SRE in the company.

Experience of Google Cloud itself, Temporal, Semaphore or SOPS is welcome, but none of it is required.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working within the UK, or a London office next to East Croydon Station if you prefer to be in.

  • The chance to build Hozah’s reliability function from a working base as we scale.

title: Research Engineer, Content Understanding
descriptionHtml:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.

Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.

We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

Desired Experience

  • Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad

  • You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere

  • You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture

  • You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

  • You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

  • Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

  • Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

  • Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

  • Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

  • Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it

  • Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all

  • Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source

title: Revenue Operations
descriptionHtml:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

  • Support our Sales, Marketing, and customer-facing teams, which might include:

    • Driving end-to-end GTM processes, including building pricing proposals, developing customer presentations, and delivering financial analyses to enable team success.

    • Analyzing, optimizing, and implementing sales territories and processes for a fast-growing sales team.

    • Building out prospecting programs, marketing campaigns and events cadences, helping the sales team to drive net new demand.

    • Help define and scale the playbook for how Sierra builds, evaluates, launches, and expands AI agents at large enterprises.

  • Take on special projects and initiatives related to international expansion, pricing, marketing, legal, deal strategy, and agent development

  • Work with Pricing, Legal, Operations, Sales, Agent Development & Finance teams to identify inefficiencies in current GTM operations and design solutions to help Sierra scale.

  • Turn insight into action: Analyze complex datasets and translate findings into clear, executive-ready recommendations that drive high-leverage decisions.

  • Serve as a versatile, proactive team player, taking on both foundational tasks and high-impact strategic initiatives that drive the GTM team’s success.

  • Leverage AI-native tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to build lightweight internal systems, automate workflows, and create operational leverage.

What you’ll bring

  • 4+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations.

  • Proficiency in financial modeling and data analysis (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets); experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Power BI).

  • A detail-oriented, methodical, and process-driven mentality that is focused on both accuracy and efficiency.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.

  • A proactive mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, drive and execute initiatives, and deliver results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas and problems into straightforward, actionable recommendations, especially to executives.

Even better…

  • SQL experience.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and marketing automation tools.

  • Previous 0-1 startup or operational experience.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

title: RevOps with Salesforce experience - France (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Chez Shiftmove, nous construisons la prochaine génération de produits de mobilité connectée qui permettent aux entreprises de prendre des décisions plus intelligentes et basées sur les données. Notre objectif est de rendre les opérations complexes intuitives et efficaces, en transformant les insights en actions à fort impact pour des milliers de clients B2B à travers l'Europe. Rejoignez notre équipe RevOps en pleine croissance !

Nous recherchons un Administrateur Salesforce expérimenté avec une solide expertise en CPQ pour soutenir et optimiser notre environnement Salesforce au sein d'une organisation SaaS en forte croissance. Ce poste se situe à l'intersection des Ventes, des Opérations de Revenus, de la Finance et du Succès Client, en veillant à ce que Salesforce soutienne la manière dont l'entreprise vend et gère réellement ses clients. Le candidat retenu sera opérationnel, proactif et à l'aise pour travailler avec les équipes GTM dans un environnement SaaS à abonnement. Vous devez comprendre le fonctionnement des Account Executives et des Account Managers, et être capable de traduire les processus commerciaux en configurations Salesforce évolutives. Une expérience dans le soutien aux migrations CRM, aux intégrations ou à la consolidation de systèmes lors d'acquisitions sera un atout majeur.

Veuillez noter que certains entretiens se dérouleront en anglais.

Tasks

  • Gouvernance du cycle de vie complet : Piloter l'optimisation de bout en bout de Salesforce CPQ, en traduisant des stratégies commerciales complexes en offres produits sophistiquées, en logiques de tarification et en workflows d'approbation automatisés.
  • Alignement Devis-Encaissement : Garantir que le moteur CPQ reflète fidèlement les structures tarifaires réelles et les processus contractuels, en fluidifiant le parcours du devis initial jusqu'aux données prêtes pour la finance.
  • Conception de systèmes évolutifs : Piloter l'évolution de nos structures de données fondamentales et des automatisations Flow, en veillant à ce que la plateforme soit conçue pour une performance à long terme plutôt que pour des correctifs à court terme.
  • Pilotage des migrations et des fusions-acquisitions : Assurer le rôle de référent technique pour les migrations CRM et les consolidations de systèmes, en maintenant un modèle de données unifié et robuste lors des expansions mondiales et des intégrations d'entités.
  • Conseiller stratégique GTM : Collaborer directement avec les directions Ventes, RevOps et Finance pour traduire les besoins métier de haut niveau en configurations techniques évolutives.
  • Synergie des opérations de revenus : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Data et RevOps pour assurer une cohérence optimale des systèmes, en mettant l'accent sur la visibilité du pipeline et sur des reportings fiables sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie client.
  • Intégrité et performance du système : Maintenir des standards élevés en matière de qualité des données et de santé du système, en faisant de la plateforme une « source de vérité » que les équipes GTM adoptent réellement et en laquelle elles ont confiance.
  • Résolution proactive des problèmes : Identifier et éliminer les points de friction au sein de l'écosystème Salesforce, en allant au-delà de la simple maintenance pour porter une démarche d'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Requirements

  • Approfondie en administration Salesforce, avec un historique démontré dans la gestion d'organisations complexes.
  • Expérience démontrable avec Salesforce CPQ
  • Expérience au sein d'entreprises SaaS B2B ou à modèle d'abonnement
  • Solide compréhension des processus de vente, de la gestion du pipeline et du cycle de vie client
  • Une expérience dans le soutien aux migrations ou intégrations CRM est fortement appréciée
  • Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec les équipes Ventes, RevOps, Finance et Succès Client
  • Gestion du changement : Expérience dans la conduite d'intégrations ou migrations CRM, idéalement dans un contexte de fusions-acquisitions ou de croissance rapide.
  • Maîtrise des langues : Français (C2), Anglais professionnel courant

Benefits

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Construire des produits à impact réel : Nous résolvons des problèmes complexes du quotidien pour des milliers d'entreprises à travers l'Europe, en remplaçant des opérations de flotte manuelles et fragmentées par des solutions intelligentes et basées sur les données sur lesquelles les gens comptent vraiment.
  • Participer à une aventure porteuse de sens : Nous sommes une scale-up rentable, soutenue par des fonds de Private Equity, avec des fondamentaux solides et une ambition claire (1 million de véhicules d'ici 2027), offrant un mélange rare de stabilité, d'autonomie et de dynamisme.
  • Évoluer dans un environnement véritablement international et collaboratif : Avec plus de 40 nationalités, l'anglais comme langue de travail et des équipes à travers l'Europe, la collaboration et la responsabilité partagée font partie de notre quotidien.
  • Grandir avec autonomie et confiance : Nous investissons massivement dans le produit, la data et les personnes — en vous donnant l'espace pour prendre des responsabilités, contribuer vos idées, challenger les autres et donner le meilleur de vous-même tout en participant à façonner notre croissance.
  • Tickets Restaurant : 19 tickets restaurant par mois complet travaillé, d'une valeur de 9 €, financés à 60 % par l'entreprise et à 40 % par le salarié.
  • Transport : Remboursement à 50 % de votre abonnement aux transports en commun (sur présentation d'un justificatif).
  • Plateforme Avantages Salariés (Comité d'Entreprise) : Accès à diverses réductions et avantages via notre plateforme CE.
  • Mutuelle Santé : Couverture dans le cadre du contrat de mutuelle collective de l'entreprise.
  • Congés Payés : 25 jours + 5 jours supplémentaires de congés payés par an, sur la base d'une semaine de cinq jours.
  • Congés Payés Supplémentaires : 5 jours de congés payés supplémentaires par an, en plus des jours de congés légaux.
  • Politique de Télétravail : Jusqu'à deux jours de télétravail par semaine (après validation de la période d'essai et avec l'accord du manager).

Les avantages peuvent varier selon le lieu de travail.

title: Safety Officer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Safety Officer to support the safe day-to-day operation of our facilities, workshops, test areas, construction activities, and wider company operations.

This is a practical, site-focused role for someone who is comfortable working directly with employees, contractors, engineers, technicians, and visitors. You will help ensure that safety procedures are followed in practice, risks are identified early, and the company maintains a strong and consistent safety culture.

Fluent German and experience working with German authorities are essential.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Carry out regular site inspections, safety walks, toolbox talks, and operational safety checks.

  • Support the implementation of safe working procedures, permits, PPE requirements, signage, and access controls.

  • Monitor the work of contractors, technicians, and operational teams, raising and helping resolve unsafe conditions.

  • Support emergency preparedness, drills, incident response, near-miss reporting, and corrective actions.

  • Maintain safety records, inspection reports, training records, action trackers, and compliance documentation.

  • Liaise with German authorities, inspectors, emergency services, and external safety partners when required.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in a safety officer, site safety, HSE, workshop safety, construction safety, or similar operational role.

  • Experience working in an industrial, technical, construction, manufacturing, aerospace, or high-risk environment.

  • Fluent German and proven experience communicating with German authorities, inspectors, contractors, or regulatory bodies.

  • A practical understanding of workplace hazards, risk controls, safe systems of work, and incident reporting.

  • A confident and approachable communication style, with the ability to influence behaviour at every level.

  • A hands-on, organised, and highly visible approach to supporting safe day-to-day operations.

Desirable experience

  • Aerospace, space, rocketry, propulsion, manufacturing, construction, testing, or hazardous-process environments.

  • Chemical handling, explosives, energetic materials, pressure systems, machinery, lifting operations, or electrical safety.

  • Experience supporting emergency response, fire safety, first aid, drills, or evacuation planning.

  • Experience delivering toolbox talks, safety inductions, contractor briefings, or operational training.

  • Relevant health and safety, occupational safety, fire safety, or environmental qualification.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

title: Sales and Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Help organizations turn AI into meaningful business results.

OpenAI’s Sales teams work directly with customers to identify valuable uses of our technology. Our Partnerships teams work with technology and services partners to develop joint business plans, bring solutions to market, and help more customers adopt AI.

This is a talent pool for GTM Sales and Partnerships professionals across customer segments and industries. Whether you build customer relationships, develop alliances, or grow partner ecosystems, you can apply without choosing a specific team or opening. You do not need experience in both sales and partnerships.

In this role, you will:

  • Developing account or partner strategies, building pipeline, and advancing commercial opportunities from discovery through negotiation and execution.

  • Building trusted relationships with customers, partners, executives, and technical teams, and translating their priorities into a clear business case for AI.

  • Creating joint business plans and coordinating co-selling, partner enablement, and delivery with internal teams and external partners.

  • Supporting customer deployment, adoption, and growth, and tracking forecasts, commercial performance, or partner outcomes relevant to your role.

  • Bringing customer, partner, and market insights back to Product, Research, and the wider GTM organization.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience in Sales, Partnerships, business development, or a related commercial role, with evidence of customer or partner impact.

  • Can build trust across organizations, navigate complex relationships, and communicate credibly with executives and technical teams.

  • Bring sound commercial judgment, turn strategy into practical plans, and stay close to execution and measurable outcomes.

  • Are curious about AI, learn quickly, and take ownership in a fast-changing environment.


Share your resume and the kinds of opportunities that interest you. Our recruiting team reviews this pool to identify potential matches and may contact you to explore where your background could fit.

Note: *This is a general expression of interest rather than a specific vacancy, and we may not be able to respond to every application.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: Sales Manager CH, KI-Software für Psychotherapeut:innen
descriptionHtml:
Über VIA HealthTech

VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat.

Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat.

Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf.

Die Rolle

Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus.

In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht.

Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen.
  • Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen.
  • Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt.
  • Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Was konvertiert, welche Einwände in der Schweiz wirklich kommen (etwa zu Datenschutz und Datenhaltung), welche Sequenz funktioniert.
  • Zahlen verantworten. Deine KPIs entlang des Funnels, gemeinsam mit unserem Commercial Engine Lead, der Tracking und Infrastruktur baut.
  • Sales-Enablement-Material. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF.
  • Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam.

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen
  • Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle
  • Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden
  • Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Entweder bringst du diesen Hintergrund mit, oder du arbeitest dich so schnell und so tief ein, dass man es dir im Gespräch nicht anmerkt
  • Systemdenken. Du baust reproduzierbare Prozesse statt Einzelfälle, mit dem Ziel, dass dein Ansatz auch ohne dich funktioniert
  • Hunger und unternehmerischer Ehrgeiz. Du willst einen neuen Markt aufbauen, nicht eine Quote abarbeiten

title: Security Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Level: Engineering Manager (PL1)
Team: Information & Cyber Security, within Platform & Security Engineering
Salary: £70,000 – £87,000 + discretionary bonus
Contract: Permanent
Reporting to: Head of Information Security

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

You’ll join the Information & Cyber Security team, a core part of our Platform & Security Engineering organisation. Security at Kaluza isn’t a silo, so you’ll work closely with colleagues across security engineering, identity and access management, platform engineering and enterprise technical services.

As Security Operations Lead, you’ll own and grow the Security Operations function, leading a team across the UK and Australia. You’ll be the senior escalation point for security incidents, a calm and authoritative presence under pressure, and the person who keeps our operational security evolving to meet new threats, including those that come with being an AI-enabled business.

  • Lead the team: Build, mentor and manage the performance of a Security Operations team across the UK and Australia, creating an environment of continuous learning, clear ownership and psychological safety

  • Evolve incident response: Develop our incident response processes, especially around AI, maintain playbooks and standard operating procedures, and run exercises that build team confidence when it matters most

  • Hunt threats: Proactively hunt for threats before they become incidents, and work with penetration testers, red teams and bug bounty programmes to find weaknesses, then partner with security engineering and technology teams to close gaps

  • Own detection and tooling: Own our security monitoring and detection capability, including SIEM, EDR and threat intelligence platforms, driving the tooling roadmap, tuning detections to cut noise, and championing automation

  • Report on what matters: Define and own Security Operations KPIs and KRIs, and give senior stakeholders clear reporting on the health of the function, including mean time to detect, mean time to respond and coverage trends

  • Support compliance and governance: Make sure our security operations posture supports our regulatory and contractual obligations, acting as a key stakeholder in audits, assessments and customer security reviews, and working closely with Legal, Compliance and Privacy


What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience managing and mentoring engineers and/or operations specialists

  • Expertise in incident response, with hands-on experience leading major incidents

  • Experience in threat intelligence and hunting, proactively seeking threats in complex, cloud-native environments

  • A good working understanding of adversarial techniques (MITRE ATT&CK and similar frameworks), and how you keep up to date

  • Genuine curiosity about the security risks introduced by AI systems, such as model abuse, prompt injection and data exfiltration

  • Familiarity with modern security operations tooling

  • Experience automating repeatable processes rather than relying on manual effort

You’ll also be:

  • An experienced leader with a track record of building and developing security operations teams across multiple geographies and time zones, who leads by example and creates clarity in ambiguous situations

  • Someone teams look to when things get difficult: composed, structured and decisive

  • Able to communicate risk clearly and confidently to audiences from engineers to executives

  • Able to show how you’ve built strong relationships across engineering, product and compliance

  • Able to set out a vision and strategy for how security operations will mature, and win buy-in from your team and stakeholders

  • Keen to drive compliance and NFR improvements that balance information security and commercial goals

  • Ready to challenge the status quo and find ways to make security more efficient and effective with AI

Skills (SFIA): We use the SFIA framework to assess and develop everyone in security roles. Levels run from 1 to 7.

Essential:

  • Level 5: Incident management, threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, security operations, penetration testing, specialist advice

  • Level 4: Performance management

  • Level 3: Information security

Desirable: Vulnerability research (Level 5), information assurance (Level 5), emerging technology monitoring (Level 4), professional development (Level 4)


Our values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday [plus/including bank holidays], plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

title: Semiconductor Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Semiconductor Product Engineer to lead the development and deployment of manufacturing test solutions for next-generation AI accelerator devices. This role spans the full silicon lifecycle from first silicon bring-up through high-volume production, with responsibility for defining test strategy, developing ATE test content, debugging complex silicon issues, and optimizing yield, coverage, and test cost. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in DFT methodologies, high-speed interface testing, and advanced CMOS manufacturing, and will work closely with design, DFT, packaging, and manufacturing partners to ensure robust, scalable production of high-performance compute silicon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and develop test methods and strategies for an AI accelerator chip targeting high-volume manufacturing.

  • Plan and manage manufacturing test content for advanced CMOS designs including high-speed logic, SRAM, DRAM, and high speed IO blocks.

  • Develop and debug structural and functional test content such as scan/ATPG, LBIST, MBIST, JTAG, and HSIO tests.

  • Bring up first silicon on ATE, including pattern debug, tester correlation, shmooing, and corner analysis.

  • Support testing of high-speed interfaces such as PCIe Gen6 and multi-GHz LPDDR, including at-speed tests and margining features.

  • Execute silicon characterization and failure analysis to identify yield limiters and defect mechanisms.

  • Optimize test coverage, test time, and cost while maintaining manufacturing robustness.

  • Work with DFT and design teams to improve testability and close coverage gaps.

  • Collaborate with OSATs and external partners on test program deployment.

  • Support advanced packaging test flows, including die-to-die interconnect testing and package-level thermal considerations.

  • Contribute to documentation of test programs, debug procedures, and manufacturing release materials.

  • Support qualification, reliability testing, and high-volume manufacturing ramp.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on semiconductor test engineering experience.

  • Experience developing ATE test programs (Advantest 93K, Teradyne, or similar).

  • Solid understanding of DFT methodologies (scan, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST) and memory test techniques.

  • Experience debugging silicon issues and correlating failures to design or process causes.

  • Familiarity with advanced CMOS nodes and production test challenges.

  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional engineering environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing AI accelerators, GPUs, networking ASICs, or other high-performance compute ICs.

  • Experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6, LPDDR4/5/6, or other high-speed interfaces.

  • Exposure to advanced packaging, chiplets, or multi-die test flows.

  • Experience improving yield, reducing test time, or optimizing cost in high-volume manufacturing.

How we work

  • Ownership and execution: you will have full agency to drive your work forward

  • Rapid iteration: we all work directly with top leadership to move from idea to hardware on ambitious timelines

  • Full-stack engagement: hardware, software, silicon, and modelling teams all work closely together to create a product with generational impact

  • Optimistic and pragmatic: we possess the will to win, and to do the hard work to get us there

  • Team player mentality: the mission is bigger than any of us, and we have the curiosity and technical focus to see the best idea shipped, no matter who’s it is

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior AI - Computer Vision Engineer - UK
descriptionHtml:
Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer

Build the spatial AI behind the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is already being used on major construction projects around the world to help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

Our R&D team applies computer vision, spatial AI and machine learning to one of the most demanding real-world settings there is: the active construction site.

We’re looking for a Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer with deep expertise in 3D computer vision and spatial AI to join the team and help develop the perception technology behind our products.

As a Series B business entering our next phase of growth, we're investing in our R&D capability and growing our team. This great opportunity will be based out of our Angel, London office on a hybrid basis, 2-3 days per week.

The Role

This is an opportunity to solve computer vision problems that exist at the intersection of the digital and physical world.

You’ll develop the perception and scene-understanding systems that enable our wearable technology to recognise construction objects, understand complex 3D environments, and relate what’s on site to the design model, using real-world sensor data.

For this role, 3D / spatial computer vision expertise is fundamental. We’re looking for someone who understands how AI and computer vision can reason about physical space, not simply someone with broader AI or machine learning experience.

You’ll work across research, algorithm development, optimisation, deployment and productisation, taking sophisticated computer vision techniques and turning them into robust technology capable of performing on active construction sites.

You’ll bring senior technical expertise to the team as we build our capability and presence in Calgary. You’ll also collaborate closely with our Navigation, Embedded Software, Hardware and Product teams across the wider business.

This is a role where you can combine deep technical work with real-world impact, seeing the algorithms and systems you develop ultimately deployed through wearable technology on some of the world's most complex construction projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop advanced computer vision algorithms for construction scene understanding and spatial intelligence.

  • Design and develop semantic segmentation, object detection and instance segmentation models.

  • Build algorithms capable of understanding 3D environments, spatial relationships and physical geometry.

  • Develop automated BIM correspondence and object-matching capabilities.

  • Develop algorithms using multi-modal sensor data.

  • Combine AI, 3D vision, SLAM and BIM to develop geometric and spatial reasoning capabilities.

  • Explore emerging scene representation techniques including Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs.

  • Improve localisation-assisted perception and robustness across varying lighting, weather and real-world site conditions.

  • Design, train and evaluate large-scale deep learning models.

  • Develop data pipelines supporting supervised, self-supervised and semi-supervised learning.

  • Evaluate emerging foundation models, multimodal AI and modern computer vision techniques where they can add meaningful value.

  • Optimise models for embedded deployment, improving inference speed, accuracy and robustness.

  • Deploy and optimise models for embedded GPU platforms.

  • Build and improve production inference pipelines, benchmarking performance, latency and accuracy.

  • Contribute to technical architecture, design reviews and our technical direction.

  • Share knowledge and mentor other engineers as the team continues to grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years’ industrial experience in Computer Vision, with strong hands-on experience solving complex technical problems.

  • MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, AI, Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Experience with perception for autonomous or embodied systems, such as SLAM, sensor fusion or state estimation, would be valuable.

  • Deep expertise in 3D Computer Vision / Spatial AI, this is a core requirement for the role.

  • Strong understanding of geometry, spatial relationships and scene understanding.

  • Experience developing and deploying computer vision and deep learning systems in production.

  • Strong Python development skills and expert knowledge of PyTorch.

  • Experience with semantic segmentation, object detection, image understanding and modern computer vision architectures.

  • Experience designing and training large-scale deep learning models and working with large image datasets.

  • Strong mathematical foundations in machine learning and computer vision.

  • Ability to bridge research and production engineering, comfortable exploring emerging techniques while remaining focused on building robust, deployable products.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex, ambiguous technical challenges.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

What matters most for this role is genuine depth in 3D / spatial computer vision and the ability to apply that expertise to complex, real-world engineering problems.

We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about where computer vision and AI are heading, but who also has the practical engineering mindset to turn emerging research into technology that works reliably outside of the lab.

What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to some of our highest-priority R&D initiatives, including:
