title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Required Education/Certification:

    • Bachelors Degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • Technical Skills & Tools (Must-Haves):

    • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

    • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

    • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

    • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Core Competencies & Scope:

    • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

    • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

    • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

    • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

Nice to Have Traits for this Role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

Employment Requirements

  • Weekly Hours: 40 h per week

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

 

How we support you

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

Given the highly complex nature of clinical trials and how they interface with our technology, the AI Engineering team at Rivia is pivotal in ensuring our clients achieve their desired outcomes and derive maximum value from our platform.

The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer who combines deep LLM and agentic systems expertise with strong software engineering skills, a bias to action, and a passion for turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, commercially impactful products in a complex, regulated domain.

  • Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials.

  • Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential.

  • Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape.

Responsibilities

What Excites us

  • Deep familiarity with the current LLM ecosystem and active experimentation with new models, tools, and techniques.

Hiring Process

Our hiring process takes 2-5 weeks over four distinct stages:

Ideal, but not required

You will also be setting the technical direction and standards for our team while working alongside senior infrastructure engineers who own day-to-day execution and operational work.

This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy or management position. You'll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team. Your value is in judgment: knowing where to invest based on business direction, designing for scalability and lower long-term maintenance burden, and raising the technical ceiling of the team.

What you'll do:

  • Set and own infrastructure architecture direction. Drive architecture, scalability, and performance decisions across the platform. 
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to senior infrastructure engineers by reviewing designs, unblocking hard problems, and playing a key role in deepening the team's expertise.
  • Establish infrastructure standards and patterns for the team to create a high benchline for quality, performance and maintenance of the system.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, build critical-path components, and get into the code where it matters while routine implementation and day-to-day operational work is owned by the senior engineers.
  • Make and be accountable for infrastructure tradeoff decisions with long-term cost, scalability, or maintainability implications.

What you'll bring:

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and owning large-scale distributed infrastructure, including a track record of owning architecture decisions yourself, with 3+ years serving as a technical lead and mentoring engineers.
  • Deep expertise with AWS & Kubernetes. Minimum 3+ years experience with each.
  • Expertise in Linux and Windows server environments, with strong experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and ArgoCD, and scripting languages including Bash and Python.
  • Experience with data infrastructure and processing technologies such as Spark and MSSQL. Experience building the systems that power high-volume transactional workloads, ideally in finance space. Cybersecurity experience is a plus.
  • A track record of building infrastructure that scales, stays available, and remains secure, using Agile practices to ship reliably.

About you:

  • You work openly and collaboratively with diverse teams, and you're energized by driving engineering excellence through better standards, processes, and shared knowledge.
  • You welcome constructive feedback, actively inviting debate and rigorous discussion around your architectural ideas to deliver optimal outcomes.

This role is architecture-led, not implementation-led — we're looking for someone who has owned and been accountable for infrastructure design decisions, not someone whose primary experience is executing infrastructure designed by others. This is also a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. 

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is the world's fastest-growing defence technology company, bringing commercial technology talent and venture funding to the defence and security sectors. Our technology helps Australia, the United States, and allied nations solve their hardest national security challenges by enabling operators to make better, more informed decisions in life-and-death situations. We have assembled a diverse team of experts in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor fusion, optics, and data analysis that are creating software and hardware solutions to radically evolve the capabilities of Australia, the United States, our allies, and commercial customers. If you are passionate about solving problems that have a real impact, come join Anduril and build the future of defence.

A critical part of the Anduril team is its Contracts / Commercial Managers, who play a crucial role in program success. They interface daily with a motivated team of program leadership, functional leadership, and customers in fast-paced environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a talented Contracts / Commercial Manager to support a variety of Government, International, and Commercial contracts and programs. In this role, you will oversee the full contract lifecycle for Anduril's government and commercial contracts, ensuring compliance, minimizing risk, and optimizing contract performance. The ideal candidate will combine deep knowledge of commercial and defence contracting with strong negotiation skills and a passion for supporting national security through technological innovation.

The position will be responsible for providing contract support for various Government contracts and commercial contracts. Support of these contracts will involve proposal support, contract negotiation, contract compliance, contract management, contract modifications, and contract close-out. This role works closely with the legal and proposal teams as well as across the spectrum of Anduril’s accounting, business operations, program, and engineering teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Execute contract management throughout the life of each contract.
  • Complete contract review and acceptance.
  • Oversee and prepare contract proposal planning and management and support preparation of proposals.
  • Ensure compliance with government regulations, legal requirements, and company policies.
  • Assist in identification, development, and implementation of new contract policies and processes.
  • Maintain comprehensive contract documentation and compliance records.
  • Provide contract summaries and ensure contract execution in accordance with government and company requirements.
  • Provide program managers and executives with contract briefs during the life of contracts.
  • Provide guidance on ASDEFCON requirements and other regulatory considerations.
  • Cultivate strong, ongoing relationships with internal/external customers.
  • Provide contractual guidance and risk mitigation strategies for contractual and business obligations.
  • Negotiate complex contractual terms with government agencies, prime contractors, and subcontractors.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of relevant contract management experience.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, government, or a related field.
  • A strong working knowledge of Australian Government contracting including ASDEFCON, Commonwealth Procurement Rules (CPRs), and/or Defence Security Principles Framework (DSPF) experience.
  • Experience with full life cycle contract management for various types of contract agreements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. You are highly respected amongst your peers and/or counterparts and known as someone who gets things done.
  • Australian citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience working for or with major Australian defence primes
  • IACCM/World Commerce & Contracting certification, Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or similar professional credentials
  • Graduate degree in business, law, government, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of AUKUS initiatives and Australia-US-UK defence collaboration framework

  • Lead workstreams across commercial strategy engagements, taking ownership from research through to client-ready recommendations.

title: Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster. Unsere KI-gestützte Software ist die Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bestandshalter, Banken und Makler nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet wurden wir mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025 des ZIA (Zentraler Immobilien Ausschuss). Heute bildet unsere Plattform auf Basis von über 300 Terabyte Geodaten digitale Zwillinge für 62 Millionen Gebäude und Grundstücke in Deutschland ab.

Für den nächsten Sprung, von unseren heutigen Gebäudemodellen zum texturierten LoD3-Gebäude, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d) in Münster oder deutschlandweit remote.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Alle Quellen in einem Modell vereinen: Du kombinierst 2D-Katasterdaten, LiDAR-Punktwolken, Schrägluftbilder, Nadir-Satellitenbilder und weitere Quellen zur genauestmöglichen Abbildung der realen Welt.
  • Unsere 3D-Modelle verbessern: Du bringst Bilddaten und moderne 3D-Rekonstruktionsverfahren in das Produkt, von Multi-View Stereo bis zu Methoden wie Gaussian Splatting und verbesserst damit unsere Gebäudemodelle erheblich.
  • Texturiertes LoD3 erreichen: Du texturierst unsere Modelle aus Schrägluftbildern und erkennst Fenster, Türen und Fassadenelemente. Diese projizierst du konsistent auf die richtige Fläche des richtigen Gebäudes, damit Geschossflächen, Nutzflächen und Oberflächen deutlich präziser berechnet werden können.
  • Mehr aus den Bildern herausholen: Du implementierst Methoden wie Multi-Image Super-Resolution und Occlusion-Aware Reconstruction. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte.
  • Forschung in die Produktion bringen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Engineers, die Pipelines und Plattform verantworten, skalierst du Methoden von einer Handvoll Gebäude auf Millionen.
  • AI-native entwickeln: Du nutzt das volle Potenzial moderner AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Copilot und identifizierst proaktiv neue KI-Use-Cases im Kontext von Computer Vision und 3D-Rekonstruktion.

Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Masterabschluss in einem technischen Fach (z. B. Informatik, Geoinformationssysteme, Geoinformatik, Physik, Mathematik).
  • Erfahrung: Mindestens vier Jahre Praxis- oder Forschungserfahrung (z. B. Promotion, wissenschaftliche Mitarbeit) im Bereich (urbane) 3D-Rekonstruktion, Computer Vision und Photogrammetrie, inklusive der Entwicklung funktionierender Produkte oder Prototypen.
  • Photogrammetrie: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Photogrammetrie und Fernerkundung: Sensor- und Kameramodelle, Kalibrierung sowie innere und äußere Orientierung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, Airborne-LiDAR und Luftbilder zu metrisch belastbaren, georeferenzierten Daten zu kombinieren.
  • Computer Vision: Starker Hintergrund in geometrischer und 3D-Computer-Vision: Structure-from-Motion, Dense Multi-View Stereo und Punktwolkenverarbeitung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, aus Punktwolken und Bildern Gebäudemodelle zu erzeugen.
  • Tech-Stack: Sicherer Umgang mit Python, insbesondere mit den relevanten Bibliotheken (NumPy, SciPy, PDAL, GDAL, OGR etc.).
  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest gern im Team und hast Erfahrung mit Versionsverwaltung (Git).
  • Interesse an der Domäne: Du hast Lust, in den anspruchsvollen PropTech-Bereich einzutauchen. Erfahrung in PropTech, Architektur oder Immobilienwirtschaft ist ein Plus.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Du willst in einem schnell wachsenden Startup schnell wachsen, echten Impact haben und technologisch vorne bleiben, besonders bei Cloud-Technologien und KI.
  • Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Englisch (mind. C1 Niveau).

Cherry on top

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien, idealerweise Google Cloud Platform.
  • Deutsche Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort

  • Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Einsatzort: Münster oder deutschlandweit remote

Deine Benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

  • Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

  • Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.

  • Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:

    • Equipment: Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.

title: Senior Creative Strategist – Paid Social / Online Video (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
A career driven by you. Join AutoScout24 Group and experience life in the fast lane. We’re not just leading the market; we’re creating it. We’re constantly innovating, evolving and transforming things for our customers. We’re driven, ambitious and determined to do our best work, together. For a career that doesn’t stand still, where you can put your ideas in the driving seat and change the way the world moves, join our global community.    

As Senior Creative Strategist, you will shape how our brand shows up across paid social, YouTube, creator partnerships, and organic channels. 

Your focus will be turning our brand strategy into clear, practical creative direction that works in-market. This means defining how the brand comes to life across ads, creators, and content formats in a way that is consistent, distinctive, and effective. 

You will work closely with creators, agencies, and internal teams to bring that direction to life through high-quality short-form video and social creative. In partnership with the paid social team, you will help define the creative testing roadmap, using campaign insights and performance learnings to understand what resonates and continuously improve creative effectiveness over time. 

Paid social and online video are key channels for rapid learning and iteration. You will use those learnings to strengthen how we show up across channels and help evolve how the brand is expressed going forward. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Develop creative concepts and write scripts, hooks and copy for paid social and YouTube ads, drawing on audience needs, brand priorities and campaign learnings. Formats include creator-led videos, AI Videos, product demos, motion graphics, and static ads.
  • Work closely with our AI Video Creator to develop feasible concepts, provide clear scripts and briefs, and give actionable creative feedback throughout AI video production.
  • Own the creative testing roadmap: define hypotheses, test, learn, and iterate on creative concepts, hooks, creator types etc.
  • Partner with the paid social performance marketing team to learn how ads are performing and determine what to test next.
  • Use insights and performance data to improve creative output and messaging  
  • Review creator-submitted outlines, rough cuts, and final edits to ensure the work stays on brief before it goes live.
  • Define how AutoScout24 app/site moments show up inside creator content so the work is useful and credible, not just branded entertainment.
  • Collaborate with the Social Organic & Creator team to ensure brand consistency and share creative learnings across paid and organic social. 
  • Explore AI tools and workflows to improve creative speed and efficiency  

What You’ll Bring 

  • 8+ years of experience in brand, social creative, content strategy, or similar roles 
  • Strong experience with short-form content production  
  • Solid understanding of platforms like Meta, YouTube, and TikTok  
  • Proven ability to turn brand ideas into effective ads and social content  
  • Data-informed mindset with strong creative judgment (no heavy analytics required)
  • Experience briefing creators and creative production  
  • Comfortable making clear go/no-go creative decisions  
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools for creative production or iteration. Experience in collaboration with an AI Video Content Creator or similar production role is a plus.  
  • Fluent English and German skills at minimum C1 level  
  • Experience scaling creator-led or UGC content strategies; experience working in international or multi-market environments is a plus 

What This Role Is Not 

A community or social media management role  

A pure performance marketing or media buying role  

A traditional brand campaign role focused only on large launches  

An agency coordination role without creative ownership 

A culture of growth    

With over 50 nationalities represented, we’re proud to welcome people of all backgrounds to our growing community, and we’re always finding new ways to help people feel welcomed and included. Here, you’ll have the tools, training and support you need to work in a way that suits you, learn new skills and reach your potential.    

For a career where you can drive our business and shape your future, apply now.

title: Senior CRM Manager
descriptionHtml:
We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

 

CRM at Marshmallow

CRM sits within the User Experience team, helping Marshmallow build more effective, joined-up communication with our customers across the business. CRM is a meaningful driver of impact for the organisation, with clear opportunities to improve how we engage customers and measure the value of that work.

This role will help shape how CRM is used at Marshmallow by building strong foundations, enabling others to use the platform effectively, and creating the governance needed to make customer communications work better across multiple teams. We’re looking for someone who is excited by ownership, enjoys working cross-functionally, and wants to help scale CRM in a thoughtful, high-impact way. This is an individual contributor role with deep platform and governance ownership, rather than a people-management track. Your impact and progression come from the scale and quality of the systems, frameworks, and cross-team relationships you build, not from growing a team.

What you'll be doing

  • Own and evolve Marshmallow’s CRM operations capability, helping shape how the platform is used across the organisation.

  • Build strong governance frameworks for CRM activity, including how campaigns are prioritised, sequenced, and managed across teams

  • Enable and support stakeholders across the business to use CRM effectively, increasing adoption while maintaining quality and consistency.

  • Partner cross-functionally with teams across the organisation to identify opportunities, align on priorities, and improve customer communications.

  • Use data and testing insights to inform decisions, optimise performance, and ensure CRM activity is driving measurable impact

  • Drive high-quality campaign execution through strong operational processes, audience segmentation, scheduling, and platform management.

Who you are

  • You’re a self-starter who is comfortable with a high level of autonomy and enjoys taking ownership of ambiguous, high-impact work.

  • You’re curious and collaborative, and you like working with lots of different stakeholders to move work forward.

  • You’re someone who believes in enabling others, not gatekeeping expertise, and you’re motivated by helping teams do better work together

  • You’re commercially minded and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for where to focus your time to unlock the most value

What you'll bring

  • Experience working in CRM operations or CRM management within an in-house, tech-led business, with a strong understanding of growth-focused customer communications.

  • Recent hands-on experience with Braze is preferable for the role, alongside practical experience building and managing CRM campaigns, segmentation, metadata, scheduling, and audience setup

  • Proven experience creating CRM governance and enabling other teams to use CRM effectively across an organisation

  • Strong data literacy, including analysing campaign or email test performance, pulling audiences and segments, and working independently with data rather than relying entirely on analyst support.

  • Confidence in using data tools or AI-assisted analysis to generate insights and support decision-making.

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

 

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

 

Our process

  • Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)

  • Onsite case study interview with a couple of the team (90 mins)

  • Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.

At exmox, data is the compass that guides product, commercial, and financial decisions. We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact.

As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Fraud, and LiveOps teams to bring clarity to ambiguous problems and support decisions with evidence.
  • Turn vague business questions, product or commercial, into structured hypotheses, experiments, and decision-ready analyses.
  • Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.
  • Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.
  • Build dashboards and self-service tools that let teams monitor performance without repeated ad hoc requests.
  • Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.
  • Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.
  • Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Product, commercial, and financial decisions are driven by evidence: Your work directly shapes prioritization, budget allocation, and go/no go calls across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.
  • You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.
  • You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.
  • AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.
  • Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).
  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.
  • Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

title: Senior Data Center Pre-Construction and Capacity Delivery Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Senior Data Center Preconstruction & Capacity Delivery Manager at Anthropic, you'll make sure our EMEA deals are ready to execute before we commit to them, and you'll take time out of every program before the lease is signed. Delivery dates and costs on AI infrastructure deals are largely fixed at signature. What is missed before then is hard to recover afterwards, and our leverage over the schedule is at its highest while the deal is still open.

About 75% of your time goes to preconstruction and pre-lease management, from first desktop review through Letter of Intent (LOI) to lease execution. You'll test whether each opportunity can be delivered, rigorously accelerate its program, and shape the deal so that what a developer commits to can be held to, verified and delivered.

The other 25% goes to delivery. You'll carry that work through mobilization, embed with the partners building leased and partnered capacity, and lead them to deliver on the fastest possible schedule while maintaining a safe construction site and protecting the finished quality of the data center.

Our EMEA pipeline is getting off the ground, so you'll set the standard for how deals become ready for execution here. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Anthropic secures and activates the compute infrastructure needed to train and deploy frontier AI systems, working at the intersection of real estate, construction, and cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

Responsibilities - preconstruction and pre-lease management (about 75%):

  • Lead.  This is a role where leadership trumps management and process.  You will be expected to engage developers, contractors, utilities and our transaction teams early enough to shape the outcome of each deal rather than report on it afterwards.

  • Confirm deal readiness and serve as the gatekeeper to validate transaction viability from LOI through lease execution, ensuring all predevelopment, planning, technical and business requirements are met before commitment

  • Give transaction leads an early delivery view from desktop study on capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, schedule and cost, so that the sites moving to LOI are ones that can be delivered

  • Run independent, evidence-based delivery due diligence on each opportunity, tested against source documents rather than relayed claims, covering capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, procurement, schedule, cost, and whether the developer's team, contractors and supply chain can deliver

  • Interrogate every developer schedule from the native file rather than summary dates, testing logic, durations, production rates and critical paths, planning backwards from commissioning, and establishing the unconstrained date before any commercial protection is added

  • Rigorously accelerate programs during the pre-lease phase by making schedule work a priority for the developer while the deal depends on it, pulling forward design, permitting, power, early works and procurement, and sequencing the build around how capacity turns up

  • Assess contractor and supply-chain capacity and long-lead equipment needs for each opportunity, setting a long-lead strategy that secures delivery capacity ahead of need and making the case for early equipment funding where it protects a date

  • Challenge Total Development Cost and delivery schedules against the assumptions behind Yield-on-Cost and IRR, flagging where time-to-power or cost exposure puts the investment case at risk

  • Shape the delivery terms of the LOI, lease and supporting exhibits with transaction and legal teams, including phasing and target dates, landlord scope, diligence cost, ownership and reliance, risk allocation and governance, and check that the developer's contract with its general contractor carries the same milestones and aligns incentives around accelerated delivery

  • Give deal and delivery leadership a clear go/no-go recommendation at each decision point up to signature, with the risks, conditions and mitigations behind it

  • Keep one delivery-readiness record and one risk register across all EMEA opportunities, assigning every risk to an accountable owner, tracking it to resolution, and escalating where cost or schedule is threatened

  • Direct owner's representatives and third-party advisers and assure what they produce, bringing design and engineering, cost, schedule, commercial, contracts and procurement into a single view of risk and readiness

  • Develop and refine the preconstruction playbook, a reference log of unit costs and benchmarks, and the operating model needed to scale the function, using AI tools including Claude for first-pass assessment, document review and benchmarking so your time goes to judgment and negotiation

  • Prepare and present regular executive reporting on readiness and risk for each opportunity and across the portfolio, including time from signature to construction start, risks found before versus after signature, and baseline-to-actual variance, supporting forward capacity planning and strategic decision-making

Responsibilities - delivery leadership (about 25%):

  • Document the baseline at signature for design, budget, schedule, long-lead position, open risks and conditions, so delivery starts from an assured position whether you carry the project forward yourself or hand it to a delivery colleague

  • Partner with landlords and developers post-deal to serve as Anthropic's primary point of contact, coordinating across internal stakeholders, tracking construction progress, and facilitating critical information exchange between development partners and Anthropic stakeholders

  • You will be expected to be at one or more project sites in adequate amount to shape the culture, approach, and aggressiveness that define those extended site teams. The goal is to impact outcomes in a favorable manner.

  • You are expected to be a force multiplier that develops and enhances the skillset that development partners, contractors, and key trades bring to the project(s) you are overseeing.  That means being a subject matter expert in the various cross functional elements of data center delivery and increasing the team's performance with that knowledge and commitment to alignment.

  • Represent Anthropic in key technical and operational decisions required by partners during the development process, ensuring our infrastructure requirements are met while maintaining strong partnerships

  • Drive seamless handoffs to operational state with heavy focus on engagement across networking and deployment teams, enabling rapid workload turn-ups and minimizing time-to-production

  • Identify and mitigate risks throughout the delivery lifecycle, proactively addressing blockers that could impact timeline, cost, or technical requirements, and feed what you learn on site back into diligence and the playbook

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 8+ years of experience in preconstruction, development, or cost and commercial management on data center or other large mission-critical programs within EMEA, including time leading delivery on site.  You won't have a big direct team to delegate to but will instead be able to treat the entire cross functional organizations around each deal and jobsite as your team.

  • Have a track record of testing developer and contractor claims on cost, schedule, power and permitting against source documents, and of telling a deal team when a date does not hold up.

  • Have taken time out of programs before construction started, and can show how.  You read a native schedule fluently and know which levers in design, permitting, power and procurement move a date.

  • Have shaped delivery terms in development, lease or construction agreements, working with legal teams, and have led tendering and bid analysis.  You understand how cost and schedule flow through to the investment case.

  • Have a strong understanding of the end to end (dirt to delivery) data center development process to include entitlements and permitting, planning and supply chain, execution, commissioning, and handover. You are not an administrator but an active player in the arena comfortable making decisions without the need to consult across multiple external parties.

  • You should understand the nuances of data center design and construction across EMEA markets- who the players are, how power and permitting differ, what contractual norms get in the way of speed of delivery, how teams can be incentivized to build and deliver faster than normal.

  • Have built or scaled a team or function, including directing third-party advisers.

  • In this role you will often be on an island and responsible for your own destiny.  You will have free rein to develop your own approaches with the mission guidance being your only bounds.  No one will be there to empower your efforts, you will create your own influence by building relationships and diving in at all phases to deliver success.

  • You must thrive operating with ambiguity and have a willingness to own outcomes, knowing that the buck stops with you.

It's a bonus if you:

  • Understand AI/ML infrastructure requirements, including high-density power and advanced cooling systems

  • Have had preconstruction or leadership positions (Preconstruction Manager, General Superintendent, Project Manager) within a GC, EPC or developer on hyperscale data center projects or in self performance of hyperscale data center development projects.

  • Prioritize extreme ownership and have the ability to create winning cultures across diverse teams and job sites.

  • Are deeply familiar with lease negotiations, construction contracts, or real estate development processes and have strategies to move those arrangements from traditionally transaction and risk managed arrangements to collaborative efforts that align incentives around accelerated delivery of facilities.

  • Have secured long-lead equipment or manufacturing capacity ahead of a signed deal, including through frame agreements or early funding arrangements.

  • Have run quantitative schedule risk analysis, or built parametric cost benchmarks across a portfolio of sites.

  • Speak additional European languages.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:£1—£1 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

  • Mentoring a small number of data scientists and supporting the professional growth of technical team members on projects.

  • Partnering with commercial teams to build client relationships and shape project scope for technical feasibility.

  • Contributing to Faculty’s thought leadership and reputation through delivering courses, public speaking, or open-source projects.

  • Ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project lifecycle to guarantee high-quality, impactful delivery.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess senior experience in a professional data science position or a quantitative academic field.

  • You demonstrate strong programming skills, with the ability to be a fluent Python programmer, using core libraries (NumPy, Pandas) and a deep-learning framework (e.g., PyTorch).

  • You have a deep expertise in core data science paradigms (supervised/unsupervised, NLP, validation), demonstrating a proficiency across the standard data science toolkit, including the ability to develop new, innovative algorithms.

  • You bring a leadership mindset, focused on growing the technical capabilities of the team and nurturing a collaborative culture.

  • You exhibit commercial awareness, with experience in client-facing work and the ability to translate business problems into a rigorous mathematical framework.

  • You are skilled in project planning, assessing technical feasibility, estimating delivery timelines, and leading a team to deliver high-quality work on a strict schedule.

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Take Home Technical Assessment

  3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. You'll own detection engineering and help shape how ARQ detects and responds to threats. From bringing new log sources into ARQ’s SIEM to writing, testing and tuning detections, you'll be responsible for making sure our coverage works when it matters.

  • Hands-on incident response experience, from investigating alerts to documenting findings and remediation.

Nice to have

Benefits

  • Discretionary performance bonus

  • The latest tools and technology

  • A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling.

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka)
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL)
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT?

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The DevSecOps Engineer at Shield AI is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating the software delivery infrastructure required to develop and deploy advanced autonomous systems for defence applications.
This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, cyber security, and defence systems engineering. The DevSecOps Engineer works alongside autonomy, software, systems, integration, and test engineers to create secure and reliable development environments and delivery pipelines that enable teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy mission critical software.
The ideal candidate has a strong software and platform engineering background combined with significant experience operating within UK defence environments. They have a strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps, Secure by Design, cyber risk management, security assurance, and the delivery of software into classified and operational environments.
What You’ll Do
  • Design, build, and operate secure development and deployment infrastructure for Shield AI autonomy and defence programmes.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable rapid, repeatable, and secure delivery of autonomy and mission software.
  • Embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring security controls, testing, evidence, and assurance are integrated into engineering workflows rather than treated as separate activities.
  • Apply UK MOD Secure by Design principles throughout the development lifecycle and help engineering teams understand and meet their responsibilities for cyber security and technical assurance.
  • Work closely with software, autonomy, systems, cyber security, integration, and test engineers to establish development environments that support rapid engineering while meeting defence security requirements.
  • Design and maintain development and deployment environments spanning cloud, on premises infrastructure, laboratory environments, simulation, hardware in the loop, and operational platforms.
  • Enable secure software development and deployment across different security classifications and appropriately segmented development environments.
  • Implement automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, software composition analysis, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement.
  • Champion a DevSecOps culture where software engineers take ownership of the security, reliability, deployability, and operational performance of the systems they develop.

    • Required Qualifications
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Significant experience delivering software or digital capabilities within UK defence or another highly regulated national security environment.
  • Strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps and Secure by Design, including the integration of cyber security and risk management throughout the capability lifecycle.
  • Experience applying MOD security policies, security assurance processes, and technical security requirements to software intensive defence programmes.
  • Experience developing and operating CI/CD pipelines using modern source control, build, test, artefact management, and deployment technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, containerisation, and infrastructure automation
  • Experience with technologies such as Git, GitLab or GitHub, or equivalent tooling.

    • Desirable Qualifications
  • Experience supporting DevSecOps, software delivery, or digital engineering activities across NATO nations or multinational defence programmes.
  • Understanding of DevSecOps approaches, security frameworks, and software assurance practices used by other NATO nations, particularly the United States and European NATO partners.

descriptionHtml:
About the role 

Reporting to the SVP, Global Engineering and Infrastructure, the Senior Director of Health & Safety Operations Europe serves as a strategic leader driving safety excellence across our European operations. You will champion the development and implementation of robust H&S strategies, ensuring full regulatory compliance while fostering a world-class safety culture. This role demands a visionary leader capable of influencing cross-functional teams and implementing industry-best practices to minimize risk and achieve ambitious safety performance goals.

What you’ll do

  • Define and execute the European H&S strategy, aligning safety milestones with broader business objectives.
  • Cultivate a "Zero Incident" organizational culture by architecting risk-reduction programs across all operations.
  • Safeguard the business by ensuring rigorous compliance with local and international safety regulations and certifications.
  • Standardize safety processes across diverse sites using our newly developed, proprietary safety framework.
  • Partner with Supply Chain and Site Operations leadership to integrate safety into the heart of production practices.
  • Leverage data to track KPIs, providing senior leadership with actionable insights and performance reports.
  • Lead high-stakes incident investigations, ensuring deep root-cause analysis and the execution of effective corrective actions.
  • Act as the primary representative for safety matters with regulatory bodies and external stakeholders across Europe.
  • Orchestrate internal and external safety audits to ensure consistent best-practice standards across all regions.
  • Mentor and develop a high-performing team of safety experts, fostering professional growth and succession planning.
  • Pioneer the use of AI and emerging technologies as accelerators for continuous improvement and safety innovation.

What you’ll bring

  • 15+ years of safety management experience, with at least 5 years in a high-impact leadership role.
  • Subject matter expertise in European safety regulations, multi-national frameworks, and compliance standards.
  • Industry background in FMCG, Logistics, Manufacturing, or Fulfillment preferred.
  • Proven track record of implementing scalable safety strategies across complex, international geographies.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate safety data into strategic business decisions.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders at all levels.
  • A relentless passion for safety and a dedication to continuous operational improvement.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agents and Context - Platform
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.

As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead a distributed team of approximately 12 engineers building this platform. Every engineering team at Elastic is led by a trio of Product Manager, Technical Lead and Engineering Manager. You will directly manage the engineers on the team, act as its primary project manager, and work with the PM and Tech Lead to define and deliver the roadmap. This is a people and delivery leadership role in a fast-moving space: the right person is energized by shaping structure where there is little, and keeps a calm, direct style while priorities shift.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.

  • Own delivery of the Chat roadmap: break it into milestones, see around corners on risk, and make sure the team ships predictably.

  • Coach and develop engineers at every level, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations and honest feedback.
  • Run performance management with consistency: promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution.
  • Partner with the Tech Lead and PM to shape roadmap and priorities, and with data science, UX, and the other Agents and Context teams on shared primitives and quality signals.
  • Build and improve team process (planning, async communication, release and on-call practice) through consensus and clear writing rather than top-down mandate.
  • Represent the team to leadership and stakeholders.

You will not write production code, but you need to spot bottlenecks, risks and one-way-door decisions.

  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, search and information retrieval, or open source communities is a plus.
  • Product acumen: comfortable with ambiguity, able to set and communicate priorities, and genuinely interested in what makes an agentic product good for users.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, concise long-form writing is how this team works.

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. title: Senior Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Assembled

Assembled helps companies scale great customer support. As consumers, we’ve all been there. You need help, you’re stuck on hold or going in circles with an AI, and your problem still isn’t solved.

Behind great support is a complex operational problem: thousands of people and AI agents working across teams, time zones, and products as new problems emerge. Assembled gives support leaders the tools to manage that complexity, from AI agents that resolve customer issues to software that forecasts demand, builds schedules, and makes intraday adjustments.

More than 400 companies, including DoorDash, Salesforce, Stripe, and Sephora, trust Assembled. We've raised $71M from NEA, Emergence Capital, Stripe, and Basis Set Ventures and have offices in San Francisco, New York, and London.

The Role

We’re hiring our first marketer in London. Europe is our next growth market, and right now we’ve got a tight-knit, quota-focused sales team with big goals and not much regional marketing behind them—yet.

 

You’ll change that. Field events are the engine — dinners, roadshows, conferences, executive gatherings that put our team in front of the CX and Workforce Management leaders running Europe’s most complex operations. But this isn’t a role that stops at the event calendar. You’ll be the person who figures out what the European market needs from marketing and then goes and does it.

 

We’re starting in the UK with plans to expand across the region. You’ll work closely with our global events lead on moments where EMEA shows up inside the worldwide program, and with our growth team on campaigns that need European flair.

 

We work together in person five days a week from our London office in King’s Cross.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the EMEA field calendar and the budget behind it — decide which events, dinners, and roadshows are worth doing, and which ones we skip

  • Run field as a pipeline channel: pre-event targeting through opportunity creation and deal acceleration, with named accounts attached to every program

  • Build account-based programs sized to the deal, whether that's one account, a handful, or a roomful, in lockstep with the London sales team

  • Build our EMEA partner and channel motion — joint events, co-marketing, and the relationships that get us in front of buyers we can't reach on our own

  • Be the voice of the European market inside Assembled: what needs localizing, which content doesn't land, where our story has to change by country, and what customer stories to bring to life

  • Foster community efforts. Get to know the European CX/WFM community by genuinely contributing and building relationships across a wide variety of stakeholders

  • Bring EU-specific campaign ideas to the team and make sure Europe is designed into campaigns rather than translated at the end

  • Build AI workflows that let one marketer cover multiple countries — invite list enrichment, event pages, personalized follow-up at volume, post-event analysis

 

What You Bring

  • 6–9 years in field, events, or regional marketing at B2B companies selling into enterprise, including time owning UK or EMEA programs rather than supporting someone else's

  • Startup, get sh*t done mindset. The region is new and our team there is small and scrappy. You know how to spot the highest-leverage opportunities and collaborate cross-functionally to make magic happen

  • You've been early somewhere — the first marketer in a region or on a small team, where no playbook existed and you wrote one

  • Event judgment with receipts. Tell us about an event you cut and why, not only the ones that worked

  • Nice to have: experience in European markets beyond the UK, with an understanding of how programs need to differ by market

  • A close working relationship with sales. You've sat in pipeline reviews, you know what an AE needs from a dinner, and you can hold your own on account strategy

  • AI systems you've built and use, with an example you can walk through. One marketer covering this much ground without AI is a headcount request, not a plan

  • A bias to go first. You'd rather run a twelve-person dinner next month than spend the quarter planning a conference booth for next year

 

Our UK benefits

  • Quarterly credits for professional development, wellness, and commuting

  • Budget for AI tools and experimentation, giving you room to test new ideas, build workflows, and rethink how you work

  • Paid parental leave

  • Onsite work model with catered lunches everyday (M-F)

 

The estimated base salary range for this role is £80,000 - £105,000 per year. The base pay offered may vary depending on location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Stock options are provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.

 

We know great candidates don’t always meet every requirement listed in a job description. If the role excites you and you believe you can make an impact at Assembled, we encourage you to apply.
