title: Sr. Compliance Associate Lead - Market Surveillance
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Associate Lead to take on our more complex casework, own an area of the surveillance programme, and act as a senior point of reference for the analysts around them.

The opportunity

  • Take the more complex investigations end to end, including those that begin as a referral rather than an alert, and present conclusions to senior compliance stakeholders and the business.

  • Act as a senior reviewer for colleagues' work, and a point of escalation for judgement calls on how an alert or a case should be treated.

  • Contribute to threshold and model reviews, recalibrating detection as trading behaviour, products and market structure change.

  • Support surveillance platform and tooling work, including setting out what detection needs to achieve and validating that it does.

  • Draft suspicious transaction and order reports and suspicious activity reports.

  • Contribute to market abuse risk assessment work, and help translate the risks identified into surveillance coverage.

 

What you bring

  • At least 4 years investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation.

  • A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

  • Solid knowledge of the core market abuse typologies and how they present differently across asset classes.

  • Hands-on experience with a surveillance platform such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus or NICE Actimize, and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool.

  • Exposure to threshold or model calibration, platform integration, or market abuse risk assessment work.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication, and the judgement to know when something needs escalating.

  • Based in the UK, Ireland, Cyprus, Canada, with fluency in English.

 

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required.

  • Experience mentoring or acting as a senior reviewer for less experienced analysts.

  • Experience of a surveillance platform implementation or build-out.

  • Electronic communications surveillance experience.

 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Sr. Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
P-1626

Senior Product Designer

At Databricks, we design tools that make complex data and AI workflows intuitive and powerful. Our mission is to simplify how data is connected, understood, and activated so organizations can turn information into business outcomes. Designers at Databricks combine strong visual craft with systems thinking. They shape products used by some of the most advanced data teams in the world, and increasingly by the business users and AI agents working alongside them.

We're hiring Product Designers to join our design team and own design for an area of the Databricks Platform. Teams span the platform, from data engineering and analytics to databases, apps, and AI agents. We match each designer to the area where their skills and interests will have the most impact. You'll design for both technical and business users of data, making powerful capabilities feel clear, controllable, and trustworthy for enterprise customers.

The impact you will have

  • Own your area end to end. Sharpen the problem, set the design direction, and carry the work from framing and interaction models through visual polish and shipped detail.
  • Set the quality bar. Make the critical design decisions in your area, review work from designers, PM, engineering, and AI tools, and have the hands-on skill to improve it yourself.
  • Advocate with evidence. Stay in regular contact with customers, choose research methods that fit the decision, and turn research into insights others can act on.
  • Show the experience got better. Define what success looks like for the key tasks users need to get done, and show the improvement through usability testing, research, and how people actually use what shipped.
  • Influence through the work. Move product and engineering decisions with prototypes, keep design reviews focused, and communicate clearly in writing and in person.
  • Prototype to explore and align. Use interactive prototypes as a primary thinking tool to explore ambiguous problems, reduce risk, and align the team on a direction.
  • Design directly in the codebase with coding agents. Use AI coding agents to ship well-scoped design changes alongside engineers, rather than handing off static mocks.
  • Define reusable UX principles. Create interaction patterns and frameworks other teams reuse, and drive consistency through a strong, cross-platform design system.
  • Raise the level of critique. Give and invite high-quality feedback, and help make clear decisions together with product and engineering.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of product design work experience.
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction, or a related field.
  • A portfolio demonstrating your end-to-end design process, from inception to production.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large and complex design projects and balance the needs of diverse stakeholders.
  • A systems thinker who has the vision to design the big picture, and the tactical ability to break it down so that engineering can succeed in building it incrementally.

  • Self-directed and comfortable in ambiguity. You help shape product direction when the path isn't defined.
  • Beautiful visual and interaction work rooted in a data-driven, well-researched UX process.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing developer tools, data/analytics products, AI/ML products, or enterprise software.

title: Staff AppSec / Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Staff AppSec / Product Security Engineer to join our Digital Security team, and make security a built-in quality of everything we ship across the XTM platform (OpenCTI, OpenAEV, XTM One, XTM Hub). You'll work closely with the R&D team: the VP, Staff and Principal Engineers, Engineering Managers, Product Owners and the Product Manager. You'll help keep our open source and enterprise products trustworthy for the 6,000+ organizations that defend themselves with them.

This is not a solo audit role. As a Staff engineer, you advise the CISO on product security and turn their strategy into day-to-day practice in the product teams. You lead security as a cross-cutting concern, and coach engineers so they own security in their own scope. And of course, you still code: critical security fixes, PR reviews, pair programming and the shared security components that make the secure path the easy one.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact

  • Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows

  • Advise the CISO on product security strategy across the XTM platform, and lead its operational implementation in the product teams: turn priorities into concrete actions, and track security technical pains to resolution.

  • Lead threat modeling and security reviews in feature refinements with Product Owners: authentication and RBAC, multi-tenancy, connectors, the GraphQL API, and AI and agent features.

  • Ensure the security quality of the stack through critical PRs, fixes and code reviews, and build shared, secure-by-default components (authorization, secrets, safe outbound calls, input handling).

  • Drive secure SDLC and supply chain tooling in CI (SAST, SCA, secret and container scanning, Renovate, Snyk, SBOMs, signed releases), tuned so teams trust the results.

  • Run product vulnerability management: intake from the open source community, researchers and bug bounty, coordinated disclosure, CVEs and advisories, remediation SLAs, and the product side of security incidents.

  • Mentor engineers and grow security champions through pairing, workshops and continuous feedback. Document security architecture decisions so they stay consistent across teams.

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

  • Reports to: the CISO, as part of the Digital Security team.

  • Key collaborators: the R&D team, including Staff and Principal Engineers and Engineering Managers across the product teams, and Product Owners during refinements, Platform Engineering on infrastructure, compliance (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001:2022, FedRamp) and incidents, and Customer Success on customer security questions and pentest findings.

  • Community: the OpenCTI and OpenAEV open source contributors and the security researchers who report vulnerabilities to us.

  • Mentorship: no direct reports. You'll act as the security technical reference and mentor for engineers across all teams, and grow a network of security champions.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • Strong interest in AI and its applications in cybersecurity

  • Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

  • Master degreee in computer science and or cybersecurity with 8+ years of experience in software engineering and application or product security, including at least 3 years as the security technical reference for a SaaS or enterprise product

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment

  • Strong engineering and security skills: you write production code fluently in at least two of Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Java or Rust, and you know web and API security in depth (GraphQL, OIDC/SAML, RBAC, multi-tenant isolation, SSRF, injection), CI/CD security tooling, and container and Kubernetes security

  • A track record of influence without authority: you led a cross-team security initiative, coached engineers, and got standards adopted with pragmatism and clear priorities

  • Autonomy, ownership, and team spirit

  • Bonus: AI and LLM security (prompt injection, agent permissions), open source contributions or published CVEs, bug bounty program experience, knowledge of STIX 2.1 / MITRE ATT&CK or hands-on use of OpenCTI or OpenAEV

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Staff QA Automation Engineer to help shape how quality engineering works across tem.

QA sits inside Platform, a central team that builds the tooling and standards the rest of engineering runs on. You'll design the frameworks and practices that let them test well themselves, and scale into the future. As we scale, you'll lead and develop scripts that equip engineering teams with the automation and standards to own quality themselves.

The product is built on a microservice architecture that brings real complexity to testing. You'll own the quality engineering approach as the organisation scales — setting the standards, building the tooling, and driving adoption across engineering.

What you'll work on:

  • A risk-aware CI testing standard any team can run: a dependency model that drives test selection and breaking-change detection, so most PRs get a fast targeted run with a clear confidence signal at the point of change.

  • Unit, integration, and contract testing standards with an observability layer that keeps pipelines honest and not flaky. Proven through reference test suites in real service repos, not a QA-authored checklist.

  • The quality side of canary releases: working with the wider Platform team to define automated pass/fail analysis against production traffic so deployments promote or roll back without manual sign-off.

  • AI in the quality pipeline: LLM-based change-risk classification, targeted mutation testing, test generation, and self-healing checks. We already use LLM tooling across QA and want someone to take it further.

You report to Bartek Kucharski (QA). Specialist individual contributor, no direct reports.

Requirements

title: Staff Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Build security platforms, not security processes

We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our products, data and engineering platform.

This is a highly technical and hands-on role. You will work closely with Engineering teams to continuously harden our systems while helping design the next generation of our security architecture.

You will operate across two horizons:

  • Strengthen security today: continuously harden our applications, access controls and data-protection mechanisms against evolving threats.

  • Build the privacy architecture of tomorrow: move beyond traditional perimeter and access-control security by designing systems where sensitive data is cryptographically isolated, minimally exposed, and increasingly usable without being directly revealed.

The ultimate objective is not simply to make Swile harder to breach. It is to make a breach increasingly uninteresting, because there is less usable data available to steal.


What you will do

We want Security Engineering to create capabilities that scale across hundreds of engineers.

You will:

  • Identify and reduce high-impact security risks across our applications, APIs and internal tools.

  • Strengthen authentication, authorization and access controls.

  • Improve the protection of sensitive and personal data.

  • Design controls that limit the blast radius of compromised accounts, services or infrastructure.

  • Improve security monitoring, auditability and detection of suspicious access patterns.

  • Perform threat modelling and targeted security reviews.

  • Build reusable security capabilities directly into our engineering platform and development lifecycle.

  • Contribute to long-term architectures around data isolation, encryption, tokenisation and privacy-preserving systems.

  • Partner with engineering teams to address systemic security risks rather than individual findings.

    • Where possible, a security requirement should become code rather than documentation.


What we are looking for

You are first and foremost a strong engineer.

You have significant experience building or securing production software and distributed systems. You are comfortable reading and writing production code, designing systems and working directly with Engineering teams.

You have deep security engineering expertise and strong experience in several of the following areas:

  • Application and Product Security

  • API Security

  • IAM, authentication and authorization

  • OAuth2 / OIDC, WebAuthn / FIDO2

  • RBAC / ABAC and privilege management

  • Cloud security

  • Cryptography, KMS / HSM and envelope encryption

  • Tokenisation and secrets management

  • Data Security and Privacy Engineering

  • Threat modelling and secure software architecture

  • Security monitoring and detection

    • Stronger attacker mindset

    You naturally ask:

  • What happens if this employee becomes malicious?

  • What happens if this backend is compromised?

  • What happens if someone dumps this database?

  • Can this endpoint be called directly?

  • How much data can one account access before we notice?

  • Where else does this information get replicated?

  • Why do we have this data at all?

    • You think in terms of attack paths, blast radius and least privilege, not just compliance requirements.

    Pragmatism

    You know that security engineering is a prioritisation problem.

    You can distinguish between:

  • something that needs to be fixed this week;

  • something that requires an architectural redesign;

  • something cryptographically elegant but operationally unnecessary.

    • You are comfortable deploying simple, high-impact controls quickly while designing stronger long-term foundations.

    What would make you stand out

    Experience with:

  • large-scale SaaS or fintech platforms;

  • highly sensitive or regulated data;

  • multi-tenant architectures;

  • insider risk or data-loss prevention;

  • advanced cryptographic or privacy-enhancing technologies.

    • What success looks like

  • Sensitive data is exposed to fewer systems and people.

  • Access to sensitive resources is increasingly scoped, attributable and auditable.

  • Compromising a single account or service has a limited blast radius.

  • Security controls are increasingly enforced by the platform rather than by process.

  • Product teams can build secure systems faster and with less friction.

    • What this role is not

    This is not primarily a GRC, SOC, compliance, policy-writing or penetration-testing role.

    Those disciplines are important, but this role exists to change how our products and systems are engineered.

    We expect this person to design systems, write code, influence architecture and ship security capabilities into production.


    Localization of this position
    This position can be based at our offices in Paris, Toulouse, or Montpellier on a flex-remote basis.

descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Production pour rejoindre notre équipe Art de Vivre & Senteurs à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Décembre 2026.. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) aux Chefs de Production, vos principales responsabilités seront :

PRODUCTION :

  • Réception et vérification des prototypes puis mise à jour du suivi de production ;
  • Participation au pilotage et respect des plannings de production ;
  • Contact quotidien avec les fournisseurs sur l’ensemble de ces sujets ;
  • Référencement des fiches produits et des bons de commandes dans notre ERP ;
  • Commande du labelling, packaging, fournitures, appro matières, et dispatch aux fournisseurs ;

PRÉPARATION DES VENTES :

  • Demande auprès des usines des shooting samples et suivi de leur réception ;

Requirements

  • Vous êtes dynamique, proactif(ve), et vous aimez travailler en équipe ;

descriptionHtml:

Pour plus d’informations, visitez www.wpp.com.

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

Pour notre client Richemont, 3ème groupe mondial du Luxe, propriétaire des Maisons emblématiques Cartier, Van Cleef & Arpels, Piaget, Vacheron Constantin, Jaeger-LeCoultre, IWC Schaffhausen, Panerai, Dunhill and Montblanc… nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire pour venir renforcer notre équipe Data & Tech.

title: Stage Customer Success Manager (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
GPTW France accompagne les entreprises à transformer l’expérience de leurs collaborateurs et développer une culture de confiance, en s’appuyant sur trois leviers clés : analyse approfondie de la donnée collectée, des benchmarks pertinents et l’activation de la marque employeur.

Le Customer Success Manager (CSM) est le référent opérationnel du client sur l’ensemble du cycle d’enquête. Le CSM intervient en amont et pendant l’enquête, puis passe le relais à l’Account Manager (AM) ou Key Account Manager (KAM) sur la phase post-enquête de fidélisation et de développement.

Le/la stagiaire contribue à la gestion d’un portefeuille clients sur la durée du stage, accompagné(e) par son/sa tuteur/trice et/ou son binôme, et prend également part activement aux chantiers transverses de l’organisation : organisation SaaS, productivité et usage de l’IA.

Vos missions

Cadrage client & pilotage de projet

  • Participer au cadrage des projets d’enquête avec les clients sur Emprising : périmètre, planning, modalités de diffusion, contraintes techniques.
  • Conseiller le client sur la mise en œuvre opérationnelle de l’enquête GPTW auprès de ses collaborateurs et sécuriser les jalons du projet.
  • Echanger régulièrement avec les équipes projet chez nos clients (RH, Communication et DSI) tout au long du projet.

Data, reporting & livrables

  • Traiter les données sur notre outil de Web Reporting ROBIN.
  • Participer à la production de livrables d’analyse : graphiques, dataviz
  • Préparer les éléments de restitution, la présentation des résultats au client restant assurée par l’AM/KAM ou le pôle Conseil.

Parcours client

  • Contribuer à la bonne compréhension du parcours client et l’autonomie du client sur Emprising.
  • Identifier les signaux faibles de satisfaction ou d’usage et les remonter à l’AM/KAM en charge du compte.

Excellence CRM & Collaboration Interne

  • Maintenir à jour le suivi de projets sur notre CRM HubSpot : contacts, jalons projet, historique et informations clés de chaque compte.
  • Collaborer en binôme avec les AM / KAM pour garantir une expérience client fluide et une bonne transmission du contexte client.

Vos compétences

Ce stage est fait pour toi si…

  • Tu prépares un Master 1 ou Master 2 (Bac+4/5 minimum), en école de commerce, IEP, université ou équivalent.
  • Tu aimes la gestion de projet et le contact client, et tu sais mener plusieurs projets en parallèle avec rigueur et sens des priorités.

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais niveau professionnel est fortement recommandée, certains comptes étant gérés à l’échelle internationale.

Avantages

  • Stage à temps plein basé à Paris à pourvoir en janvier 2027.
  • Gratification : 1000€ à 1200€ selon profil
  • Onboarding personnalisé, avec formation et accompagnement.

Les missions décrites ci-dessus ne sont pas exhaustives et pourront évoluer avec l’organisation et les besoins de l’activité.

Nous nous engageons à mener un recrutement inclusif et ouvert à tous les profils. Nous considérons la diversité comme une chance pour notre organisation et nous étudions, à compétences égales, toutes les candidatures.

descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France.

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul.

Vous contribuerez à la préparation des documents techniques, à la standardisation des outils d'ingénierie et au suivi des projets en pré-construction, en collaboration avec l'équipe EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction).

En particulier les sujets suivants seront travaillés :

  • Echanger avec les fournisseurs sur les offres techniques en fonction des besoins et des caractéristiques de chaque projet.

3. Études de mise à la terre et solutions de conformité au réseau

  • Analyser les exigences de raccordement et de conformité au réseau applicables aux turbines éoliennes reconditionnées.

  • Vous utilisez quotidiennement le pack office et êtes à l’aise dans l’utilisation des outils informatiques d’une manière générale.

title: Stage R&D - conception d'un banc d'essai automatisé
descriptionHtml:
Aerophile développe une technologie de filtration électrostatique (précipitateurs
électrostatiques – ESP) capable d’éliminer jusqu’à 95 % des particules fines.

Pour qualifier, caractériser et faire progresser ces filtres l’équipe R&D souhaite
se doter d’un banc d’essai autonome et polyvalent. Ce banc devra reproduire des
conditions climatiques contrôlées (température, humidité, taux de particules,
gaz si besoin) et des conditions de fonctionnement variables, tout en mesurant
automatiquement les performances du filtre (efficacité de filtration,
concentrations particulaires amont/aval, perte de charge, débit …).

Vous aurez donc pour mission de concevoir et mettre en œuvre l’automatisation
du banc d’essai, de l’acquisition des mesures jusqu’au pilotage des conditions
d’essai permettant de caractériser et de qualifier les performances des filtres
électrostatiques de manière autonome.

Vos missions

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de conception et de réalisation d’un
banc d’essai automatisé, avec un rôle central dans la conception de son système
de régulation, de pilotage et d’acquisition. Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec
les différents pôles de l’entreprise, de la conception à la mise en service du
système.

En particulier :

  • Conception de la chaîne d’asservissement du débit et des conditions d’essai
    (régulation, actionneurs, boucles de contrôle). Dimensionnement aéraulique
    (mécanique des fluides) ;
  • Conception/choix et intégration des systèmes de génération et de régulation
    des conditions climatiques (température, humidité, génération de particules
    PM calibrées, injection de gaz si besoin) ;
  • Sélection et intégration des capteurs de mesure (compteurs/granulomètres
    de particules amont/aval, capteurs de pression différentielle, débitmètres,
    capteurs environnementaux, ...) ;
  • Conception de cartes électroniques (PCB) dédiées au pilotage et à
    l’acquisition si besoin ;
  • Développement de la chaîne d’acquisition, de traitement et de visualisation
    des données (firmware embarqué, communication, base de données) ;
  • Participation à la conception mécanique du banc d’essai à l’aide d’un logiciel
    de CAO ;
  • Participation au sourcing, consultation de fournisseurs et commande de
    composants et pièces ;
  • Fabrication, montage mécanique, électronique et intégration informatique
    du banc ;
  • Mise en service, calibration et validation métrologique du banc ;
  • Réalisation de campagnes de validation de l’automatisation sur des filtres
    électrostatiques.

Vos compétences

Étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur (Bac+5), avec une formation
orientée vers la mécatronique, l’électronique, le génie électrique, l’automatisme
ou l’instrumentation.
Un profil pluridisciplinaire, avec des connaissances en génie physique, mesures
physiques ou mécanique des fluides, est particulièrement adapté au projet.

  • Programmation embarquée et traitement de données
  • Asservissement et régulation (boucles PID, instrumentation de contrôle)
  • Électronique (conception de cartes PCB, capteurs, interfaçage numérique :
    I²C, RS485, etc.)
  • Physique expérimentale et métrologie (incertitudes de mesure, calibration de
    capteurs)
  • Notions de mécanique des fluides (pertes de charge, dimensionnement de
    ventilateurs et de gaines)
  • Notions de conception mécanique et prototypage (CAO, conception et
    réalisation de prototypes)
  • Connaissance ou appétence pour la qualité de l’air appréciée

Avantages

Au sein d’une PME innovante, vous intégrerez une petite équipe R&D dynamique
et enthousiaste et aurez l’opportunité de concevoir, de A à Z, un outil clé pour le
développement de nos technologies de qualité de l’air. Vous bénéficierez d’une
réelle liberté dans vos choix techniques et travaillerez sur un projet concret, à fort
impact environnemental, au sein d’une structure à taille humaine où vous
contribuerez directement aux futurs développements de l’entreprise.

title: Stage Software Engineer - Paris - H/F/X
descriptionHtml:

  • Déploiement de ton logiciel sur le cloud : GCP, AWS ou Azure 
  • Déploiement d’une ou plusieurs expertises techniques suivantes : développement logiciel, ingénierie analytique, ingénierie ML, architecture cloud ou ingénierie de sécurité et de fiabilité des sites
  • Veille technologique : Explorer de nouvelles technologies et outils pour optimiser nos méthodes de travail.

Profil recherché

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en sotware engineering, génie logiciel, informatique, ou développement web et tu recherches ton stage de fin d’études à partir de Janvier 2027
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Maîtrise d'un ou plusieurs langages de programmation comme Python, Java, JavaScript (Node.js), Go ou Scala.
    • Connaissance des principes de la programmation orientée objet et/ou de la programmation fonctionnelle.
    • Expérience avec des bases de données SQL ou NoSQL.
    • Une familiarité avec le Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) et les conteneurs (Docker, Kubernetes) est un atout.
    • Connaissance des outils de versioning, en particulier Git.
  • Qualités personnelles :
    • Curiosité et proactivité : Tu as envie d'apprendre et de proposer de nouvelles idées.
    • Rigueur et souci du détail : Tu es soucieux(se) de produire un code propre et de qualité.
    • Esprit d'équipe : Tu es capable de travailler en collaboration et d'échanger avec des profils variés (Data Scientists, Consultants, etc.)
    • Français courant pour travailler en équipe et anglais professionnel obligatoire pour nos clients internationaux

Le processus de recrutement : pour rejoindre Artefact, nous te proposons un processus de recrutement en quatre étapes durant lequel tu auras l’occasion de parler de ton expérience et d'en apprendre davantage sur Artefact et le poste d'ingénieur logiciel.

  • Entretien RH
  • Entretien #1 – Test de codage avec un Senior Software Engineer 
  • Entretien #2 - Test d'architecture et de pipeline avec un Senior Software Engineer 
  • Entretien #3 - Entretien de motivation avec un Manager ou Directeur du pôle Data Engineering 

Processus d'onboarding : 

L'intégration comprend une formation sur des compétences transversales critiques telles que la gestion du temps, la communication orale et écrite. Un counsellor te sera également attribué qui te guidera dans ta familiarisation avec la culture et les méthodes de travail de l'entreprise. De plus, tu auras l'opportunité de travailler sur des projets internes pour acquérir une expérience pratique et perfectionner tes compétences. De plus, tu auras la possibilité d'obtenir des certifications sur les fournisseurs cloud avant de travailler sur des missions clients. Ce processus d'intégration est conçu pour te doter des connaissances et des compétences nécessaires pour devenir un ingénieur logiciel performant chez Artefact.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un stage de 6 mois basé à Paris.

  • La possibilité d'être embauché(e) en CDI à la fin du stage.

Prêt à rejoindre l'aventure ?

Si tu te reconnais dans cette description et que tu souhaites mettre tes compétences au service de projets concrets et impactants, envoie-nous ta candidature !

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. title: Storm Test Bench Principal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced and talented Storm Test Bench Principal Engineer, to lead the development of one of the most powerful European cryogenic test bench for 2.5MN class engines.

This is a key leadership role that requires deep technical expertise in liquid-propellant propulsion systems, a proven track record managing complex engineering projects, and experience leading and mentoring technical teams. As Storm Test Bench Principal Engineer, you will ensure that test bench development is carried out safely, efficiently and with technical rigor, from design through commissioning and system-level testing. You will provide technical direction to the testing team, coordinate priorities and resources, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure the test bench meets its performance, quality, schedule and safety objectives.

The role combines technical leadership, people leadership and hands-on involvement in preparing and executing complex cryogenic propulsion test campaigns.

Key Responsibilities / Tasks:

  • Provide overall technical leadership for the test bench development

  • Define and maintain the development approach, philosophy, plans and technical execution strategy

  • Ensure that test bench capabilities are aligned with system requirements, design intent, verification objectives and programme milestones

  • Lead the technical assessment and resolution of complex test problems, including test anomalies, hardware issues, instrumentation problems and system performance deviations

  • Coordinate the investigation of anomalies and ensure that root-cause analysis, corrective actions and retest activities are properly managed

  • Ensure that the test bench design performed in accordance with applicable safety rules, operational constraints and approved procedures

  • Support the development of the teams through coaching, technical guidance and constructive feedback

  • Build a culture of ownership, disciplined execution, continuous improvement and learning from experience

  • Contribute to integrated project planning, including test schedules, resource requirements, facility usage and major test milestones

  • Identify technical, operational and schedule risks related to test activities and ensure that mitigation actions are defined and implemented

  • Ensure compliance with company processes and applicable regulatory requirements for cryogenic propulsion test activities

  • Promote a strong safety culture, particularly for activities involving cryogenic propellants, high pressure, hazardous energy and propulsion test operations

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, propulsion engineering or a related technical discipline

  • Proven professional experience (5+ years) in spacecraft, launch vehicle, aircraft, industrial gas, energy or another relevant high-technology environment

  • Experience in cryogenic propulsion systems testing

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams and coordinating multidisciplinary technical activities

  • Experience with cryogenic systems, liquid propulsion, pressurised systems, fluid systems or related test operations

  • Experience planning and executing complex test campaigns from test preparation through final reporting

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical investigations and resolve test anomalies using structured problem-solving methods

  • Experience working with test facilities, ground support equipment, instrumentation and data acquisition systems

  • Capacity to travel to test sites and partner facilities as required

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Fluent professional English. French will be an advantage

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

title: Strategic Sales Manager (Paris)
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

We’re hiring a Strategic Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence with its most important French customers. This is a pivotal opportunity to shape how we win and grow strategic accounts, from developing senior relationships and navigating complex buying groups to building a repeatable approach for large, high-impact opportunities.

You’ll act as the business lead for the strategic segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team while staying close to customers, account plans, and active deals. You’ll build a focused pipeline and a sales motion suited to organizations with complex needs, multiple stakeholders, and ambitious transformation goals.

You’ll also orchestrate the cross-functional support needed to grow strategic accounts. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll direct resources toward the accounts and opportunities where they can have the greatest impact.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the Strategic sales team, including hiring, performance management, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set clear priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Develop a focused strategy for target accounts, including account plans, senior stakeholder relationships, and a clear view of customer priorities and decision processes.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on executive engagement, value-based selling, multi-threading, commercial strategy, and navigating complex buying groups.

  • Build a consistent, evidence-based strategic sales motion, refining qualification, messaging, and execution based on customer conversations and deal patterns.

  • Bring customer and market learning to Product, making clear recommendations on strategic customer needs, use cases, and opportunities.

  • Set pipeline priorities with BDR and Growth leaders, including targeted outbound and other channels suited to strategic accounts.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize executive events, campaigns, customer advocacy, and community programs that support strategic pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support strategic priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on account access, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to deliver credible evaluations, successful implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share strategic account and market insights with the CRO and other segment leads, helping shape a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience leading Strategic or Enterprise sales, including complex, multi-stakeholder deals and relationships with senior executives.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end, and building pipeline through teams and functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience making practical decisions about where to focus capacity and budget, including the roles of direct sales, marketing, and partners.

  • Strong judgment in developing account strategies, coaching complex deal execution, and building a reliable forecast.

  • The ability to create a repeatable sales approach without treating every strategic customer as the same.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building strategic sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Strategic segment has clear ownership, a focused pipeline, and measurable progress against its ARR goals. The team builds trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and executes complex sales cycles with discipline. Cross-functional resources are aligned to the accounts and opportunities that matter most, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust sharpen its strategic sales approach in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Strategy & Operations - Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Strategy & Operations - Transformation

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 3-4 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £90k-£110k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

Our customers are some of the world's largest companies, and every partnership depends on Deducta delivering the measurable outcomes we've committed to. This role owns delivery for a set of our enterprise accounts, from sales handover through implementation, adoption and ongoing value. You'll report to the Chief of Staff.

You'll work directly with senior leaders at our customers, run complex programmes end to end, and work closely with whoever leads our customer function. You'll have the autonomy to shape how Deducta delivers and help make that model repeatable.

What you'll do

  • Account delivery: Own delivery for a set of enterprise accounts end to end, from sales handover through implementation, adoption, value realisation and ongoing partnership.

  • Enterprise programmes: Translate customer objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, owners and dependencies, and keep complex programmes moving.

  • Senior relationships: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders from day-to-day programme leads through CPOs, CFOs and other executives.

  • Data and platform: Work directly with customer data and the Deducta platform, understanding each customer's business so our work produces meaningful insights and outcomes.

  • Implementation and adoption: Identify blockers early, coordinate the right resources across product and engineering, and make sure customer learnings shape how we improve the product.

  • Delivery playbook: Turn what works on your accounts into repeatable processes the wider customer team can use.

Success in this role means:

  • Trusted partner: Your customers see Deducta as a partner that consistently delivers against its commitments.

  • Predictable implementations: Implementations move quickly, with risks and blockers surfaced early rather than through firefighting.

  • Visible value: Customers adopt the platform, can articulate the value Deducta creates, and keep deepening how they use it.

  • Repeatable delivery: The processes you build make delivery faster and more consistent across accounts.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency operator with roughly three to four years in MBB or top-tier management consulting, ideally having reached Manager, with experience managing complex workstreams and confidence in front of senior clients. You should be as comfortable in the data as you are presenting to an executive. A background in procurement or enterprise software isn't required.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Client leadership: You build credibility quickly, manage demanding stakeholders and become a trusted partner to senior executives.

  • Programme leadership: You turn an ambitious objective into a structured plan and create accountability across stakeholders you don't control.

  • Analytical depth: You get into the data yourself, identify what matters and synthesise complex information into clear conclusions.

  • Problem solving: You diagnose why something isn't working, separate symptoms from underlying problems, and drive the team to a practical solution.

  • Executive communication: You take complex, messy work and communicate the answer clearly and confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • High agency: You create clarity where none exists and follow problems through to resolution.

  • Nice to have: Experience in enterprise software, data, analytics, AI, procurement, complex technology implementations, or a high-growth environment.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical exercise

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Help the world's biggest businesses finally see themselves clearly.

title: TECH LEAD IA H/F
descriptionHtml:
Le rôle

Équiper des équipes de LLM et de coding agents prend un après-midi. Les faire travailler en AI-Native SDLC, c'est-à-dire concevoir et livrer du logiciel avec des agents dans la boucle plutôt qu'à côté, demande de faire évoluer tout l'environnement autour : architecture, gestion du contexte, harness (la couche système qui donne à un agent ses outils, ses permissions et son contexte d'exécution), developer platforms, intégration au SI, infrastructure, sécurité, observabilité, évaluation.

Comme Tech Lead, tu aides nos clients à comprendre ces transformations, tu arbitres les décisions d'architecture qui en découlent et tu mets en place les capacités qui leur manquent. Tu conçois, tu conseilles, et tu descends dans le code quand il faut confronter une décision au réel.

Pourquoi on ouvre ce poste

Nos clients ont dépassé le stade du POC. Leur question porte maintenant sur l'intégration des agents au SI et au cycle de delivery, et sur ce qui doit être mutualisé dans une plateforme plutôt que laissé à chaque équipe. Ce sont des questions d'architecture, et on n'a personne dont c'est le métier à plein temps.


Tes missions 🎯

• comprendre le contexte Product, business et technologique du client, son SI et son environnement de delivery

• identifier ce que l'IA change et les capacités technologiques qui manquent pour y répondre

• concevoir les architectures et arbitrer les choix structurants : build ou buy, plateforme ou équipe, standardisation ou autonomie, besoin immédiat ou capacité durable

• prototyper ou implémenter certains composants quand une décision d'architecture a besoin d'être éprouvée

• accompagner les équipes client et faire monter les équipes Thiga en compétence

• intervenir en avant-vente comme garant technique, challenger les demandes et aider le client à transformer un problème flou en décision


Deux exemples de ce que ça donne concrètement 👀

Passer à l'échelle avec les coding agents

Le cas du début. Tu analyses l'existant, tu identifies les capacités manquantes et tu conçois l'architecture qui permet aux équipes et aux agents de travailler ensemble de façon observable et sécurisée. Le vrai sujet est souvent le knowledge : reconstruire un contexte exploitable à partir de repos, de docs et de conventions que personne n'a maintenus depuis trois ans.

Décider ce qui se mutualise

Cinq équipes expérimentent chacune avec leurs propres modèles, agents et outils. Tu aides le client à trancher ce qui remonte dans une plateforme, ce qui reste décentralisé et dans quel ordre y aller. La réponse est rarement la grande plateforme IA. C'est plus souvent trois capacités bien choisies qui débloquent tout le monde.


Avec qui tu travailles 🤝

  • Chez nos clients : CTO, responsables Engineering, architectes, Platform Engineers, développeurs, équipes sécurité et Product. Tu dois pouvoir passer d'une discussion d'architecture très technique à une décision avec un dirigeant dans la même journée.

  • Chez Thiga : nos Product Builders, Product Engineers et consultants Product. Ton rôle est de construire les enablers technologiques qui leur permettent de tirer parti de l'IA sur leurs missions, et de les faire progresser.


    • Ton profil 🚀

    Une culture Tech large

    Tu es d'abord un bon technologue. Tu comprends assez bien les systèmes logiciels modernes pour raisonner sur une architecture entière : software architecture, systèmes distribués, APIs, données, cloud, infrastructure, sécurité, IAM, CI/CD, developer platforms, observabilité. On cherche quelqu'un capable de repérer ce qui est structurant, de comprendre les interactions entre les couches et d'aller en profondeur quand le problème l'exige, plutôt qu'un spécialiste de chacune de ces disciplines. Tu as assez de kilomètres au compteur, souvent une dizaine d'années, pour avoir vu des architectures évoluer, atteindre leurs limites et parfois échouer.

    Une vraie profondeur IA

    Tu comprends les systèmes construits avec des LLM et des agents, ce qu'ils permettent et où ils coincent. Context engineering, retrieval, tool use, systèmes agentiques, evals, sécurité, observabilité : tu sais raisonner sur les propriétés architecturales que ces systèmes introduisent et sur ce qu'elles impliquent pour le reste du SI.

    Du jugement, et des mains

    Tu raisonnes en trade-offs, tu prends position et tu expliques pourquoi une option est préférable dans un contexte donné, sans confondre architecture et accumulation de technologies. Et tu es resté assez hands-on pour ouvrir le code, manipuler des APIs, explorer une infra ou monter un prototype quand ça devient le moyen le plus rapide de savoir.

    Une culture Product et client

    Tu cherches à comprendre le problème, les utilisateurs, les contraintes de l'organisation et le résultat attendu avant de dessiner une solution. Tu sais challenger un client, poser plusieurs options avec leurs compromis, puis l'aider à décider.

    Apprécié

    Une expérience du conseil, des transformations Product & Engineering, des developer platforms ou des systèmes IA en production. Si tu écris, contribues à de l'open source ou parles en conférence, c'est un vrai plus.


    Pourquoi Thiga 👀

    Thiga vient du Product Management, ce qui change la manière d'aborder l'AI-Native SDLC. Cette transformation touche la technologie, le produit et la façon dont les équipes travaillent en même temps, donc on refuse de la traiter comme un simple sujet d'outillage ou de plateforme.

    Tu seras rattaché à la Tribe Tech & IA, qui réunit nos Product Builders, les consultants qui déploient l'AI-Native SDLC chez nos clients et les architectes qui en construisent les enablers. Notre ambition : mener de vraies transformations chez nos clients, construire un collectif d'experts qui partage réellement ce qu'il apprend, et faire reconnaître Thiga comme un acteur de référence sur le sujet.

    Il y a donc une vraie dimension intrapreneuriale, et la liberté qui va avec.


    Process de recrutement 🎢

    1. Premier échange avec une Chargée de recrutement : ton parcours, ce que tu cherches, et une présentation précise de Thiga et du rôle.

    2. Cas et soutenance : on t'envoie un cas une semaine avant. L'exercice ne consiste pas à retrouver notre architecture ou à réciter une stack, on veut voir comment tu abordes un problème complexe, comment tu explores les options, comment tu arbitres et comment tu défends une recommandation. On évalue quatre dimensions : profondeur Tech, profondeur IA, culture Product, posture de conseil.

    3. Rencontre finale avec un.e Directeur.rice : approfondir ce qui doit l'être et valider l'envie de travailler ensemble, des deux côtés.

    Notre culture Chez Thiga, nous vivons selon des principes forts : Product first Nous pensons produit dans sa globalité, de l'expérience utilisateur jusqu'à l'infrastructure. Hands-on or nothing Notre approche est radicalement pratique. Nous croyons en la démonstration concrète plutôt qu'en la théorie. Market Maker by Design Nous repoussons les limites et partageons ouvertement nos innovations. Knowledge Open Bar Le savoir n'a de valeur que lorsqu'il est largement partagé. Nous diffusons librement nos apprentissages et nos outils. Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse

title: Tech Lead - Python & AI
descriptionHtml:
This is a full-time, permanent opportunity for candidates based in the UK and authorised to work without sponsorship.

This position also requires travel to client sites with travel expenses covered by the company.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.  

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products.
Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Technical Lead Role:

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects in your time here, your responsibilities may also include:

  • Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.
  • Take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects.
  • Identify and resolve blockers before they become issues.
  • Ensure best practices in software development, DevOps, and agile methodologies are upheld within the team.
  • Work directly with clients, translating requirements into technical briefs.
  • Shape and define architectural decisions ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Provide updates to client and Nearform leadership to ensure clear understanding of project status and drive good decision-making.

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience in software engineering and 2+ years of experience leading projects and mentoring as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, we are looking for professional experience Python.
  • Experience with AI application development and Agentic frameworks and platforms (e.g., LangGraph, Agentspace, etc.)
  • Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.
  • Proven experience working with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Strong CI/CD experience, including hands-on work with Terraform, Helm, and other cloud-native IaC technologies.
  • Deep understanding of observability practices, with practical experience using OpenTelemetry (OTel) and related tooling.
  • Experience leading software engineering teams through technical delivery and either direct line management or mentoring.
  • Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of test-driven development and testing best practices.
  • Deep understanding of version control tools, e.g. Git.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Understanding of operational concerns (such as monitoring, performance testing, security considerations, accessibility, GDPR)
  • Empathy and people skills


Benefits and Perks we offer at Nearform

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance. 
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem! 
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

  • Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
    An initial conversation with a member of our Talent Team to explore your background, leadership experience, and career goals. We’ll provide an overview of Nearform, discuss potential alignment, and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.
  • Panel Interview (60 mins via Zoom)
    A conversation with two of our Technical Directors focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.
  • Technical Lead Assessment (90 mins via Zoom)
    A structured assessment led by a senior Technical Lead or Head of Engineering, designed to evaluate key aspects of a Technical Lead role. This session includes a selection of tasks to cover:

    Architecture Design - We want to see how you approach a high-level problem, demonstrating your design thinking and decision-making process.
    Technical Implementation - How do you turn a design into reality, taking into account business needs?
    Code Standards and Feedback - We want to see not just your own skills, but also how you improve those around you

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project. 

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct manual and electronic identity verification checks to confirm the identity of prospective employees.


Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence. 

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.

Our salary range starts from £90,000 + bonus & benefits and will be discussed during the initial interview based on your experience.

title: Technical Architect
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: Technical Architect

We’re deploying large-scale NVIDIA GPU clusters, including GB200 and GB300 rack-scale systems, into live data centres on tight customer commit dates. On those schedules, a design error found on site costs weeks and real money. We need one architect per deployment who takes the high-level design and turns it into something that can actually be built, then stays with it until the customer signs off.

This is a role for someone who would rather find the problem on paper than on the data hall floor. It suits someone who will push back on an inherited design or a customer requirement that won’t perform, and who carries authority through owning the design rather than managing people.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Take each cluster from CTO handover to customer acceptance as its single design authority, so nothing is ordered or installed against a design you haven’t validated
  • Turn high-level designs and initial BOMs into build-ready low-level designs, hall layouts, rack elevations, P2P maps and cable schedules that site teams can build from without having to call you
  • Design the InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric, power, direct liquid cooling and containment to fit the real constraints of each data centre
  • Validate every BOM before it goes to procurement, and make part substitution calls knowing exactly what breaks when a line changes
  • Hold OEMs and integrators (NVIDIA, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro and others) to their technical commitments, from FAT witness through to on-site issue resolution
  • Build the reference designs and building blocks that mean each new deployment starts from a known-good baseline rather than a blank page

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:
